Team, We know there’s a lot happening in Pennsylvania right now. But while many of you are working hard to shape the future of our state, the leaders already in office are preparing to make a critical decision that could have lasting consequences for the health and safety of Pennsylvania families.
**Pennsylvania lawmakers are considering HB 2145, a bill prohibiting companies from intentionally adding PFAS, (a.k.a. “forever chemicals”) to a variety of products ranging from _cosmetics, dental floss, and menstrual products to certain everyday _products for children under 12.__**
PFAS exposure has been linked to serious health problems, including reproductive issues and cancer. They have no legitimate place in products families use on a daily basis, especially products for babies and children, who are particularly vulnerable (and notably aren’t always the best at keeping everyday objects out of their mouths).
The state house passed the bill with bipartisan support in June. Now, the state senate needs to pass it.
**That’s why we’re asking you to join us by writing and calling your senators demanding they pass this legislation as soon as it is up for a vote.**

clean_body: write your letter and call your senator | Team, We know there’s a lot happening in Pennsylvania right now. But while many of you are working hard to shape the future of our state, the leaders already in office are preparing to make a critical decision that could have lasting consequences for the health and safety of Pennsylvania families. Pennsylvania lawmakers are considering HB 2145, a bill prohibiting companies from intentionally adding PFAS, (a.k.a. “forever chemicals”) to a variety of products ranging from cosmetics, dental floss, and menstrual products to certain everyday products for children under 12. PFAS exposure has been linked to serious health problems, including reproductive issues and cancer. They have no legitimate place in products families use on a daily basis, especially products for babies and children, who are particularly vulnerable (and notably aren’t always the best at keeping everyday objects out of their mouths). The state house passed the bill with bipartisan support in June. Now, the state senate needs to pass it. That’s why we’re asking you to join us by writing and calling your senators demanding they pass this legislation as soon as it is up for a vote. You’ll be directed to a page that will connect you with your senator’s office directly. After you take these actions, reply to this email to let us know how it went, then help spread the word by forwarding this email to your friends, family, and social circles across the state! Thank you for taking action with us. We’ll keep you posted! \- Jane Fonda Climate Action Team | | Paid for by Jane Fonda Climate ACTION.

name: Rick Bennett
subject: I just walked off the stage, Peter.
disclaimer_text: Paid for and authorized by Bennett for Governor · P
body:
Maine isn't broken. Our politics are. Here's where you come in.

| | |
---
---
---
---
Hi Peter, I just walked off that stage, and before the night ends I wanted to write to you. You signed up to follow this campaign, and I'm grateful you're paying attention. **Tonight I told a room full of Mainers what they already know.** Housing is out of reach. Energy bills keep climbing. Health care and child care cost too much, and wages aren't keeping up. None of that is bad luck. It's what happens when the people in charge stop listening to the people who live here. Then I told them what I believe more tonight than ever. **Maine isn't broken. Our politics are. And Mainers are ready to fix it.** Mainers aren't asking for a miracle. They're asking for a home they can afford, a paycheck that goes the distance, and a government that shows up and does its job. I'm running for Governor because I answer to them. Not to party bosses, not to dark money, and not to anyone who profits from things staying the way they are. **That's why I'm asking you to do something you haven't done yet** : become an official supporter of this campaign with your first contribution tonight. Even $5 makes you part of this. Here's what your gift does:
* **$10** prints the doorhangers a volunteer uses on a Saturday canvass
* **$25** puts our message in front of about 1,500 Mainers online
* **$50** covers gas for an organizer driving through rural Maine for a day

name: Troy Jackson
subject: devastating new poll
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Chris Pappas for Senate
body:
A new poll from the New York Times just came out — Susan Collins is winning this race by three points.
Look, it’s Troy. I need to be straight with you: **we’re getting hammered.**
[](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20261001_3.m16VTe&refcode=em20261001-3&t=1&akid=9268%2E582294%2EIsP9Ag)
A new poll from the New York Times just came out -- Susan Collins is winning this race by three points.
**[Democrats need to flip the Senate, and the only way we’ll do that is by defeating Susan Collins and winning in Maine. Our campaign has launched a same-day $1,000,000 goal to help us combat the millions Susan will raise off of this new poll. Please help Chris Pappas and me punch back by giving $10 or more right now.](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20261001_3.m16VTe&refcode=em20261001-3&t=2&akid=9268%2E582294%2EIsP9Ag)**
**[Donate to Defeat Susan Collins »](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20261001_3.m16VTe&refcode=em20261001-3&t=3&akid=9268%2E582294%2EIsP9Ag)**
**I won’t mince words; this is a five-alarm fire for our campaign.**
If you know me, you know I don’t put much stock in a single poll. But this is now the *second* poll showing us losing to Susan Collins. That’s a big deal.
With this new poll, you can bet that Donald Trump and his billionaire buddies see Maine as their best shot to hold the Senate majority. That means they’ll be doubling down on the millions they’ve already thrown at Susan’s campaign -- _their goal now is to bury us._
And to make matters worse, Susan has been outspending us 2-to-1 with TV ads -- this gives her the perfect opportunity to reach the 5% of Maine voters who will decide this election.
I’ve never needed your support more than at this moment.
**[We’re falling behind, and there’s not a lot of runway left before Election Day. Unless we’re able to reach our $1 million goal today, our shot at flipping Maine and the Senate majority will fade. Please, don’t wait another second, give $10-- or more -- right now to help Chris Pappas and me respond in a big way. ](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20261001_3.m16VTe&refcode=em20261001-3&t=4&akid=9268%2E582294%2EIsP9Ag)**

Let's get to work,
Troy

body:

# CAMPAIGN UPDATE:
TV Ads Bought - Debate Prep Going Strong. Debate: October 6, 2026 at 7pm EST.
Friends, It's just five days until the debate between Governor Moore and myself and I am writing to let you know that we have just made a major TV ad buy. Our campaign ads to lower our taxes, fees and bring transparency and accountability back to our budget have been running for several months now on Streaming and social media, and we've recently hit milestones of over 12 million views.

But we need [your continued support](https://us.list-manage.com/ph0pbI4y8xx?e=5bb5efcda7&c2id=56a77d5a7be3731f6f21d9e4cc6a323b) while I continue to prepare to take on the Governor's failed policies and chart the vision needed for our state's recovery.

The debate is Tuesday, October 6, 2026 at 7pm. Here is how you can watch it: **MPT** will broadcast the debate, statewide, from 7 p.m. to 8 p.m., that Tuesday, Oct. 6. **WBAL-TV 11** , WBAL News Radio in Baltimore, **NBC4 Washington (WRC-TV)** , and public media stations WHUT and WETA will air the debate at 7 p.m. on Tuesday, Oct. 6. **C-SPAN will air the debate nationally at 7 p.m. Tuesday, Oct. 6.** MPT will air an encore broadcast of the debate at 11 p.m. Tuesday, Oct. 6. MPT will livestream the pre-recorded debate at 7 p.m. Tuesday, Oct. 6, at [mpt.org/vote2026](https://us.list-manage.com/cTBzPgnzJC4?e=5bb5efcda7&c2id=56a77d5a7be3731f6f21d9e4cc6a323b).

Now is our moment to save Maryland. Will you chip in tonight to help us make the next urgent media buy of $40,000? Donate [here](https://us.list-manage.com/L_2E4q924Dv?e=5bb5efcda7&c2id=56a77d5a7be3731f6f21d9e4cc6a323b). [$176 buys one 30 second tv ad; $1776 buys 10](https://us.list-manage.com/GKT6ipbSSkx?e=5bb5efcda7&c2id=56a77d5a7be3731f6f21d9e4cc6a323b).

Thank you! We need your help - volunteer if you can as well. Let's win together. See our upcoming events below.

For Maryland,

Dan Cox
Republican Nominee for Governor
Maryland, Beautiful Maryland

Reminder: If you're receiving this email, you're already set up on Right Insight and ready to help your statewide and
Congressional candidates this November!

Getting started is easy. Log in using the email address where you received this message. You'll receive a six-digit verification
code by email. Enter that code, and you're ready to start making calls or knocking doors.

October starts today, and we're kicking off the month with a big Week of Action. We want to get as many volunteers logged in and
reaching voters as possible this week.

Whether you can make 5 calls or 500, every contact helps. Log in today and join our Week of Action!

name: Gina Hinojosa
subject: I refuse to stop talking about public education.
body:
Moms across Texas are fed up.
# [](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)[](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)
Conservative moms are fed up, Peter.
Across Texas, lifelong conservative mothers, teachers, and school board members are throwing their support behind my campaign because they’re tired of the way Abbott has deteriorated our public school system.
From the Rio Grande Valley to the Panhandle, parents across the political spectrum are fed up watching Greg Abbott funnel $1 billion of taxpayer dollars into private school voucher schemes while neighborhood public schools close, classrooms face teacher shortages, and local districts are forced onto four-day schedules.
When I first started this campaign, I was told at the beginning, "You talk too much about education."
**Well, I am going to talk about it some more, and I refuse to stop talking about it.**
I’m a mom of two sons, and over the last decade under Greg Abbott, I’ve watched the steady deterioration of our public schools firsthand. I know that parents and teachers are working tirelessly just to hold things together.
That’s why I’m running: to restore public schools, end private school vouchers, raise teacher pay, and stop state takeovers of local districts.
**[Peter, will you chip in $5 today to help us reach voters across Texas and build a school system our kids deserve?](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20261001_4_moms.pK5JDo&refcode=em20261001-2297&amount=5&t=1&akid=2297%2E299639%2EtpqhPr)**

Thank you for having my back.
Gina

He wins the Senate. He gets the gavel. He gets the ability to stop everything cold and push through every radical priority the left has been waiting years to pass. three of us, together, represent the difference between a Republican majority that can govern and a Schumer-led chamber that cannot be stopped. Every confirmation fight, every spending battle, every check on the left's agenda runs directly through our three seats. Lose one, and the math gets dangerous. Lose all three, and it's done. Brown built his job in Washington as a reliable vote for big government, big spending, and big labor -- and he wants it back. He's championed radical left wing mandates, and a tax-and-spend agenda that would hammer Ohio's businesses and working families. Jon Husted is the candidate who can stop him -- but only with your support.Abdul El-Sayed is not a Michigan candidate. He is the national progressive movement's bet on Michigan. He has championed radical government expansion, and a tax-and-spend agenda that would hit Michigan families and Michigan businesses hard. He is flush with outside money, he has national backing, and he has one goal: to take Mike's race and deliver it to Schumer.Troy Jackson has built his entire campaign around a single purpose: hand Maine to the Democrats. He is a partisan progressive who would enter the Senate as a guaranteed vote for every item on Schumer's wish list. If we want to build a better future for Tennessee, we must run bold, courageous leaders who aren’t afraid to take on the rising costs, chaos, and corruption that has defined the complete Republican control of our state for far too long. Today, I want to personally introduce you to a phenomenal champion leading that charge in West Tennessee: **Our Democratic nominee for U.S. Congress in District 8, Heidi Kuhn!** [****](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/140462572/650607176/-1167662527?refcode=261001-email&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83NzEzNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwMzBhM2Q4Ni0wMGJlLWYxMTEtYTZhOS0wMDBkM2E1NmQyZjciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=I0kHIjL0cpSgpPp2syND_WVl0qr9njy2XF8ruYkKzr8=) | [SPLIT A DONATION BETWEEN THE TNDP & HEIDI KUHN](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/140462573/650607177/-1167662527?refcode=261001-email&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83NzEzNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwMzBhM2Q4Ni0wMGJlLWYxMTEtYTZhOS0wMDBkM2E1NmQyZjciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=I0kHIjL0cpSgpPp2syND_WVl0qr9njy2XF8ruYkKzr8=)

As the proud mother of a nurse, a teacher, a pilot, and a son serving in the military, Heidi knows what it means to hope for your children’s future. After 27 years in public service, including serving as the elected Criminal Court Clerk in Shelby County, she stepped up to run for Congress to protect the rights of her children, their families, and everyone working to build a future in Tennessee.
For too long, Tennessee families have been left behind and ignored by out-of-touch politicians who prioritize corporate mega-donors and extreme political theater over real issues.
Look at the incumbent Republican representing District 8, David Kustoff. While Tennessee families have struggled to stay afloat under skyrocketing costs for groceries, gas, and healthcare, Kustoff voted in line with extreme Washington cronies to slash healthcare and food assistance for our neighbors, knowing that half of those recipients are children.
**Heidi knows that families deserve more than just survival, they deserve stability, dignity, and real opportunity.**
But to take on their corporate machine, we have to stand united. That is why I am asking you to stand with Heidi and the Tennessee Democratic Party today by splitting a grassroots contribution. We are proving to the country that Tennessee is not a state to fly over or ignore. We are organizing everywhere to compete and win anywhere.

_The first story I commissioned for Drop Site News in September 2024 was about a brutal Israeli military operation on the city of Jenin in the occupied West Bank. I reached out to Palestinian journalist Mujahed al-Saadi for coverage from the ground on the targeting of Jenin 's hospitals by Israeli troops. A reporter from Jenin who has covered the region since 2012, Al-Saadi was no stranger to the dangers of working as a journalist in Palestine. In 2022, he was just a few feet away from his friend and colleague Shireen Abu Akleh, the legendary Al Jazeera correspondent, when an Israeli sniper shot and killed her._
_A couple of weeks after we published his[dispatch](https://substack.com/redirect/d1fea445-3e91-40c7-906d-474b2e19893c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), Al-Saadi was [abducted](https://substack.com/redirect/80ee6411-df40-4868-b45e-c391577340a5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) from his home in Jenin by Israeli forces and thrown into administrative detention, where he was held without charge or trial for nearly two years. He was released on July 14, 2026._
_Barely a month after his release, he filed a video[dispatch](https://substack.com/redirect/665bfdcb-a7ef-4eba-83f3-ec0d8b2639c3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) for Drop Site about an Israeli airstrike on a building near his home that killed three Palestinians. The report marked Al-Saadi's first time back in the field after being released from prison. "The first experience today is the most difficult, as reporting information and news is intertwined with confronting the occupation for the first time," he said. "But this is the reality I am reporting, and I am trying to convey it for the first time after my release from the occupation's prisons."_
_Nearly 40 Palestinian journalists are currently imprisoned by Israel, the majority of them in administrative detention._
_We asked Al-Saadi to write about his harrowing experience in Israeli prison. Below is that account. It is the first in a two-part series. The second, to be published in the coming days, is about Al-Saadi returning to Jenin to find the refugee camp there destroyed by the Israeli military and all of its residents displaced._
_-- Sharif Abdel Kouddous_

Mujahed Al-Saadi reporting from Jenin on September 8, 2024, less than two weeks before his arrest by Israeli forces. Photo courtesy of Mujahed Al-Saadi.
_Story by Mujahed Al-Saadi_
JENIN, occupied West Bank--Just after midnight on September 19, 2024, a large Israeli military force arrived in the city of Jenin and raided my home in the Al-Saada neighborhood, west of the city. It marked the beginning of what would be a 22-month ordeal of imprisonment for me.
The sounds of explosions filled the air as occupation forces threw concussion grenades and broke down the doors of my house. They moved quickly. Within the first moments of their arrival, I was severely beaten in front of my family. I was then blindfolded and my hands bound. Israeli soldiers searched the house and confiscated my journalistic equipment, including cameras, electronic accessories, and mobiles.
The soldiers hurled insults and obscenities at me, and continued beating me while I was shackled inside their military vehicle. They drove me to a military base west of Jenin, known as Salem Camp, where I spent a full day and night out in the open, without food or water. This was where the opening chapter of my imprisonment began.
Since October 7, 2023, the occupation's prisons, which are overseen by National Security Minister Itmar Ben-Gvir, have become graveyards for the living. Prisoners are subjected to various forms of abuse, including starvation, humiliation, and deliberate killing through a policy of medical neglect. The number of Palestinians detained by occupation forces since October 7 has topped 25,000, with nearly 10,000 currently behind bars, compared with just over 5,000 prisoners before.
The following day, I was next taken to Megiddo Prison, located near the city of Jenin. I arrived there at 3 a.m. Incoming prisoners are welcomed with severe beatings--this is the ritual and the first stage of being admitted into the prison. I was beaten on sensitive parts of my body, then stripped of all my clothes and given poor quality and foul smelling clothing. All my belongings were taken from me, including my ring and my watch.
LEFT: Mujahed Al-Saadi reporting from Jenin on June 5, 2024. RIGHT: Mujahed Al-Saadi with colleagues in Jenin on April 22, 2024. Photos courtesy of Mujahed Al-Saadi.
Megiddo prison consists of 10 sections. Each section contains 16 cells, with 10 prisoners held in each cell, in a space no larger than 20 square meters (around 215 square feet). At the end of each cell, there is a single bathroom shared by the 10 prisoners.
I was taken into one of the cells and thrown onto the floor. I spent the first night without a mattress or a blanket. A day later, I was given a thin mattress that reeked--it was probably more than 10 years old. This was how the ritual of abuse and torture began, with prisoners deprived of even their most basic rights.
There was hardly any food given to us. The morning meal consisted of no more than 50 grams of yogurt, a few small pieces of cucumber or tomato, and three slices of bread. Meals like this were distributed to all the prisoners. This was the first thing I was given to eat in the 48 hours since my arrest.
Lunch consisted of no more than 30 grams of rice and around 50 grams of legumes, such as chickpeas. The food was served cold. Dinner was just as meager: no more than one egg, 10 grams of hummus, and a few slices of bell pepper.
I weighed 89 kilograms when I was arrested and 59 kilograms when I was released--I lost nearly a third of my weight during my imprisonment.
Since October 7, 2023, the occupation has both reduced the amount of food provided to prisoners and shut down the "cantina," or "market," inside each prison section where detainees used to be able to buy personal hygiene products as well as some food and canned goods they could take into the kitchen and prepare themselves.
Some prisoners would save their breakfast, lunch, and dinner and eat all three together as a single meal--just so they could feel full.
An adult male typically needs between 1,500 and 2,000 calories a day, but the three meals we were given amounted to no more than 5% of that. And that's not to mention the poor quality of the food.
Personal hygiene items were also taken away or withheld from us, including toothbrushes, razors, and nail clippers, along with other basic personal cleaning supplies. My first shower was a full 15 days after my arrest, when I received my first 30-gram packet of shampoo. We would receive just one shampoo packet per week for bathing or any other use. Deprivation of basic hygiene products led to some 95% of prisoners contracting scabies, a skin condition that spread because of poor hygiene, a severe shortage of cleaning supplies, and a lack of clothing. The shortage of clothes was so severe that prisoners were often forced to share.
Scabies is so pervasive and persists for so long in prison, that some prisoners have attempted suicide because of it. Symptoms include rashes that appear all over the body and on sensitive areas, accompanied by constant, distressing itching that prevents prisoners from sleeping or resting. Boils develop that discharge infected blood. Prisoners have also been martyred as a result of systematic medical neglect. One prisoner developed boils on his body near his heart--they burst, causing internal bleeding and infection inside his body.

Before October 7, the number of prisoners with medical files in the occupation's prisons did not exceed 100. Today, all prisoners have medical files and are in need of intensive treatment. There are also prisoners with heart disease and diabetes, and others who need urgent operations and immediate surgical intervention, but the occupation delays their treatment.
Over 90 Palestinian prisoners have died in Israeli prisons since October 2023, many of them from deliberate medical neglect, which includes the withholding of basic medications. In Megiddo, a single Acamol painkiller tablet--if any were available at all--would be shared by more than 10 prisoners who would grind it up and dissolve it in water.
The raids and abuse practiced against me and all the prisoners were carried out through more than five units, including a unit called Dror, assigned after October 7 to the occupation's prisons to suppress and humiliate prisoners and search their cells.
Today, inside in the occupation's prisons, even an empty plastic bag, kept by prisoners to store their meager bread rations to prevent it from drying out and spoiling, is considered a prohibited item. A prisoner can be singled out for abuse if a single-use plastic cup is found in his possession. If a prisoner raises the call to prayer aloud, or just practices religious worship inside the cell, this unit is brought in to suppress, beat, and abuse him.
One evening at around 8 p.m., the Dror unit raided my cell in section 9 of Megiddo Prison. They searched the room and beat us. Then they took us outside in the frigid night, stripped us of our clothes, and threw us on the ground. They left us there for more than two hours, our bodies absorbing all that cold. We were forced to lie on our stomachs with our hands shackled behind our backs, our faces at the section's sewage drain. The stench was unbearable.
After they ransacked the room, they poured shampoo and cold water over our clothes, mattresses, and blankets. When we were taken back into the room, it smelled filthy because they had left garbage on the clothes and soaked everything with water. This was one of the forms of abuse practiced against us. It was a day I will never forget. That night, we all slept on the bare iron beds, without mattresses or blankets. Even the window in the room was left open without glass, leaving us exposed to the winter cold.
Over the past three years, the occupation has imprisoned thousands of Palestinians, with the total at one point reaching over 10,000 prisoners. Many are administrative detainees, held under what is known as the Emergency Administrative Detention Law, which has been used in Palestine since the British Mandate era, and allows authorities to imprison Palestinians indefinitely without charge or trial.
I was transferred to administrative detention 72 hours after my arrest. I was detained for six months, an arbitrary detention without a clear charge, based on the claim that I posed a security threat, even though I was just working as a journalist, covering events in the city of Jenin and across the West Bank. After the first six month detention period ended, my administrative detention was renewed a second, third, fourth, and fifth time, until I had spent 22 months in the occupation's prisons without charge and without any evidence of what the occupation claimed. With the arbitrary extensions, the prisoner does not know when he will be released, increasing the bitterness of detention and the difficulty of adapting to the prison's conditions. This is how the occupation holds dozens of journalists behind bars.
As for military courts that prosecute Palestinians in the West Bank, there are two: the first is Ofer military court, near the city of Ramallah, and the other is Salem military court, west of Jenin.
Another form of torture and deprivation is the lack of communication with prisoners' families and restrictions on lawyers visits. Prisoners' families have to obtain a permit from the Supreme Court approving a private lawyer's visit to the prisoner--this is the only way to communicate and get some reassurance for both the prisoner and his family.
But the visit costs the prisoner more than 700 shekels (about $230) and lasts only five minutes. Worse still, the prisoner is taken out of the cell at 6 a.m. and waits until three in the afternoon sitting on his knees, blindfolded, and with his hands shackled behind his back. There can be as many as 30 prisoners waiting at one time. Each prisoner is taken out to speak with the lawyer. On rare occasions, a visit may last 10 minutes. This is not enough time to exchange information and news about the prisoner and his family.
During one of my lawyer's visits, I was taken out of the cell at 6 a.m. I was beaten by the guards, my hands were shackled behind my back, and I was blindfolded. There were around 20 other prisoners waiting in the room with me. When my turn came, they removed my restraints and the blindfold from my eyes. I quickly sat down on the chair across from the lawyer. He was visibly shocked by my appearance, which had completely changed from the photos my wife had sent him on his phone. He stared at me in disbelief. This was after nearly six months of detention.
After I had been sitting in the chair for five minutes, perhaps less, the lawyer told me that my older brother had been [martyred](https://substack.com/redirect/da1c20bf-0e31-44dc-9aec-bde21bc150e6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) during a raid on the city of Jenin in an attempt to arrest one of the neighbors. He was shot inside his home and died after ambulances were prevented from reaching him to provide medical treatment. I remember that I could not contain myself and broke down, crying heavily. Prison guards then beat me severely all over my body. This is how lawyer visits go.
Under Israeli law, a prisoner has the right to a visit lasting between 30 and 45 minutes. But the occupation continues to deprive prisoners of this right.
Life in prison is filled with cruelty, deprivation, humiliation, and indignity, from the first moment of arrest until the moment of release. When I was finally released, I was taken out of the cell early in the morning and given back my belongings that had been confiscated from me on the first day. I was then brought before the prison directors, who threaten and intimidate every prisoner being released. After that, I was held in a cell for more than three hours until the prisoner transport vehicle arrived. I was then driven to one of the checkpoints closest to the occupied Palestinian territories and let go.
When a prisoner comes out of prison it appears that he has grown old, not only from the lack of food and ill treatment but also psychologically, due to the constant humiliation and deprivation. The prisoner reaches a point where he believes he cannot return to life, to humanity. With no direct contact with his family, he reaches a point where he loses confidence in life beyond prison, he believes the outside to be devoid of life.
I used to think of it as a distant dream: the prison gate opening for me to walk out. Then I remember that I really did make it out of that dark graveyard.
The number of prisoners who have died inside the occupation's prisons since October 7 is many times greater than the number who died during decades past. I developed health problems in my frail body, specifically issues affecting my thyroid and liver. A number of my body's functions have been impaired because of the lack of nutrition, the lack of food, and the poor hygiene.
When I was arrested, my youngest daughter, Maria, was six months old. When I returned 22 months later, she was over two years old and she did not accept my presence in the house. It took many attempts and nearly 30 days before she accepted me.
Whomever is released from the occupation's prisons feels as though he has been given a new life. These prisons are mass graves where prisoners wait for their own deaths to be announced.

1051 Evans Ave, Fort Worth, TX 76104 For more event details, contact David at [_**dvillalobos@organizetexas.org**_](mailto:dvillalobos@organizetexas.org). [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/140462691/650608721/-359020199?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNVE8vMS80NTY0MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkY2IzOWYzMC0wM2JlLWYxMTEtYTZhOS0wMDBkM2E1NmQyZjciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=AwY5Oh4wI-XVARdIq1Un97OgVURHMT1Yg4kRl156BNQ=&emci=2bd02b25-c3bd-f111-a6a9-000d3a56d2f7&emdi=dcb39f30-03be-f111-a6a9-000d3a56d2f7&ceid=227997)
**Remembering Garnet Coleman, former Houston State Rep.** **We were saddened to hear of the passing of former State Representative Garnet Coleman last week.** A steadfast public servant and supporter of TOP since our inception, our staff and members send our sincerest condolences to his loved ones. Rep. Coleman was a fighter for all communities across Harris County — especially those historically marginalized — being a staunch defender of the rights of his constituents. From affordable healthcare access, to public education, to community-driven urban redevelopment, his command of the issues impacting everyday working Texans was undeniable, earning him a Community Champion Award from our organization in 2014. A vocal advocate for health reform particularly, his efforts were instrumental during the rollout of the Affordable Care Act in Texas, as he was a fierce backer of Medicaid expansion for our state. **Rep. Coleman's presence and strong leadership in Houston will be deeply missed.**
**End Non-Safety Traffic Stops + Mass Surveillance in Texas** Every day, thousands of Texans are pulled over for minor, non-safety issues. **These stops draw working people into unnecessary police contact with zero public safety benefit.** At the same time, Automated License Plate Readers (ALPRs), like Flock Safety, are expanding across our state. They create massive tracking databases that monitor where you drive, work, worship, and seek medical care. **Sign the petition:[Tell Texas officials to end non-safety traffic stops and Flock surveillance.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/140462692/650608722/-731476291?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNVE8vMS80NTY0MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkY2IzOWYzMC0wM2JlLWYxMTEtYTZhOS0wMDBkM2E1NmQyZjciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=AwY5Oh4wI-XVARdIq1Un97OgVURHMT1Yg4kRl156BNQ=&emci=2bd02b25-c3bd-f111-a6a9-000d3a56d2f7&emdi=dcb39f30-03be-f111-a6a9-000d3a56d2f7&ceid=227997)**
**TOP Tip: Register to vote by Oct. 5**
**Time is running out! ⏰ Make sure to register to vote by October 5 - the Texas Voter Registration Deadline.** We’re only a month out until the November midterm election. Now’s your chance to make sure your voter registration is up-to-date so that you can vote with ease this election season. Already registered to vote? Double check your voter registration. If you have friends or family members in Texas who aren't registered to vote yet, now's the time to get it done. [_**Visit govotetexas.org for helpful information.**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/140462693/650608723/10063611?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNVE8vMS80NTY0MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkY2IzOWYzMC0wM2JlLWYxMTEtYTZhOS0wMDBkM2E1NmQyZjciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=AwY5Oh4wI-XVARdIq1Un97OgVURHMT1Yg4kRl156BNQ=&emci=2bd02b25-c3bd-f111-a6a9-000d3a56d2f7&emdi=dcb39f30-03be-f111-a6a9-000d3a56d2f7&ceid=227997)

* * *
**Español** **6 de oct. en Fort Worth: Cena comunitaria sobre la salud y la política de las mujeres afrodescendientes** **Acompaña a BlackTOP la próxima semana en Fort Worth para una cena gratuita y una conversación comunitaria** sobre cómo la salud de las mujeres afrodescendientes en Texas se relaciona con el voto en estas elecciones. **Martes, 6 de octubre de 2026 – 6 p.m.
Fort Worth Association of Federated Women's Clubs**
1051 Evans Ave, Fort Worth, TX 76104 Para más detalles sobre el evento, contacta a David: [_**dvillalobos@organizetexas.org**_](mailto:dvillalobos@organizetexas.org). [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/140462694/650608724/-359020199?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNVE8vMS80NTY0MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkY2IzOWYzMC0wM2JlLWYxMTEtYTZhOS0wMDBkM2E1NmQyZjciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=AwY5Oh4wI-XVARdIq1Un97OgVURHMT1Yg4kRl156BNQ=&emci=2bd02b25-c3bd-f111-a6a9-000d3a56d2f7&emdi=dcb39f30-03be-f111-a6a9-000d3a56d2f7&ceid=227997)
**En memoria de Garnet Coleman, exrepresentante estatal de Houston** **Nos entristeció profundamente conocer la noticia del fallecimiento, la semana pasada, del exrepresentante estatal Garnet Coleman.** Como servidor público incondicional y aliado de TOP desde nuestros inicios, nuestro personal y nuestros miembros expresan sus más sinceras condolencias a sus seres queridos. El representante Coleman luchó por todas las comunidades del condado de Harris — especialmente por aquellas históricamente marginadas — y fue un firme defensor de los derechos de sus representados. Desde el acceso a servicios de salud asequibles y la educación pública hasta la renovación urbana impulsada por la comunidad, su dominio de los temas que afectan a los trabajadores tejanos en su vida cotidiana era innegable; por ello, nuestra organización le otorgó el premio "Community Champion" (Campeón de la Comunidad) en 2014. Destacó especialmente como un firme defensor de la reforma del sistema de salud; sus esfuerzos fueron fundamentales durante la implementación de la Ley de Cuidado de Salud Asequible (Affordable Care Act) en Texas, ya que apoyó decididamente la expansión de Medicaid en nuestro estado. **Extrañaremos profundamente la presencia y liderazgo del representante Coleman en Houston. **
**Poner fin a las paradas de tráfico no relacionadas con la seguridad y a la vigilancia masiva en Texas** Cada día, miles de tejanos son detenidos por infracciones menores que no comprometen la seguridad. **Estas intervenciones obligan a personas trabajadoras a tener contactos innecesarios con la policía, sin aportar ningún beneficio a la seguridad pública.** Al mismo tiempo, los sistemas automatizados de lectura de matrículas (ALPR), como Flock Safety, se están extendiendo por todo el estado. Estos sistemas crean enormes bases de datos que rastrean dónde conduces, trabajas, acudes a servicios religiosos y recibes atención médica. **Firma la petición:[Exige a las autoridades de Texas que pongan fin a las paradas de tráfico no relacionadas con la seguridad y a la vigilancia mediante sistemas como Flock.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/140462695/650608725/-731476291?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNVE8vMS80NTY0MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkY2IzOWYzMC0wM2JlLWYxMTEtYTZhOS0wMDBkM2E1NmQyZjciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=AwY5Oh4wI-XVARdIq1Un97OgVURHMT1Yg4kRl156BNQ=&emci=2bd02b25-c3bd-f111-a6a9-000d3a56d2f7&emdi=dcb39f30-03be-f111-a6a9-000d3a56d2f7&ceid=227997)**
**Consejos de TOP: Regístrate para votar antes del 5 de octubre** **¡Se acaba el tiempo! ⏰ Asegúrate de registrarte para votar antes del 5 de octubre, la fecha límite de registro de votantes en Texas.** Falta solo un mes para las elecciones de medio término en noviembre. Es el momento de verificar que tu registro de votante esté al día para que puedas votar sin problemas durante esta temporada electoral. ¿Ya estás registrado? Verifica tu registro aquí. Si tienes amigos o familiares en Texas que aún no se han registrado, ahora es el momento de hacerlo. **[Visita govotetexas.org para obtener información útil.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/140462696/650608726/10063611?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNVE8vMS80NTY0MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkY2IzOWYzMC0wM2JlLWYxMTEtYTZhOS0wMDBkM2E1NmQyZjciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=AwY5Oh4wI-XVARdIq1Un97OgVURHMT1Yg4kRl156BNQ=&emci=2bd02b25-c3bd-f111-a6a9-000d3a56d2f7&emdi=dcb39f30-03be-f111-a6a9-000d3a56d2f7&ceid=227997)**

Don't let the folkish sweaters fool you -- Brown is a loyal foot soldier for the Left, and he is running this race with the full organizational and financial muscle of Schumer's machine behind him. He is a partisan progressive who would enter the Senate as a guaranteed vote for every item on Schumer's wish list. He is betting that a well-funded, nationally backed campaign can override decades of trust Susan has earned with the people of Maine.[Three opponents. One coordinated plan. They’re doing this with massive infusions of billionaire cash, and hoping that money saves them from the consequences of Trump’s historically unpopular second term. They’re hoping that if they run enough attack ads in battleground races, Americans will forget that Trump’s administration has spent the last two years jacking up prices and terrorizing our neighbors. Derek, we don’t need to outspend Republicans to win, and to be blunt with you, we’re not going to. But we do need to continue building the largest midterm operation in DNC history. We need to keep registering voters, knocking doors, making calls, and training campaign staff and volunteers. And that work is expensive. This is our last month before Election Day. We can’t leave a single stone unturned. subject: He never apologized

body:
[ https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/1219?t=1001&akid=3392%2E251025%2ET2dyF7 ]Abdul for US Senate [ https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/1219?t=1002&akid=3392%2E251025%2ET2dyF7 ]Abdul for US Senate

Peter, I want to
tell you about a bill most people in Michigan have never heard of.

I was in high school when Mike Rogers introduced the National Pain Care
Policy Act. It was part of a movement in Washington that set Big Pharma
loose to deal opioids like candy.

By the time I got to medical school, bills and policies like his were why
my classmates and I were taught that pain was a "vital sign," and that
opioids were the most important medicine we had to offer our patients.

A decade after that, as a health director, I watched the worst of the
epidemic Mike Rogers helped create come into full view. It's why we made
life-saving Narcan available for free in 100 locations across Wayne
County.

I don't need to go into detail about how horrific the opioid crisis has
been for our country and for Michigan. But I do want to highlight the fact
that Mike Rogers never apologized for any of this.

Instead, he raised money off of it.

Mike Rogers took $400,000 from the drug companies that profited off this
crisis. Then, after leaving Congress, he got $14 million richer while he
worked for the very corporations he used to regulate.

When you confront Mike Rogers about how he made all of that money, he
won’t give you a straight answer. That’s probably why he’s too scared to
share a debate stage with me. He doesn’t want voters to see just how
corrupt he really is.

Peter, I don’t
take corporate PAC money and I never will. That means I don't owe the drug
companies a thing.

And when you don't owe them anything, you can take them on, bring down the
cost of prescriptions and premiums, and fight for things that’ll actually
help working people, like passing Medicare for All.

Here's why I'm telling you all of this now: Mike Rogers has Trump, Elon,
and the GOP machine spending tens of millions of dollars to plaster his
face all over TV. Plenty of Michiganders know his name, but very few know
about his track record.

MAGA Republicans are betting we won’t have enough resources to break
through their noise and get this message across to undecided voters. I’m
betting this team will shock them come Election Day.

But that only happens if we can reach those voters first, which is why I’m
asking:

[ https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/507?c0=em-ms-aes-20261002-1-ak.KkwDeF&amount=10&refcode=em20261002-3382&t=1004&akid=3392%2E251025%2ET2dyF7 ]Will you chip in $10 to get Mike Rogers' track record and
our campaign’s core policies in front of as many Michiganders as possible?

[ https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/507?c0=em-ms-aes-20261002-1-ak.KkwDeF&amount=10&refcode=em20261002-3382&t=1023&akid=3392%2E251025%2ET2dyF7 ]Donate $10 ››

In solidarity,

Abdul

subject: When they’re pushed for proof, they fold like cheap tents
body:
If we fight back, demand truth and accountability, and refuse to give in we will defeat Trump.
| | | | If you believe you've received this email in error, you may unsubscribe below.
---
---
---

---
| Friend,
---
| Trump’s administration cronies willing to do his dirty work for him have been bullying election officials in states across the country since the moment he returned to the White House.
---
| As a result, Trump’s actions—ordering the FBI to seize ballots, red state gerrymandering, and using ICE and DHS to try and build a fake voter database to prove “noncitizen and unlawful voters”—have dominated the news cycles for almost two years.
---
| This has made it seem like MAGA got the upper hand in a lopsided battle between the full might of the federal government against county and state election clerks and secretaries of state.
---
| Yet buried in the headlines are more than mere glimmers of hope—**in some cases, the blueprint for defeating Trump’s scheme to intimidate, bully, and cheat his way to victory this midterm is right there.**
---
| And the truth is this:
---
| **When MAGA election deniers are called out and pushed to show real proof, they fold like cheap tents.**
---
| [](https://zzejj9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0013rvBpHN6UMLUM-SpqfgtVcKz8phdjhht-qF92BXwzslIN-ZUW1JedufSf8CL3uR1a_xuiVOKz5CJpSMG6ysh_VTAcDtNxnoAUKkr0qnoD3U2nNLj28R_iMqBDaSt-X9-y7yVfMt70Lx3lAVzopcac3DSMoj8NtDAziomJ4OFx0YAF7V5N_EXVi2BKwiYxNuerSKQeghJmi3KUQE_LGH09NjmfEzU0DWPJ11Y3Qmxa65ECJcQa6ac_JxfoWMx8doZ92iRTAKfysWCPPgfHxTJ2Q==&c=8C9nxciXpcV5mVAIoz-sTn0n55Bnvj_Vg_9SSGsjHL0PhisYjgIkQg==&ch=P_hqBAB_oFEoqx-YkaQMKfgEptrDRGAHYnKjHYPJsClIS4VR9V9Siw==)
---
| In Nevada, a state that voted for Trump in 2016 and again in 2024 and has a Republican governor, officials there investigated the Trump Admin’s claims that over 15,900 voters were flagged in an “internal review” as likely unlawful or noncitizens.
---
| They called them on their bullshit; demanded proof, received none; and then discovered they were straight up lying: the voters they had flagged as illegal were in fact citizens, _valid voters that the Department of Homeland Security was trying to have purged from the voter rolls_.
---
| This is why it is so important to fight for every single state court judicial seat, every local election official, and every part of our system that can stand against MAGA’s fascist agenda:**they may be the very last line of defense against MAGA’s attack on our democracy, but if we fight back, demand truth and accountability, and refuse to give in we will defeat Trump.**
---
| [Will you stand with us and help save American democracy and freedom? This election, everything is on the line. What we do now will determine what kind of country we wake up to on November 4. Trump will lose if we stick together to the very end. # CAMPAIGN UPDATE:
TV Ads Bought - Debate Prep Going Strong. Debate: October 6, 2026 at 7pm EST.
Friends, It's just five days until the debate between Governor Moore and myself and I am writing to let you know that we have just made a major TV ad buy. Our campaign ads to lower our taxes, fees and bring transparency and accountability back to our budget have been running for several months now on Streaming and social media, and we've recently hit milestones of over 12 million views.

But we need [your continued support](https://us.list-manage.com/14U69WYSQUS?e=5bb5efcda7&c2id=56a77d5a7be3731f6f21d9e4cc6a323b) while I continue to prepare to take on the Governor's failed policies and chart the vision needed for our state's recovery.

The debate is Tuesday, October 6, 2026 at 7pm. [$176 buys one 30 second tv ad; $1776 buys 10](https://us.list-manage.com/1BXp9cqji53?e=5bb5efcda7&c2id=56a77d5a7be3731f6f21d9e4cc6a323b).

Thank you! We need your help - volunteer if you can as well. Let's win together. See our upcoming events below.

For Maryland,

Dan Cox
Republican Nominee for Governor
Maryland, Beautiful Maryland

subject: Join Me in Making Kansas More Affordable!
body:
| | | | | [](https://natowebbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001A3rcRDwDJ6oAgonrrXmX8831_gFSoa2TMILalz37YBMaTtAV5ls8zfrynHxAib72t8KAuaoOhbJEjhfSy4JEsGEMnwT3iAvxbCQHLG2mQQ-9vVincadwbDcBsbZw-HVTeUbhb0Gh-2bDMq-ZRdCT0ErjxmqWMKrM&c=WL0N3nau2qLyLgkBh-IjIJiroqW6z-ULd6wgkR90k4jg4iL0Mn7X3g==&ch=yLeEhmceKnho0wFEp6z5lNiGFtSGAsLKKZ7uxMVQ4Juw49ELTaB8eA==)

| | Peter,
The American Dream should still include owning a home.
In the Kansas legislature, I was proud to co-sponsor [SB 418](https://natowebbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001A3rcRDwDJ6oAgonrrXmX8831_gFSoa2TMILalz37YBMaTtAV5ls8zdbp_nUOSvOc0J_FIhVSfJ6eXQFhMwsfdTVmKJWMqJVX0jVvokijvkBvGZfjVwvBu1vo9xJlA2NBfXkR4OclwOMMHsJDINHPLymxWf2SHun4oMUiGhwpN31zQQD3gDiK-XLf0jhpGIhG&c=WL0N3nau2qLyLgkBh-IjIJiroqW6z-ULd6wgkR90k4jg4iL0Mn7X3g==&ch=yLeEhmceKnho0wFEp6z5lNiGFtSGAsLKKZ7uxMVQ4Juw49ELTaB8eA==), legislation designed to cut through unnecessary red tape, streamline housing development, and help increase the supply of affordable homes across Kansas.
Young families shouldn't have to give up on buying their first home, and older Kansans should be able to find affordable options when they're ready to downsize.
Kansas should be a place where building a future is within reach, not priced out of reach.
---
|
---
| |
---
On the Trail with Ty
---
| | Jeff and I enjoyed spending time in Shawnee with business leaders from Leavenworth, Wyandotte, and Johnson County and hearing directly about the opportunities they see, the challenges they're facing, and what Kansas can do to stay competitive.
These are the people investing in our communities, creating jobs, and helping shape the future of our state. Their perspective matters, and I'm grateful for the conversation and the ideas they shared.
---
| |
---
| |
---
| |
---
NFIB Endorses
---
This week, the National Federation for Independent Business Kansas PAC announced its endorsement of our campaign.
NFIB, the Voice of Small Business, is a nonprofit, nonpartisan, member-driven organization that advocates on behalf of America's small and independent business owners in all 50 state capitals. For over 75 years, they have been a leader on the most pressing small business issues, such as taxes, healthcare, and regulations.
In their release, they stated:
"Main Street Kansans need leaders who understand the challenges they face and support policies that will help them grow and thrive," NFIB State Director Dan Murray said. "Ty Masterson has been a friend to small businesses throughout his time in the state legislature. His commitment to cutting red tape, bolstering the workforce, and cutting taxes will help strengthen our state's economy and promote greater opportunity for hardworking Kansans. Ty Masterson is the pro-small business candidate for governor, and we are proud to endorse him as Kansas' next governor."
\--
I'm honored to have the support of the NFIB. As a former small business owner myself, I know the challenges our small business owners face and the value they bring to our state's economy. Small business is the biggest employer in Kansas, and as governor, I will continue to deregulate, lower taxes, and reduce costs so they can compete, grow, and create even more good-paying jobs.
---
| [](https://natowebbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001A3rcRDwDJ6oAgonrrXmX8831_gFSoa2TMILalz37YBMaTtAV5ls8zdbp_nUOSvOc1VibR9LoT2PVGB81VUk2my926HnQWnFhli2vva8QuE0cxuQ8RIhGe6q7F8KnSjLGEq9ArsN25jaFgo2CWA321me0_9kZIJ8BcDA5VOchNU-nuyoGPUWlurawLv_rPcs58Bz0EV6aleOV6-Zj7EkvHKb9gXrc-0CdXfa8iq4ufjocrqz4Lr4DYQv1hHew5S3M&c=WL0N3nau2qLyLgkBh-IjIJiroqW6z-ULd6wgkR90k4jg4iL0Mn7X3g==&ch=yLeEhmceKnho0wFEp6z5lNiGFtSGAsLKKZ7uxMVQ4Juw49ELTaB8eA==)
---
|

| The Field Report
---
| I know what tough choices look like because I've had to make them myself.
Too many Kansas families are facing those same pressures today, and politicians like Cindy Holscher have only made it harder. She voted for the largest tax hike in Kansas history while families were already being stretched thin.
I believe leaders should make it easier to get ahead, not harder. That's why I'm focused on lowering property taxes, keeping costs down, and making Kansas more affordable for the people who call it home.
---

Bill Lee [halted the one remaining execution](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LFyszAQBOCnEZ080kkGU6j4Gzr_bUrmEId1jkAedLaTt8-QV0i9M7vz7cd1vCJn3m7_caUgSxk3etdMIrSPmSRh5u1OUbhsC3J-7rSWfQQDrbZGGxgxCr9o9NjMYSECcg0F2_Wmd2fvbJNCnCdyNoLFGb2JU2cvi53OnQEb2z4uDYejzxoD1hjn-5N16Lt2wejBmdZG5Q3NLGU_3QtvkmjJ3-VF-ymWtckhiTyqcv8UDAoGSZQ45yNTMKSy0kFSMFRBIf1GiUnB0FoAd2n1xDnrTKSFto1qJdL0RfF5iKtOmEXHtHMV1A_-JB2xkoKh2cP8eHPOXNtOeXNbkX83G_njja8APwEAAP__YheI4g) in the state through the rest of the year and ordered a third-party review after two failed attempts to execute Christa Pike by lethal injection, the only woman on Tennessee's death row.

But I have to be honest with you: this fight feels different. Democrats are doing more than just running a campaign this cycle. They're running an invasion of Texas values, funded by out-of-state, coastal billionaires who've never set foot on a Texas ranch, never cheered a Texas football game, never sent their kids to a Texas classroom. And they 're trying to BUY Texas this election cycle. > > The Soros family has poured over $100 MILLION into Texas races this year. They believe Texas is the next domino. They believe if they spend enough, they can turn us into California. I don 't believe that. And I don't think you do either. That's why I'm not just running ads. I'm building the largest voter turnout machine this state has ever seen. **Washington's Debt Keeps Growing. What Could That Mean for Your Retirement?**

The math isn't complicated. A $38 trillion national debt doesn't get paid off with a speech — it gets inflated away, and the people holding cash and paper assets absorb the cost.

For retirement savers 55 and up, that's not an abstract economic debate. It's the difference between a nest egg that keeps pace and one that quietly loses ground every year, even while the account balance looks "fine" on a statement.

Physical gold has held real value through currency devaluations, recessions, and political dysfunction for longer than any fiat currency has existed. And there's a mechanism most investors never hear about at a workplace benefits meeting: a Gold IRA can hold IRS-approved gold and silver, and in many cases, a portion of an existing IRA, 401(k), or TSP can move into one without triggering a current tax bill or penalty.

Gold Gate Capital has handled these rollovers since 2008. Qualified purchases may include up to $25,000 in free silver under current terms.

The average donor has contributed **2 times** , and the average online contribution is **$32.05.**
That tells me something important about the kind of campaign we're building.
People aren't just showing up once. They're coming back, pitching in again, and helping us keep this campaign moving forward.
And with just 32 days until Election Day, every single contribution is an investment in our fight to keep New Hampshire blue, flip the Senate, and hold Donald Trump accountable in Washington.
**[That's why I'm asking you today: If you're able will you make a $15 contribution to this grassroots-powered campaign and defend this open Senate seat?](https://substack.com/redirect/f8549558-ed5c-4ba6-9cdb-67bdb7d0d972?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

Maybe you've supported us once. Maybe you've given several times. Or maybe you're thinking about making your first contribution today.
_Whatever brought you here, thank you._
We knew this wouldn't be the easy road. We're building this campaign with people from across New Hampshire and supporters around the country who are willing to give what they can and chip in when they're able.
**And we 're going to need that support in the weeks ahead.**
We have limited opportunities before Election Day to show the strength of this grassroots team -- and with just 32 days left, everyone is watching.
A lot of money is coming into New Hampshire to try to influence this race, to the tune of $50 million.
We can't control what outside groups decide to spend, but we can control how hard we work and whether we have the resources to reach voters, organize in communities across the state, and make our case.
**So if you 've been waiting for a chance to step up, this is it.**
**[Will you make a contribution of $15 or whatever you can to our campaign right now?](https://substack.com/redirect/f8549558-ed5c-4ba6-9cdb-67bdb7d0d972?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

## Capitol Plot Suspect in Federal Custody
The FBI took a 40-year-old Converse man [into federal custody](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLFyqzAQRb8GOjHSIgMqVLyGzq9NyaylldFERoy0Mc7fZ_DkD9JtsXPuPffjulwxprjd_-ODLL9CXjY6aiJmKovDPXJOe8occkzkPTI62ngBCYNQUkhY0HF80qKx9fYmvVEtWTUaafrJ6KFdrfeelNGDJtWDCdMEF-NIwXjT4228hDbaE6ekBKUkQN-FASXgZCSFcHFSN1qSj5xLxysxvbCG9J2fVDqXH22yK_Nem_5fA3MD83EcXcgvfYqcDw3M59nAXL_qTo7FnnDbyAtkRvcp3kRRGZnEr7LAUqgyeXHGbPG-sii058JtsX4_YkqxDmOj5f2BMb178F_3e1r4CQAA__88IYk0) Wednesday night, hours after a DPS SWAT team pulled him from his home over an alleged plot to attack the Texas Capitol. DPS said it received "credible information" Tuesday evening that Benny Caldera Jr. was planning an attack on the Capitol for Oct. 1. SWAT [arrested him at about 3 a.m. Wednesday](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL9ugzAQxp_GbEbngxh78NCFLV07ogPOwaoTIziF9O0ror5Bt5NO35_f93UdrpRyetw-6c5BXrEMDz72zCK8DROtSUpec5FYUuZ5JqGJHzIgoNUGNOBAk6QnDy1Vcxhh9qbiYDoPvnG-tdUS_Gi9sSOZSxsbNzt2nUHH7kJonXVdlcJpZwDQGEBs6mgJkJwHjvEyQata4DlJ2WpZWPhFe8w_5clbPZV7lcMisu6q-VDYK-yP46incT85zr_C_jwV9m-l_oPSJELTt5ZlYxLtdQP6rKGwr7Ywr0fKOe22Uy3c7pTyO0r-O9Ez4G8AAAD__3pZesI) on a felony charge of terroristic threat against a public servant. Caldera was released on a $75,000 bond, but [the FBI arrested him](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0LGOozAQxvGngc5oPDEEFy6uocu1V6LBHifWOTHCk5B9-xXRvsHWI_1Hv-_fZb5Qyulx_Ut3dvKOZX7wXjOL8DZ7WpOUvOYisaTMIZCQ54fMCDgoDQpwJi_pxbOhNrgFgtUtO322YE-jNUN7c4vmcQBt48JjMGDHZem17k2PvNgefZvckdMAqDUgnro4ECCNFjjG3oNpDHBIUrZObiz8phrzV3nx1vlyb7O7iay1Of1pcGpw2ve9i-V9OI57g9OzNjjVZ13Zi6Jt4yocFOXMVw7q4CkSIf9ffeLqx61KjMknyrXdXFj3lHOqw7kxcL1Typ_n8tvRXg6_AwAA__80F4Sz) again at the jail and charged him with possessing a firearm with an obliterated serial number. DPS has not described the alleged plot or how it learned of the threat. Gov. Greg Abbott [credited the two agencies](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLvOpDAMhZ8GOo9MuAwUKbahm223RE5iZqI1BCXWXN5-xWjf4K_cWOec7_tzW24UJe7337Sx1fealp1fRViV8-LpiJrkkKRrisIhkJLnXReDZoAGAc1CXuOTl47qYB2GqanZNtcJp3acuqF-2L5r3OppHP2ANAVs0bnQur7vnfeT6-toz7gG0TQNGtNe1oHQ0Dghr2vvsas65BA15Ys-WPlNZZVPenK--LTVYh-qR6naX5WZKzOT81faKEeRdD5UZj6ZzkMa0w6vlCVUZt5oB8qZi3KAuAOJ8J0DnLygCUiV_F_4FkJRUob_RiAcBQp9Sp1tOF5RJJbhWnV43yjKd5X-1ObTmn8BAAD___MejeA) in a post on X: "_Texas DPS and the FBI stopped a planned attack on the Texas Capitol_." The Capitol kept regular hours on Wednesday, and DPS said it will keep extra security there.

South Korea will help pay for a $22.3 billion [natural gas power plant](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0LGOozAQxvGnMZ3ReCCACxfX0OXaK5FjhuCLwZY9C9m3X5FX2Pov_fTp-3ef7tYHvz__2o0Mv5c47XSWQMyUJ2eT5xhSiLxEH2ieLVtHO08I2EkFEnCyjv1BU2ur2Txg1qoio3oNuhl021WrGfTtNriud0uDmpxyTa8AG9RD38PgHpU3F6cAUClAbOqls4B20EDLcnPQihZo9hxzzSsxvW1Zwnc8KNcublUwK3MqovkjcBQ4nudZvzjTFQWOly1wVCBwBHX11TPJNX4VkoUCOS7yg8oUT8oyBbuzTDn-J8dys6X4g6TfDyq80c6yyFfMZAWOVTZzOn0IvnS9aOG5WR8-o_i3Zx4GfwIAAP__jGGKJQ) in the South Texas town of Encinal, President Trump announced Wednesday at the White House. body:
This one's a triple feature. Meet three Tennessee Democrats stepping up to run in this upcoming November election

| | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/0001953a9cf6/stand-up-against-the-shameful-gop-power-grab-7363915?e=dc5f639d62)

Hey friends,
This one's a triple feature. Meet three Tennessee Democrats stepping up to run in this upcoming November election who couldn't be more different, and couldn't be more ready to challenge Tennessee’s status quo.
[**[CLICK HERE TO LISTEN NOW**](https://us.list-manage.com/1CyWPKVikz_?e=dc5f639d62&c2id=395895520870fa96cf2587ee59cac4d0)]

[**Listen or watch**](https://us.list-manage.com/zA6eOml5U5O?e=dc5f639d62&c2id=395895520870fa96cf2587ee59cac4d0)**now wherever you get your podcasts. 🎧**

[ Victoria Broderick](https://us.list-manage.com/8ZaQL2Enpce?e=dc5f639d62&c2id=395895520870fa96cf2587ee59cac4d0) is taking on a Congressional District 4 incumbent so quiet I couldn't remember the last time I heard his name.
[Dr. Laura Andreson](https://us.list-manage.com/tfmTiiqAQMY?e=dc5f639d62&c2id=395895520870fa96cf2587ee59cac4d0), a 24-year OB-GYN, told me she felt she needed to hire a criminal defense attorney just to safely practice medicine under Tennessee's abortion laws — now she's running for TN House District 63.
[ Lindsey Patrick-Wright](https://us.list-manage.com/nAmIbvez0YR?e=dc5f639d62&c2id=395895520870fa96cf2587ee59cac4d0), a public librarian in Wilson County, decided book bans and bad leadership were reason enough to run for TN Senate District 17.
We cover cost-of-living pressures on working families, the real math behind school vouchers, book banning, and what's giving each of these women hope heading into the November 2026 election.

**Register to vote or check your voter registration**[**here**](https://us.list-manage.com/TwMSjxroIh7?e=dc5f639d62&c2id=395895520870fa96cf2587ee59cac4d0)**!****Confirm your district and look up your candidates**[**here**](https://us.list-manage.com/xJ4LP42Bb6s?e=dc5f639d62&c2id=395895520870fa96cf2587ee59cac4d0)**.**
**Dates to Remember:****Voter Registration Deadline:** Monday, October 5, 2026**Early Voting:** Wednesday, October 14 – Thursday, October 29, 2026**Absentee Ballot Request Deadline:** Saturday, October 24, 2026**Election Day:** Tuesday, November 3, 2026
We have real options in this election and I hope that you’ll take the time to learn more about these candidates or the ones running in your district.
Thank you for being here,
Gloria

Here’s the rundown.
September was our busiest and best month yet.

And because of that success, we’ve burned through our financial resources faster than planned.
**[We _cannot_ run out of money to keep ballot chasers on the ground at the worst possible time in this election cycle.](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjUwMTd9AAwAAAAAA0nCSE40ey_U9KgJa64ECIQt_LRoSwbu6RPr0kMOVyBLWOpXSUxHQ0npiJ7IUUJUNDRFJ47lXoSkGLgCzReobjrQp6_FnWmfO69YL1LH6g)**

**[Right now we need 500 ballot chasers](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjUwMTd9AAwAAAAAA0nCSE42kx_6OS3HEs194VJKPYP3WmBMRLUzXnig-K5B25gg1izTMPtYYMUM8Dyaap4I-rOc-fhU1GMU1ZKKjrLVCJVrj8ITxdoiAFGoPg)** funded and deployed in the 8 critical states we have to win this midterm cycle.

If we hit that number and keep the ground game funded, we have a real fighting chance. We can keep radical “**democratic socialists** ” — actual communists in all but name — out of power.
If we fail, we lose the majority. President Trump becomes a lame-duck president. We get more of the same disastrous policies. And for all practical purposes, the fight is over.

We are out of runway. The only thing standing between us and a radical takeover is the ground game Charlie believed in — and the patriots willing to fund it right now.
**[Please don’t sit this one out.](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjUwMTd9AAwAAAAAA0nCSE45DQLkjLJ3lBgZN1W0GcnlB2oI7oYc-7F2JxeOtkSPx_WF8ibg-cqEJuv3xnaGR-Q3VbaiA4K3sX2EeuBwTusUmtgTeG3xRTdcKA)**
For Charlie. For our country. For the America we still believe in.

Tyler Bowyer

clean_body: Friend, My name is Emily, and I'm a ballot chaser for Turning Point PAC in Arizona. That means every day, I show up, knock on doors, have conversations with potential voters, and chase down ballots before Election Day. I need to tell you what I'm seeing out here, because I don't think most people understand how close this really is. Arizona is not lost.Not even close. But it is not safe either. A new poll just showed Katie Hobbs up by 4 points over Andy Biggs. Four points. That is the entire ballgame, sitting right there behind the doors I have not knocked on yet. Turning Point PAC is not like anything else in this space. They take decades of grassroots organizing and put real people, like me, into these communities well before Election Day. We build relationships. We knock on the same doors more than once. We chase every ballot, mail-in or in person, because every single one counts. This is the vision Charlie Kirk built. People on the ground, having real conversations, changing real minds. And it is working! But I cannot do this alone, and neither can the 700 of us out here across Arizona. I 'm seeing momentum on the ground, but we have so many more voters to cover. We can't do it without your continued support. Every $50 you give sponsors a ballot chaser like me for one full day. That's about 75 doors and 25 real conversations with voters who haven't made up their minds yet, and who deserve to hear from us before it's too late. For America and for Charlie, A Turning Point PAC Arizona Ballot Chaser Paid for by Turning Point PAC Arizona. Not authorized by any candidate or agents acting on any candidate's behalf. name: Bill Gray
subject: Are you proud to be an American citizen?
body:
If you’re like me, you give thanks to God every day that you live in a country that is free.

This sponsored message from Inside Scoop Politics is on behalf of Hillsdale College
| | | [](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyckc2K2zAQgJ9GvsWMfmLHBx8KXkOh2W0bSo9iIk2cAVkSlrxl-_RlS7YP0OPMB98HMz_P9owcOC7PuNLIpVifvMWN3tKet7T7mq6EEVfa2GG0ClR3kHAAZdFVfiVrsPHjUcnT7dTQKPsBBqM6eWzu45Ggl6YbPGoAB3BDglOPMDjprz26hsd3nwRQUoHWpr15ecXbCXsvCQySMLBnj5VajoU9FZdSzilwZVfatC1NGO-15iL0J6FmoeZCbt_It3cOoXgM1JLfhZr_zULN_o3jcnBc-TdFoefihJ4AOjU8gzLqizlPL9PT00Wobq-rLWnfHAk95S2VTK5yXB5oJc_7KvREK3J4LB2uGXmJQk9_S_aj9MApVopV6Onr95cfk_3WHz5fLoePSzTb6PMvDoFL1wsDy7u5dWlt6v_-53VUfwIAAP__2Kah8g)

| | Dear Fellow American, Are you proud to be an American citizen? If you’re like me, you give thanks to God every day that you live in a country that is free, peaceful, and where citizens have inalienable rights. Most people in history can’t say the same thing—in fact, most people in the world can’t say the same thing even today. You don’t have to be a historian to see that the long practice of citizenship in America is unprecedented. It’s one of our nation’s great achievements. But there’s a catch—citizenship requires vigilance and knowledge to maintain. Especially now, when it faces threats from the far-Left and progressive economic policies, illegal immigration, and more. Everyone who wishes to defend freedom in America requires an understanding of the nature and scope of these challenges. As a college, we know that a proper education is the best defense of liberty. And unlike the vast majority of colleges and universities, we must **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans about liberty. And we have to do it without taking ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of student grants and loans. NOT. ONE. PENNY—to remain proudly independent. This means that your support is critical to our success. With your help, we’ll engage the far-Left on the battlefield of education. With your help, we will defend liberty against dangerous ideologies. And with your help, we will preserve freedom for future generations of American citizens. You can give safely and securely at this link: [https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/dying-citizen](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyckc2K2zAQgJ9GvsWMfmLHBx8KXkOh2W0bSo9iIk2cAVkSlrxl-_RlS7YP0OPMB98HMz_P9owcOC7PuNLIpVifvMWN3tKet7T7mq6EEVfa2GG0ClR3kHAAZdFVfiVrsPHjUcnT7dTQKPsBBqM6eWzu45Ggl6YbPGoAB3BDglOPMDjprz26hsd3nwRQUoHWpr15ecXbCXsvCQySMLBnj5VajoU9FZdSzilwZVfatC1NGO-15iL0J6FmoeZCbt_It3cOoXgM1JLfhZr_zULN_o3jcnBc-TdFoefihJ4AOjU8gzLqizlPL9PT00Wobq-rLWnfHAk95S2VTK5yXB5oJc_7KvREK3J4LB2uGXmJQk9_S_aj9MApVopV6Onr95cfk_3WHz5fLoePSzTb6PMvDoFL1wsDy7u5dWlt6v_-53VUfwIAAP__2Kah8g) **And for a gift of $100 or more, you’ll receive a special hardcover edition of Victor Davis Hanson’s book,** **_The Dying Citizen: How Progressive Elites, Tribalism, and Globalization Are Destroying the Idea of America_****. Victor Davis Hanson is a frequent commentator on Fox News and online. He’s also a historian and distinguished fellow here at Hillsdale.** Regarding the book, my boss and teacher, Hillsdale President Larry P. Arnn, has written, “In this book, Hanson demonstrates yet again his command across time and for our time. **This book and he are a treasure.** ” Thank you so much for your partnership in promoting the kind of intelligent patriotism—especially among younger Americans—that is essential to preserving citizenship and free government.
---

Hillsdale College

name: Gina Hinojosa
subject: The race Abbott thought he’d never have to run
body:
This is a long but critically important read.
# [](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)[](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)
Hi, Peter — it's Gina.
Everywhere I go in Texas, I hear the same thing: people are struggling in ways they've never struggled before. Working people donating plasma before their shift just to cover the bills. Families rationing insulin. Small businesses closing because property taxes have gotten so out of hand.
And everywhere I go, I hear something else too:_that this movement is giving them hope_. We’re closer than we’ve ever been before, but we have a long way to go. People still worry if we can actually win here.
I understand that skepticism. Democrats have been saying Texas is turning for years. But something is different now, and I need you to see the numbers.
My campaign manager Amy put together a memo on exactly where this race stands. Two independent polls now show us ahead. Abbott's own strategist is admitting it will be close. Conservatives across Texas are crossing over — on schools, on data centers, on the simple question of whether this state belongs to the people or to Greg Abbott's billionaire donors.
**[Read the memo. Then, if you believe what I believe — that we can actually win this — I'm asking you to pitch in whatever you can.](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/1356?c0=em_ms_gh_20261002_1_memo.rPQaoJ&refcode=em20261002-2294&t=1&akid=2294%2E299639%2Eu7Bl_J)**
[Donate »](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/1356?c0=em_ms_gh_20261002_1_memo.rPQaoJ&refcode=em20261002-2294&t=2&akid=2294%2E299639%2Eu7Bl_J)
=============================================================
**OCTOBER 2026 CAMPAIGN MEMO ON TX-GOV**
**FROM:** Amy Friedman, Campaign Manager, Gina for Texas
**TO:** Interested Parties
Let me tell you where this race actually stands — because what's happening in Texas right now is something I don't think the national establishment fully understands yet.

**Gina Hinojosa is leading Greg Abbott in two of the most recent polls. That’s never happened before.**
This race is closer than ever but some people still don’t believe we can win — that’s exactly why I'm writing this memo. And it's exactly why this race could slip away if we don't act.
Here's the polling picture. This race has moved steadily and dramatically in Gina's direction since the spring:
* Emerson (January 2026): Abbott +8
* Texas Politics Project (April 2026): Abbott +5
* TPOR (July 2026): Abbott +3, inside the margin of error
* N+ Univision (September 9): Tied 47–47, with Gina leading Latino voters by 12
* ReconMR/Siena (September 17): **Gina leads 49–45** — independents breaking for Gina 65–27
* NPR/Marist (September 23): **Gina leads 49–46** , winning independents 52–39, pulling 9% of self-identified Republicans

Both RealClearPolitics and Nate Silver's Silver Bulletin have the polling average under 2 points. This is a toss-up.
**Abbott is outspending us 10 to 1 — and he still isn’t getting the result he wants.**
Between July 30 and September 8 alone, Abbott outspent Gina $28 million to $2 million on advertising. Over the full race, he's spent $47 million to our $5 million. Despite that, Gina leads in two of the last three polls. Abbott's favorability has gone deeply negative — 45% favorable, 53% unfavorable — and his job approval has flipped the same way. He's even polling 13% unfavorable among his own Republicans.
Abbott is a damaged incumbent with a nine-figure war chest. The only thing keeping this race from breaking open is the spending gap.
But here’s the truth: The more money Abbott spends lying about Gina’s record, the more vulnerable we are. _We have to raise more money to reach the voters who haven’t heard from us yet._
**Something real is happening on the ground — and Republicans know it.**
Lifelong conservative voters are publicly breaking with Abbott over two issues.
On education: conservative moms who backed Abbott before are now appearing at Gina's events, frustrated by a decade of voucher schemes and defunded public schools. Gina is running an ad featuring a self-described MAGA conservative who protested on January 6 — and is now voting for Gina because of schools.
On data centers: rural Republican protest groups — including one in Lubbock led by Republicans — are furious about unregulated expansion driving up electricity bills. Abbott championed data centers for years, took millions from their developers, and is now scrambling to reverse course. Gina called for a moratorium from day one.
As Gina put it to The Nation: The data-center issue is the latest example of a governor doing the bidding of moneyed interests and not the people of Texas. And it is angering MAGA Republicans — not country-club Republicans, not Chamber of Commerce Republicans. There is an opportunity for alliances to be forged when we are pursuing a populist agenda.
**Even Abbott's own team is admitting this race is close.**
Abbott's longtime political strategist, was asked about the tightening polls. His response: "Is it going to be close on Election Day? Yes." That’s Abbott's own guy publicly conceding this goes to the wire. And when pressed on his best argument against Gina? He went to culture wars and lies on income tax votes — not data centers, not schools, not the affordability crisis Abbott has presided over for twelve years. When culture wars are the best attack you can come up with, you're losing ground.
**The coalition winning this race doesn't look like past Texas Democratic coalitions.**
Gina leads independents by 38 points in the Siena poll. She's winning women 57–40%, voters under 45 by 60–33%, and Gen Z 71–19%. She's pulling 9% of self-identified Republicans. In TX-15 — a district Trump carried 58–41 — a House Majority PAC poll shows Gina leading 52–47.
This is a cross-partisan, cross-regional majority being built in real time. _Gina is earning support from Texans who have never voted for a Democrat before in their lives._
**When Texas Democrats run strong, the whole map shifts.**
In 2018, when Beto lost the Senate race by just 2.6 points, that wave energy flipped 12 State House seats, 2 State Senate seats, and 2 congressional seats. And the stakes this cycle go even further: if Abbott wins another term, Republicans will redraw the congressional map again. Combined with seats Texas gains after the next Census, that could put nine or ten congressional seats permanently out of Democratic reach — one-party control of Congress, likely for a generation. A governor who vetoes rigged maps changes all of that. As Gina said: _"We flip Texas, and it's over."_
**The bottom line.**
Two polls show Gina leading. One has us tied. Abbott is underwater on favorability and approval. Conservatives are crossing over to support our campaign. The polling average is under 2 points. Abbott's own strategist admits this race will be close.
_This race is winnable._ But Abbott is going to spend over $106 million to try to buy his lead back in the final few weeks of this race.
Gina has raised a fraction of Abbott’s war chest. The only thing that closes the spending gap is donors who understand what's actually happening in Texas right now — and decide this race is worth their investment.
We can win this. But only if people show up.
=============================================================
Peter, I'll leave you with this.

A view from inside the destroyed Shajareh Tayyebeh primary school, which was struck by U.S. cruise missiles, in Minab, Iran. Photo by Atta Kenare / AFP via Getty Images.
In the opening hours of the war against Iran, on February 28, 2026, the U.S. military fired Tomahawk cruise missiles directly at a school in the southern city of Minab. At least 156 people were killed that morning at Shajareh Tayyebeh school--120 of them were children and 26 were teachers. It will go down in history as one of the gravest war crimes committed by the U.S. government since Vietnam.
Drop Site News conducted a two-month investigation into the strike, speaking with survivors, first responders, parents, doctors, teachers, psychologists, and other witnesses. Some of them had never before shared their experiences of that day. This is their story.

In the opening hours of the war against Iran, on February 28, 2026, the U.S. military fired Tomahawk cruise missiles directly at a school in the southern city of Minab. At least 156 people were killed that morning at Shajareh Tayyebeh school--120 of them were children and 26 were teachers. It will go down in history as one of the gravest war crimes committed by the U.S. government since Vietnam. Drop Site News conducted a two-month investigation into the strike, speaking with survivors, first responders, parents, doctors, teachers, psychologists, and other witnesses. Some of them had never before shared their experiences of that day. This is their story. Read the full investigation here:. body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

Across the country, working people are being taken advantage of by Big
Tech companies dropping massive, destructive data centers into our
backyards.

But communities of all shapes and sizes are fighting back, and Justice
Democrat Justin J. Pearson is leading the charge in Tennessee's 9th
congressional district.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20261002-jjp.o0pi_R&refcode=em20261002-38320&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=10&t=1002&akid=38320%2E1203867%2EnPQFgU ]Image from clip by The Hill showing Justin J. Pearson, Elon Musk, and a
data center with the words 'ILLEGALLY OPERATING' over it; caption:
"'Polution island': State Rep. Justin J. Pearson rails against Elon Musk,
data centers | RISING"

When Elon Musk built two massive data centers near Justin’s home in
Memphis, he knew someone needed to stand up. In the face of Musk illegally
polluting their air and sucking up their clean drinking water, Justin’s
campaign is organizing to go to Congress and put an end to Big Tech’s
abuse of communities like his.

As Justin told The Hill, “Our lives have more value than their computers
and their billions of dollars of profit.”

Since his district was gerrymandered by Republicans to weaken Black voting
power, Justin is facing a MAGA Republican in this November’s general
election.

Ever since the map was redrawn, he’s been getting out there and uniting
voters from all political backgrounds on this issue, because “It’s not a
fight of right versus left; it’s a fight of those who are at the top and
the rest of us.”

Recent polls show Justin can win this race and go to Washington as one of
our strongest advocates against Big Tech and their toxic data centers, but
we need to make sure he has the resources to reach every voter before
Election Day.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20261002-jjp.o0pi_R&refcode=em20261002-38320&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=10&t=1003&akid=38320%2E1203867%2EnPQFgU ]Can you split $10 between Justin’s campaign and Justice
Democrats now to help us send our next progressive champion to Congress?

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20261002-jjp.o0pi_R&refcode=em20261002-38320&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=10&t=1022&akid=38320%2E1203867%2EnPQFgU ]Contribute $10

In solidarity,

Justice Democrats
