| | Friend,
---
If you ever doubted we could win America's youth back from the Left...

If you ever wondered whether we'd lost the next generation for good...

If you ever sat up at night -- watching the news, seeing what's happening in our schools, our culture, our country -- and thought, _" Is it already too late?" _

You're not alone.

A lot of good people have been asking the same question.

**But I want to tell you something that might just change how you feel about the future of this country... **

Just one year ago, Turning Point USA's high school program -- which is now called "Club America" -- was in about 1,200 schools.

That was no small feat.

Starting a single chapter today takes serious courage. Students get mocked. Threatened. Investigated. Sometimes even physically attacked.

So reaching 1,200 chapters already felt like a miracle.

_Then Charlie called me... _

He said: "Andrew, I love what we're doing with our high school program -- but we've got to move faster."

I told him, "We are."

Charlie replied, "No you're not thinking what I'm thinking... I want to be in 35,000 high schools."

I laughed. I told him, "Charlie, there aren't even 35,000 high schools in America."

"Okay," he said, "How many are there?"

"About 27,000."

Without skipping a beat, Charlie said, "Okay, great. Let's do 27,000!"
I'll be honest -- I froze.

We didn't have the numbers. We didn't have the staff. We didn't have the roadmap yet.

But he wasn't fazed.

He said, "Don't worry. We'll figure it out. We'll do it together."

That was Charlie.

He didn't think small. He didn't move slow. He didn't settle for "maybe someday."

He believed in going now.

And he believed that if the mission was right, the path would reveal itself.

He chased what others only dreamed about... and turned what others thought impossible into reality.

That's why he built Turning Point USA in the first place.

That's why tens of thousands of students were inspired by Charlie to start chapters of their own -- _many in schools where they were explicitly told not to. _

**And that 's why today -- less than a year later -- we're not in 1,200 schools anymore: **
---
[](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=e035250da2e34687957a46a06d4801b9&_e=91VTLTABkcTQ4CHaSY100NgNkihpKxwUmptlzkEeQlvv4ub6CEvW8i8-0bHiQaDFJR8XxEIlXibB3GI5xNh2xBbcCu6faV5G7HgWW8cFPiu3vNSs6DoDhT_wDJuGAOq_fbAWe-dj1jHnJsGlTGjQElKgi8EMIeePR2474Dk-T-nGstjc3tlkzZA4L-38PEaXwNwzPC5jkiyuPFBgxRUAoNjfh2f1VLF8xX7A2sT8EQajr76nkpile4aU_5URaknkI5BhPtoNqT6d3YvP0P5X1E35teVJiJ2JBRuxyRr7-xkt4T8qQc1WBkTMQcHEk1_U10yg35YC1MWRM1belaGMxWlXXHzukAQO2-47j6px1yZTCeLb_3JaZfIn0yaOzQVQ-hVH_zsxnu3QfoSzIIuEFqpEew8Y-7scogEkBCprfquzNc9HSSHq-Ti2STNdMxUeDfyel5z3HmwD0zF4YWJgSjX_BDZztLjEbhu_0NUkv3RMInJubZ1s_fIwZtbCLmbumyQdbqiOeqHK961bxPyvcW6YjadboKTVOHWdDv_43US4sEHs5gGGkLO6L21Xt4NuSBKlks8kRFgMMQnQgGWnM_rc2VfHJPGohTqbm265XdYOUYoSXNiSEaPZ6cxRYfDq9DxhGPhb0vhl00iz8ORgEK4bsRQsqV2adRGB0hLb3F_FE3EXJRuCRdaahxVjjMVT8hx4cAbn4jihiwFOR3A3Fdf6j2bF5UPZbiWG1XdIFXw%3D)
---
We're in 3,300.

That's roughly 13% of all high schools in America.

Eight states have officially partnered with Club America to bring our chapters into every school statewide.

✅ Florida
✅ Texas
✅ Tennessee
✅ Oklahoma
✅ Montana
✅ Nebraska
✅ Arkansas
✅ Indiana

And we're just getting started.

Think about that: 13% of America's youth now have a place at school where they can say it's okay to love this country...

That it's okay to be bold. That it's okay to believe in God, in family, and in freedom.

_That 's what Club America is about... _

**Giving the next generation a place where they can find their courage, develop grit, and learn how to lead the fight for their country. **
---
[](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=e035250da2e34687957a46a06d4801b9&_e=91VTLTABkcTQ4CHaSY100NgNkihpKxwUmptlzkEeQlvv4ub6CEvW8i8-0bHiQaDFJR8XxEIlXibB3GI5xNh2xBbcCu6faV5G7HgWW8cFPiu3vNSs6DoDhT_wDJuGAOq_fbAWe-dj1jHnJsGlTGjQElKgi8EMIeePR2474Dk-T-nGstjc3tlkzZA4L-38PEaXwNwzPC5jkiyuPFBgxRUAoNjfh2f1VLF8xX7A2sT8EQajr76nkpile4aU_5URaknkI5BhPtoNqT6d3YvP0P5X1KNCVZHldcKI6pRW4tX-z3WNDAEVacArxR1cW6nDlQVJ47CxcGWSNao9H5yCMBspVoa3MJz103FizPAnQgto_43SU5XuPct-gVfC44QLjS3cSpE2B-Gy9m2Hkbf_jab9VPOH8QUuyGpqDBmOxGrZuYLQ5TNOhjaXBwJUjcG2O76Y9pfqVVsb9Vi2eFBL1ZbAztae42QAfiPVN3Na-gL9pQvqRR3xYqF3uiXfD4_hTM3WAxdB_X3nFWAxgi3ygFsL-qE_b4ME8X4VJto8zQtufhjRCkEBN36iRCwJUAA3YMKaGSP_E1dsgufSJck40LJvaFsXFw-PZOdF01gDOvQu4ZEmomI4x2o5Qu7H_S0zmT8ZXO6JZ_ghvHHHvmjHmPQF0qhFyhR9H_2R_GmtDsSGLDI47xaB5_8ZY1t0CpqaiZOOVvVwuinbdLg03ddTYN6tnfsX9iNUvnIVqXA7tZBBIoc%3D)
---
_But now, Friend, the question is... _

**What will it take to bring Club America to the next 3,300 schools? What will it take to bring it to all 27,000? **

Because here's the truth:

These students aren't just signing up. _They 're stepping up. _

They're leading chapters in schools where America is attacked... where they're often targeted for daring to say what they believe... and where speaking the truth is dangerous.

But that isn't stopping them.

They're still showing up. They're speaking out. And they're growing stronger than ever.

They're becoming exactly the kind of young patriots Charlie believed in -- not just bold, _but brave_. Not just loud, but _principled_.

**Every time a student starts a new chapter, we make sure they 're not standing alone. **

**We send them an activism kit -- American flags, pocket Constitutions, chapter materials, and leadership tools. **

These kits give student leaders everything they need to rally their peers and stand strong on their campuses.

Each one costs just $25 to pack and ship.

**[If you’re able to, I hope you’ll help send a kit to the next student who raises their hand to lead by making your gift to Turning Point USA today.](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=e035250da2e34687957a46a06d4801b9&_e=91VTLTABkcTQ4CHaSY100NgNkihpKxwUmptlzkEeQlvv4ub6CEvW8i8-0bHiQaDFJR8XxEIlXibB3GI5xNh2xBbcCu6faV5G7HgWW8cFPiu3vNSs6DoDhT_wDJuGAOq_fbAWe-dj1jHnJsGlTGjQElKgi8EMIeePR2474Dk-T-nGstjc3tlkzZA4L-38PEaXwNwzPC5jkiyuPFBgxRUAoNjfh2f1VLF8xX7A2sT8EQajr76nkpile4aU_5URaknkI5BhPtoNqT6d3YvP0P5X1KiL66inWfkcr8gSqJQlXnHDICINuEySe3ai6VowtIeVUlLAD90VjbdLLo2RoxELUd1htu0qLEcsZk1mBi3wdl8a0Y5ghMeQH2cBX3gpf_8xmsuH-LrXeqXh8UJ_DPqVaF8lKrLU-vk9P6ZULHFOUCNzzGO0TaIgwzW49p-9eRT8UCWXdk9ibCjKLQsQbeD3p2R5-BSbnHNogWbbWy4_PoC4sIDXfmK0eKToI5Sc0mOo1_QswI49exijkjxB1kG0rWakoZvrmdI7HG5W0FH9fCP3vQmfz1HMUZqZDalHJmHDZFd5iE-8A-mUiD-5oV6_9Co4hNgK3DdZG-m_5ik1EjvI4842eB4G0xRZFotIePB6f0dqjZa43ZLro4zWfv9xFv2T5494navyP3N4J7dP4eUOk1W3zyaAsX4aW5KCyWk5g7eP2jK8wDCvoCZjUffDu-sdOdIJoGt39x_MWIB0rJM%3D)**

Charlie wanted a Club America chapter in every high school so no student would ever feel alone for loving God, defending their country, or believing in truth.

And so the next generation wouldn't be handed over to the Left by default.

Let's make Charlie's dream real -- 27,000 high schools. And a generation that doesn't apologize for loving this country.

It's up to us to finish what he started.

One chapter. One student. One school at a time.

Let's move faster. Let's push further. Let's get this done -- for Charlie, and for the country we all love.

On Monday, September 21, 2026, with almost no public ceremony, the European Central Bank switched on Pontes, its wholesale digital euro platform. Thirteen eurozone banks began settling tokenized transactions in central bank money for the first time in history, and the ECB even committed to investing part of its own funds in tokenized securities on the new rails. The headlines said "wholesale," a word carefully chosen to make ordinary readers' eyes glaze over. Don't let them. Wholesale first, retail by 2029 -- this is how radical monetary change always arrives: quietly, technically, and framed as plumbing.
Make no mistake about what's actually being built. The retail digital euro -- the version that lands in every citizen's wallet -- is on its own track but the same road. A twelve-month pilot begins in the second half of 2027, with 36 payment providers and merchants already being recruited. The rulebook has been through public consultation and now sits at version 0.91. The ECB is targeting a first public issuance in 2029, pending legislation. This is not a thought experiment. The scaffolding is up, the contractors are hired, and the move-in date is circled on the calendar...

Congresswoman Sarah Elfreth broke barriers in 2024, becoming the youngest woman ever elected to Congress from Maryland. She went to Congress with one thing in mind: delivering for Maryland families on the issues that matter most. Whether it's standing up for federal workers, supporting veterans, protecting the Chesapeake Bay, or tackling the affordability crisis head-on, Sarah is on the front lines, fighting for what is right. This is deeply concerning — let me explain why.

Since re-taking office, Trump has turned the DOJ into his own personal law firm.

They have opened up politically-motivated investigations into multiple state attorneys general, the former FBI director, the former CIA director, and countless other perceived political enemies, resulting in multiple indictments. And now, they admit they have surveilled conversations by a sitting Member of Congress — who happens to be a Democrat, and happens to sit on the House Oversight Committee.

body:
Right now, we need all hands on deck to register voters and ensure Latinos turn out for Jon Ossoff.
#
Peter,
Georgia’s voter registration deadline is just 3 days away. Right now, we need all hands on deck to register voters and ensure Latinos turn out for Jon Ossoff.
**[Will you make a $3 donation to Voto Latino right now to power our emergency voter registration push across Georgia before the October 5th deadline in just 3 days?](https://act.votolatino.org/go/57?c0=em-ms-voto-20261002-1.M-aplL&amount=3&refcode=em20261002-642&t=1&akid=642%2E1366028%2EvIlQ54)**
We’re less than 5 weeks away from Election Day, and we need your help to ensure Latino voters in Georgia show up in force to re-elect Jon Ossoff and support Democrats running up and down the ballot.
Georgia’s high-stakes Senate race is one of the most critical battlegrounds in the entire country. Holding this seat and re-electing Jon Ossoff could directly determine which party holds the Senate majority next year.
We must ensure every eligible voter in Georgia has the chance to make their voice heard on Election Day. That's why we're on the ground right now to register new voters, mobilize our communities, and make sure Latino turnout powers Jon Ossoff to victory on November 3rd.
**We've already registered more than 84,000 Latino voters in Georgia, and we have a proven formula for getting our communities to the polls — but we still have a long list of eligible voters to register before the deadline hits.**
[**So please, make a $3 donation today to help us register voters before October 5th and build lasting Latino voting power in Georgia.**](https://act.votolatino.org/go/57?c0=em-ms-voto-20261002-1.M-aplL&amount=3&refcode=em20261002-642&t=2&akid=642%2E1366028%2EvIlQ54)

Thank you,
Voto Latino

body:

| Law Enforecement Legal Defense Fund Never in a million years did I think I would be writing an email like this. | | | | | Dear Friend,[](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjUwMTd9AAwAAAAAA0rQxyss63ijY29HZeW7lDtglYh0HKukg0XUMo3S7nCM4qPRsQ-_xDEFsUn7yMGJd5piLwKOCONTevUhFLK5_sxN7n2ocE-3Rpj9Ahsg) Never in a million years did I think I would be writing an email like this. [_**But the truth is, my family and I are out of options. And you're our only hope.**_](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjUwMTd9AAwAAAAAA0rQxyst6xOrnUexmczmKhaPDiZBArZoSU0UnBBdgZdiMVHuuR9wCzJNPpKzSzzdgGw95F9AyVKxEYZ-PR1l70NjLJPkXqSVAtKwoV3E)
---
| | | This is a photo of my brother, Anthony DeLustro. Anthony spent more than 20 years serving citizens as an NYPD cop, hunting down dangerous drug dealers and busting up drug dens. On 9/11, he helped evacuate hundreds of people from one of the buildings just before it collapsed. Since that day, he’s been battling cancer and Ground Zero Lung from the toxic fumes. We really thought Anthony had been through the worst of it. And when he told us he was taking a police job in a small South Carolina town so he could spend his golden years close to his grandkids, I was so relieved.
---
| | [ ](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjUwMTd9AAwAAAAAA0rQxysuIPcdxoGXt5C-QC2PHuOQmbiNayBcnj8TwO9WUAzrboID2mFLxXZcakGdmnnWfiRvjNLwVjEa3f_ytZvuwdjOBRsZ8Oya9qOd)
---
[](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjUwMTd9AAwAAAAAA0rQxysvKcIijVpdMhsvIB08SYg8ZHAd46W2YdLyiorLa35Qib-chkYL8-8XtDJhr81CKDFsy2J9j0Vd7JoulUNKT3DI6vReK7H8OnV1)
---
| | | How could I have known he was about to face the greatest danger of his life?I’m not talking about a drug dealer or a terrorist or even cancer... **...but a local prosecutor hellbent on destroying my brother for defending himself when he was the victim of a road rage incident. **Let me explain.The day Anthony was attacked, he was off duty. He and his wife had stopped for lunch after spending the morning at a “Coffee With A Cop” community event.And as they tried to pull out of the crowded restaurant parking lot... ...another driver, in a fit of road rage, jumped out of his car and began screaming threats at my brother. Anthony tried to calm him down. But the man attacked him, striking him over and over. My brother could see the situation was spiraling out of control. He pulled out his badge and told the man he was under arrest. But instead of complying... ...the man knocked the badge out of Anthony’s hand. Then he got in his car and tried to flee, dragging my brother with his vehicle and running over his legs. In that moment, Anthony knew he was about to be crushed to death in front of his own wife. So he fired a single shot into his attacker’s arm, bringing the car to a stop. Anthony’s quick thinking saved his life. But the road rage driver who attacked him died at the scene. When I got the call that Anthony had been assaulted and was in the hospital with serious injuries, I couldn’t believe what had happened. I was so relieved he was alive. **But my relief turned into shock when my brother was arrested and charged with murder.** He hadn’t even recovered from his injuries when the local prosecutor dragged him in front of a judge and had him locked up in jail. He’s already spent 10 months behind bars. And he’s facing up to **30** **years** in prison. My friend, Anthony is 64 years old. If he’s convicted... **...he’ll likely spend the rest of his life locked up--and die in prison--for defending himself.** [_**That's why I'm writing you--someone I've never met--to ask you to help my brother.**_](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjUwMTd9AAwAAAAAA0rQxyswX25k5t7p5j16CqKML1k9kOBhHcZuEMUHdmmYkrL8Z_mzSXNGRFPz6qUD3LqnkAJhkV6BzrxUX1RzpCop2EtFaZahM9JlIl32)
---
| | | Because what they’re doing to Anthony is an outrage. I might not be a cop...but to me, if a police officer puts you under arrest, you don’t resist. And you certainly don’t physically attack the officer, then try to flee the scene. My brother may have been off duty. But you know that as an off-duty officer, he had the authority--and even the responsibility--to make an arrest to protect the public. What does this prosecutor expect off-duty officers to do--just let angry, violent offenders beat them up, resist arrest, and then walk away like nothing happened?
---
| | [ ](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjUwMTd9AAwAAAAAA0rQxysx5LIPUBE2uD7W1HnyrJ_pdSf0m-DYz-k1X3Mhx9rzsOSPvWEdQopNldGcRkajxoyL7G6cCCyUByHgvdsMI1TbJvzQM_k5_7PS)
---
| | | My friend, Anthony doesn’t deserve this. He’s a good man who’s well-respected by his fellow officers. He served as a cop for four decades and never once faced discipline. He has a spotless record full of awards and commendations. So to watch my brother’s life be torn apart like this is just heartbreaking. It’s been hard on his family too. Several years ago, Anthony and his wife took their two granddaughters into their home. They’ve been raising them ever since. You can imagine the pain it’s caused these poor girls to have their grandfather locked up and treated like a common criminal. My friend, we were almost out of hope. And then we found out about the **Law****Enforcement Legal Defense Fund**. You know the LELDF is a national group that’s helped dozens of innocent officers clear their names when they’re wrongly accused by radical prosecutors. And they’ve agreed to help Anthony too. Not only are they getting my brother the legal defense he deserves -- they’re also raising money to pay for the best attorneys and expert witnesses available. Which brings me to the reason I wrote you today: [_**My friend, will you help my brother fight these unjust charges by donating to the LELDF?**_](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjUwMTd9AAwAAAAAA0rQxysym19mTiYKSmOp5FyGyb0_VyNXN7zN6ox3uzB1ta2Weba33zOibyRX4Zid_TGvi_fuIGYUFZwkl_FdEqfQTgy1duW3Or3oMw5P) Because the truth of it is, the legal bills are already overwhelming. And we haven’t even gotten to trial! Anthony and his wife have already drained almost their entire life’s savings fighting to free him. So any amount you can give today will help. And because LELDF is a non-profit organization, your gift is completely tax-deductible. [**_But whatever you can afford to give, I'm asking you to please make your gift today._**](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjUwMTd9AAwAAAAAA0rQxyszIPSS6gEnvHlZWlX9ssosuslGp3rORaHMG9CB_9FWe0B2z4Ci-kGbcpzceVWTJoj5NS7dYo5cmMWgKmsNxHSpFv08r3xgdoMD) After the four decades serving his community, the cancer, and the injuries from his attack, Anthony deserves to spend his retirement years in peace with his family -- NOT locked up behind bars for the rest of his life. But that’s exactly what will happen unless friends like you step up on his behalf. Thank you for taking the time to read my email today. **[Thank you in advance for making your tax-deductible gift to help Anthony fight to clear his name.](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjUwMTd9AAwAAAAAA0rQxys0fxoqGGr1BKWe5iPXmYiaINj_igGnw0J_Vib5EdoOB5kCkMCsN8piQSKzgYRYlZ859BT8IyExEjyhx-VtCCxUlSg6T5rB-RKd)** And please, keep my brother in your prayers.
---
**_Frank DeLustro_**
---
P.S. Anthony didn’t know it at the time, but the road-rage maniac who attacked him had a criminal record. Maybe that’s why he was so eager to flee the scene after my brother arrested him. **[Please help save Anthony from spending the rest of his life behind bars. Make a tax-deductible gift of any amount to the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund right away.](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjUwMTd9AAwAAAAAA0rQxys1ytcuwarPz0UcPJ9EcSMOc5hDo_DI6kDalJhguXY3vchZLymAgMxZrnOmUU61lqRphpBIqgPjGNmImYuEK3rgFY4rlLzsS_t7)**

When I got the call that Anthony had been assaulted and was in the hospital with serious injuries, I couldn’t believe what had happened. I was so relieved he was alive. But my relief turned into shock when my brother was arrested and charged with murder. He hadn’t even recovered from his injuries when the local prosecutor dragged him in front of a judge and had him locked up in jail. He’s already spent 10 months behind bars. And he’s facing up to 30 years in prison. My friend, Anthony is 64 years old. If he’s convicted... ...he’ll likely spend the rest of his life locked up--and die in prison--for defending himself. | | | Because what they’re doing to Anthony is an outrage. I might not be a cop...but to me, if a police officer puts you under arrest, you don’t resist. And you certainly don’t physically attack the officer, then try to flee the scene. My brother may have been off duty. But you know that as an off-duty officer, he had the authority--and even the responsibility--to make an arrest to protect the public. What does this prosecutor expect off-duty officers to do--just let angry, violent offenders beat them up, resist arrest, and then walk away like nothing happened? | | | | | My friend, Anthony doesn’t deserve this. He’s a good man who’s well-respected by his fellow officers. He served as a cop for four decades and never once faced discipline. He has a spotless record full of awards and commendations. So to watch my brother’s life be torn apart like this is just heartbreaking. It’s been hard on his family too. Several years ago, Anthony and his wife took their two granddaughters into their home. They’ve been raising them ever since. You can imagine the pain it’s caused these poor girls to have their grandfather locked up and treated like a common criminal. My friend, we were almost out of hope. And then we found out about the LawEnforcement Legal Defense Fund. You know the LELDF is a national group that’s helped dozens of innocent officers clear their names when they’re wrongly accused by radical prosecutors. And they’ve agreed to help Anthony too. Not only are they getting my brother the legal defense he deserves -- they’re also raising money to pay for the best attorneys and expert witnesses available. Which brings me to the reason I wrote you today: Because the truth of it is, the legal bills are already overwhelming. And we haven’t even gotten to trial! Anthony and his wife have already drained almost their entire life’s savings fighting to free him. So any amount you can give today will help. And because LELDF is a non-profit organization, your gift is completely tax-deductible. After the four decades serving his community, the cancer, and the injuries from his attack, Anthony deserves to spend his retirement years in peace with his family -- NOT locked up behind bars for the rest of his life. But that’s exactly what will happen unless friends like you step up on his behalf. Thank you for taking the time to read my email today. And please, keep my brother in your prayers. Frank DeLustro P.S. Anthony didn’t know it at the time, but the road-rage maniac who attacked him had a criminal record. Maybe that’s why he was so eager to flee the scene after my brother arrested him. | | | | | | ---|---|---|--- © Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund | 2560 Huntington Ave. Suite 203, Alexandria, VA, 22303 |

body:
Here’s where our Must-Flip and Must-Hold Senate races stand right now.
#
Hi there,
With less than five weeks until Election Day, today we want to give you very brief updates on where things stand across Swing Left’s Must-Win races for the United States Senate.
**Overall, Democrats have a chance to flip the chamber this November, but taking back the majority will come down to razor-thin margins in several key battlegrounds:**
**Alaska (Must-Flip)**
Democratic nominee Mary Peltola is polling five points ahead of Republican opponent Dan Sullivan, and looking at recent election results in Alaska, we expect this race to be extremely close once all the votes are cast.
**Iowa (Must-Flip)**
A recent poll shows Democratic nominee Josh Turek leading his opponent Ashley Hinson by eight points, but just a few days ago Senate Republicans’ Super PAC announced an additional $20 million in spending to support Hinson and drown out Turek’s message.
**Maine (Must-Flip)**
Despite one recent poll putting Republican Susan Collins ahead, Democrat Troy Jackson continues to lead most polls in Maine by three to four points in this critical race for Senate control.
**North Carolina (Must-Flip)**
Former North Carolina Governor Roy Cooper holds a double-digit lead over Republican Michael Whatley, despite Donald Trump recently campaigning in North Carolina to boost Whatley as Republicans fight to hold onto the critical Senate seat.
**Ohio (Must-Flip)**
With Democrat Sherrod Brown leading in multiple recent polls, a cryptocurrency super PAC funded primarily by Trump-aligned billionaires announced a few days ago it would pour nearly $3 million into the Ohio Senate race to boost Republican incumbent Jon Husted.
**Texas (Must-Flip)**
James Talarico represents Democrats’ best chance at winning a Texas Senate seat in nearly 40 years, which is why Republican super PACs, including President Trump’s, have spent or reserved more than $119 million in ad campaigns to boost his opponent Ken Paxton.
**Georgia (Must-Hold)**
Incumbent Democratic Senator Jon Ossoff holds a four-point lead over Republican challenger Mike Collins in Georgia’s high-stakes Senate race—but for Ossoff to win, we need to ensure enough voters turn out on Election Day.
**Michigan (Must-Hold)**
Democrat Abdul El-Sayed just had his largest polling lead yet with a seven-point advantage over Republican Mike Rogers in the Michigan Senate race, an open battleground seat that could decide control of the U.S. Senate.
**New Hampshire (Must-Hold)**
Democrat Chris Pappas has opened a slight lead over Republican John E. Sununu in New Hampshire, holding his ground against tens of millions in GOP dark money attacks.
All of these races will be decided by narrow margins. While winning the Senate majority is within Democrats’ reach this November, we can’t take a single vote for granted.
That is why the Swing Left community is both donating directly to these candidates _and_ working to have thousands of Ground Truth conversations with the voters who will decide these races before Election Day.
But running a get-out-the-vote campaign in each of these states takes serious resources. With less than 5 weeks to go, your support can help give these candidates the boost they need in this final stretch.

Your donation will go to support all nine of these Senate candidates and the work Swing Left is doing through Ground Truth to help turn out the vote in swing districts and states across the country.
Thank you for everything you’re doing to build durable governing power for Democrats this year and beyond.
— The Swing Left Team

**Since 2017, Swing Left has channeled the energy of grassroots volunteers and donors to elect Democrats, up and down the ballot, focusing on the most competitive races that can swing the national balance of power.** Right now, Swing Left is investing in grassroots organizing in key swing districts and initiatives across the country to flip the House and win the Senate and critical states in 2026. | | **_Meet Russell:_** Born and raised in Surfside Beach, SC, Congressman Russell Fry is the proud and homegrown Representative for South Carolina’s 7th Congressional District. Growing up in a cinder block home with no heating or air conditioning, Russell learned at an early age that hard work and perseverance pave the only true path to the American Dream. He watched his parents work day in and day out to make ends meet. And the values they instilled in him during his upbringing led Russell to self-fund both his undergraduate education at the University of South Carolina, and later his law studies at the Charleston School of Law. At Charleston, Russell served as the President of the Student Bar Association and even helped the school achieve its American Bar Association accreditation. He went on to practice law in the Grand Strand area for over a decade before entering the political arena to serve in the South Carolina House of Representatives for State House District 106 (Horry County). During his seven-year tenure in the SC House, Russell fought to safeguard Constitutional liberties, lower taxes, and put the best interests of South Carolina families above all else. He climbed the ranks to become Chief Majority Whip, and also chaired the House Opioid Prevention Study Committee. Under Russell’s leadership, 18 policy initiatives to combat the opioid crisis were signed into law. Since the first day he stepped foot in Washington, Russell has strived to shake up the corrupt status quo and deliver real change for the American people. He believes adamantly that so long as the American people stand united, we can keep the American Dream alive for every citizen of our great nation. Russell is a dedicated husband to his wife, Bronwen, and a loving father to his son, James. The family lives in Murrells Inlet with their chocolate lab, Jasper.

And thank you for being a PATRIOT, Fry Campaign HQ | | | = | | | Meet Russell: Born and raised in Surfside Beach, SC, Congressman Russell Fry is the proud and homegrown Representative for South Carolina’s 7th Congressional District. Growing up in a cinder block home with no heating or air conditioning, Russell learned at an early age that hard work and perseverance pave the only true path to the American Dream. He watched his parents work day in and day out to make ends meet. And the values they instilled in him during his upbringing led Russell to self-fund both his undergraduate education at the University of South Carolina, and later his law studies at the Charleston School of Law. At Charleston, Russell served as the President of the Student Bar Association and even helped the school achieve its American Bar Association accreditation. He went on to practice law in the Grand Strand area for over a decade before entering the political arena to serve in the South Carolina House of Representatives for State House District 106 (Horry County). During his seven-year tenure in the SC House, Russell fought to safeguard Constitutional liberties, lower taxes, and put the best interests of South Carolina families above all else. He climbed the ranks to become Chief Majority Whip, and also chaired the House Opioid Prevention Study Committee. Under Russell’s leadership, 18 policy initiatives to combat the opioid crisis were signed into law. Since the first day he stepped foot in Washington, Russell has strived to shake up the corrupt status quo and deliver real change for the American people. He believes adamantly that so long as the American people stand united, we can keep the American Dream alive for every citizen of our great nation. Russell is a dedicated husband to his wife, Bronwen, and a loving father to his son, James. Peter,
_**For 45 days, a 12-year-old girl lived through a nightmare no child should ever experience.** _ She had been trafficked, drugged, abused, and held against her will in a homeless encampment in California. **For 45 days, it seemed as if everyone had forsaken her.** **For 45 days, she suffered a living hell.** **For 45 days, she endured untold horrors.** [ _**Then came Day 46. That was the day our team at Heroes for Humanity went in and brought her out.** _ ](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=d5e6b0fa6f3e40d18d94058a6e078b5f&_e=n5z2DICl-EL9WbsF7iJFeTv5VXZ0TolsgETb-EB955lrbfYeV8zvusoidl_1PDL2apwQsmLUzUjsAD3mnWAWK8CFaBksOmK_vOHMk6Rbx5M3TpT8Eul99daegBj5pKK1vrY-qry9sn4SO7uGGQsJpPUqZHhGIK1sp6b7bAuzdWVwIRj2NRXCt2I0Aq5u1IMNHurH6xj456bhILikNR_2NNVIErC-TTRW7JjYZ8VeXJamRHfw2-q1XGJRCL7FmlWXHCyaFIkVzQng2DJoG-oeGwqpmRrMMvXDI0mj_0ZgG4qHmLaGPTYzdWnDGvO1zxZcJG1vepOPKYVlcrYO-OV-GwdPqfd3xaRBZf3ifmo_rZX1-RrbG0CExzPWYVCtuFLAZjeYVXkt8GkVv32_EJK4_4zYp8ZRMgqUn5D1-loFoLgRWZg0yYxV6cwgF1eDonNYsyjs5z_Y4baDB6o7UnOFY8u6BvR0irp_2oQoJQ_GFpqQIqaK0xS1Xxx_jNYRC1iTNsyHNN9mQdzPY0BP0c7x5MB_Cp896jzn-GYwKlEteGzwjt_EBYOl7Obix2EH7yhdGZRcGCfz_rwmn5bCHl5TvG6IAoI-t_Ttt5FxSh3AkjwClF6HQynmAcre2cYsOSgyw4QW2IvB1tmSUEA4CmO82OMiRHmoZhjTwAZCJ3Q6Q-62h4T9ymwqS_plUiTb_DyqA4MGQ7plUFkIowEuHkZ-hA%3D%3D)
My name is Dennis Price, and I want to tell you why I'm sharing her story with you today. I believe God puts people in our path for a reason. Sometimes He calls us to pray. Sometimes He calls us to give. And sometimes He puts someone in front of us who desperately needs help, and then the Lord asks, “Who will go?” I have spent more than 19 years across various special operations units and private military contracting, and now I serve as a humanitarian and evangelist. I've seen suffering most people thankfully never will. I started Heroes for Humanity during the collapse in Afghanistan, watching Americans and vetted Afghan allies get hunted while the systems built to get them out failed completely. A small team and I helped rescue dozens of them. **That crucible proved how powerful it can be when good people refuse to look the other way.** We’ve carried that mission to all corners of the world, including responding to devastating earthquakes in Venezuela and Colombia this summer and the deadly Texas Hill Country floods last year. Our team is made up of veteran special operators, first responders, medical professionals, and everyday heroes who are willing to go into the places others can’t – or won’t – to rescue people in desperate need. [ _**For that little girl, it meant getting her out of an unimaginable situation and bringing her home.** _ ](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=d5e6b0fa6f3e40d18d94058a6e078b5f&_e=n5z2DICl-EL9WbsF7iJFeTv5VXZ0TolsgETb-EB955lrbfYeV8zvusoidl_1PDL2apwQsmLUzUjsAD3mnWAWK8CFaBksOmK_vOHMk6Rbx5M3TpT8Eul99daegBj5pKK1vrY-qry9sn4SO7uGGQsJpPUqZHhGIK1sp6b7bAuzdWVwIRj2NRXCt2I0Aq5u1IMNHurH6xj456bhILikNR_2NNVIErC-TTRW7JjYZ8VeXJamRHfw2-q1XGJRCL7FmlWXaXYgQEbJy0ZJuOuol5ZzYh1yltNc4DIKUwy9yaRPzQcv5ad3wZDcsEAyeYhcB-Kd2gqK6JyBpwwaIcY8QU8MmXqg4qEVCCJPb-n5hCe5or9mR0lwMsN9QnJCYZwu9o4YGO02_WbU2fhvT9IqzdTyaopEi5ZDdY6b3VPng5F31cbU1z5TIQUUpfHksCmzpLSMjtOIB5nec5VbRbvbttUTPVAk0mMqbxgY86Z4ak_cClwtLEbNi59SW37HM41JhkfepKnn1TUhHTBZd2rwWDHmecAulzcyuc5BDSrdXzLz5GKOOHPklVIBNI6hgf42BdQW9auPY-7rNkItvM4bW2yk-htbG94jGJrR7GH-mKWWONfeZBVxM5WHdSgI-op7_hxji8ay5Q0vKjrW94GMD2lU0t0BD4cibj4pwNfVs5BetMVhIH44xGN8Uhfp41cHLvK9KzaKqlvuh3NWkqKmFwR2xQ%3D%3D) In other cases, it could mean delivering lifesaving aid after a natural disaster, pulling families from a warzone, or simply being there on the worst day of someone’s life and reminding them that they have not been forgotten. But we can't wait until the next desperate call comes to get ready. Our operators have to be trained. Our equipment has to be ready. Vehicles need fuel. Medical supplies need to be stocked. Because when someone is waiting for their “Day 46,” every minute matters. **So, I’m asking you to do something today.** [ _**Will you make a gift of $10, $25, $50, or whatever you can afford to Heroes for Humanity?** _ ](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=d5e6b0fa6f3e40d18d94058a6e078b5f&_e=n5z2DICl-EL9WbsF7iJFeTv5VXZ0TolsgETb-EB955lrbfYeV8zvusoidl_1PDL2apwQsmLUzUjsAD3mnWAWK8CFaBksOmK_vOHMk6Rbx5M3TpT8Eul99daegBj5pKK1vrY-qry9sn4SO7uGGQsJpPUqZHhGIK1sp6b7bAuzdWVwIRj2NRXCt2I0Aq5u1IMNHurH6xj456bhILikNR_2NNVIErC-TTRW7JjYZ8VeXJamRHfw2-q1XGJRCL7FmlWX3xBaMCO1sp3KfNUoBbMJPsK5I7tjnZSN8-5wnwRL03a_zWTpUTtTtStxPu3U2cl7P6h06PEMBYjeSUXkXpeez14J04zyL3NG89lyy46f0YgpFxh9EFwSpVJmdlbGcrRU23m0hAOrzPREcpo9GDGUKlQwxGKO1K76E2IBB7067mLX1GaK75hKI9DEfGQwAh_Q2Tg0RAoqpTUzpLQ0IDA5SgYJLxwQac7LbrZad854zI5s-VmPR5mUPfw_sF2va0kd2QOk1L2ZZKTSlplicOugzHE5ETSiz4nFFNaWQz8wBO_errjnVTdgPWh2FqbAiYj4L195gecEmABM64M0x5o4Dtnpa5MklRVOIXk8LeeJUGdayXQqwEjCQt9UBK4jUGe_eDI75-n9EEjIDjO40UKLacoOM00l-ITZmmFT2oITtqDhAZFXP1S_M5MMKG5u0DPaPjZucxSHNAFFqJ-tAd7Uzg%3D%3D) You may never be the person who physically walks into danger to bring someone home, but you can empower someone else to be that person. clean_body: For 45 days, she was alone and abandoned. | | | | | Peter, For 45 days, a 12-year-old girl lived through a nightmare no child should ever experience. She had been trafficked, drugged, abused, and held against her will in a homeless encampment in California. For 45 days, it seemed as if everyone had forsaken her. For 45 days, she suffered a living hell. For 45 days, she endured untold horrors. My name is Dennis Price, and I want to tell you why I'm sharing her story with you today. I believe God puts people in our path for a reason. Sometimes He calls us to pray. Sometimes He calls us to give. And sometimes He puts someone in front of us who desperately needs help, and then the Lord asks, “Who will go?” I have spent more than 19 years across various special operations units and private military contracting, and now I serve as a humanitarian and evangelist. I've seen suffering most people thankfully never will. I started Heroes for Humanity during the collapse in Afghanistan, watching Americans and vetted Afghan allies get hunted while the systems built to get them out failed completely. A small team and I helped rescue dozens of them. That crucible proved how powerful it can be when good people refuse to look the other way. We’ve carried that mission to all corners of the world, including responding to devastating earthquakes in Venezuela and Colombia this summer and the deadly Texas Hill Country floods last year. Our team is made up of veteran special operators, first responders, medical professionals, and everyday heroes who are willing to go into the places others can’t – or won’t – to rescue people in desperate need. In other cases, it could mean delivering lifesaving aid after a natural disaster, pulling families from a warzone, or simply being there on the worst day of someone’s life and reminding them that they have not been forgotten. But we can't wait until the next desperate call comes to get ready. Our operators have to be trained. Our equipment has to be ready. Vehicles need fuel. Medical supplies need to be stocked. Because when someone is waiting for their “Day 46,” every minute matters. So, I’m asking you to do something today. You may never be the person who physically walks into danger to bring someone home, but you can empower someone else to be that person. **Friday, October 2, 2026 -**_****_
_**Iran** : U.S. sending third carrier, up to 10,000 more troops to Middle East. U.S. deploys Patriot batteries to Saudi Arabia, Qatar. Treasury issues new round of sanctions on Iran's auto and rail sectors. Iran strikes fifth tanker in Hormuz within three days. Gulf oil exports double since early August. UK-Iranian national arrested over RAF Fairford incident._
_**Yemen** : Saudi-led coalition accuses Ansarallah of attack on power station serving holy city of Medina. President Donald Trump says Saudi Arabia "wouldn't be here" without him as defense chiefs hold call._
_**Palestine:** Israeli fire wounds three Palestinians in Khan Younis, including child. Israeli forces and settlers continue to attack olive harvesters across the occupied West Bank. Over 2,000 Israeli attacks on Palestinians in West Bank in September. Gaza families bury 105 Palestinians nearly three years after Israeli massacre. Hamas denies Israeli report on rebuilding military capabilities. Jared Kushner firm holds $1 billion stake in Israeli company invested in Gaza war suppliers._
_**Lebanon:** Israeli forces carry out strikes, demolitions and shelling across south Lebanon amid "ceasefire."_
_**U.S.:** Supreme Court to hear challenge to Trump's mandatory immigration detention policy. South Korea denies finalizing funding for Trump's Alaska pipeline. Trump administration diverts $52M from Europe, Iraq to Latin America. Microsoft-linked NJ data center ran unpermitted generators for nearly a year, emitting hundreds of tons of pollution. Trump meme coin firm offers "most exclusive dinner" to top holders, raising fresh ethics concerns. Housing Finance agency guts its own inspector general._
_**International:** Eritrea severs diplomatic ties with Ethiopia. Ethiopian government-allied force claims to have wiped out TPLF forces in Tigray. U.S. waives human rights conditions for $320 million in aid to Egypt after the country's "helpful role" in Iran war. Brazilian President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva and his rival Flavio Bolsonaro skip final debate ahead of Sunday vote. Supreme Court bomb scare proves false alarm. Ousted Sudanese President Omar Al-Bashir, 82, wanted for genocide, needs treatment abroad. Russian President Vladimir Putin rules out ceasefire on long-range strikes, reiterates nuclear threat over Kaliningrad. India's "cockroach" party renews protests, demands election commissioner's resignation over voter roll dispute. Hundreds of schools remain closed in France as student protests grow._
**This is Drop Site Daily, our free news recap We send it Monday - Friday**

* * *
# Iran
* **U.S. sending third carrier, up to 10,000 more troops to Middle East:** The Pentagon is [deploying](https://substack.com/redirect/328dbd70-60bb-49c6-b7d9-814c1c4d49d3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) a third aircraft carrier strike group, the USS Theodore Roosevelt, to the Middle East, officials told the Wall Street Journal.
* The fleet reportedly left San Diego Sunday, alongside the USS Makin Island Amphibious Ready Group. The latter will carry Marines from the 13th Marine Expeditionary Unit, adding 9,000 to 10,000 troops to a region that already has more than 50,000 U.S. personnel.
* These additional U.S. forces are expected to arrive in the region by the end of November. President Donald Trump reportedly told aides he expects to resume bombing Iran that same month.
* **U.S. deploys Patriot batteries to Saudi Arabia, Qatar:** The U.S. military [sent](https://substack.com/redirect/c6a8d3b8-b1e5-4382-9ca0-c823fa94e172?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) two additional Patriot missile-defense batteries to Saudi Arabia and Qatar to protect key oil and gas facilities against potential Iranian retaliation if Trump resumes major strikes on Iran, Axios reported.
* The deployments come as Trump said Thursday he was considering renewed attacks in the coming weeks. "Now I have to make a decision: either Iran signs the deal, or it won't exist any longer," Trump said.
* **Treasury issues new round of sanctions on Iran 's auto and rail sectors:** The Treasury Department [announced](https://substack.com/redirect/4508467c-3d4f-4b76-8904-4bdabc43d8b8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) sanctions on Iran's rail and auto sectors and their foreign suppliers as part of Operation Economic Outcast.
* The sanctions affect Iran's two premier automotive companies, Iran Khodro and SAIPA, which together account for over 90% of the country's domestic market, as well as Iran's state-owned Islamic Republic of Iran Railway Company and two major passenger and freight rail firms.
* The new round of sanctions also targets foreign firms that supply Iran's auto companies, with affected firms in Indonesia, the UAE, and Turkey.
* **Iran strikes fifth tanker in Hormuz within three days:** Iran [appears](https://substack.com/redirect/0641f294-f3a1-401d-95e8-4caf0cd96ab6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to have struck a fifth tanker in less than three days, according to recent incident reports from United Kingdom Maritime Trade Operations.
* Between the evening of September 28 and October 1, five vessels were reported "struck by projectiles" while transiting the Strait of Hormuz, the British maritime security body said.
* IRGC adviser Ali Balil claimed on Thursday that Iran achieved a longstanding goal of using a long-range ballistic missile to strike a moving target. Belali said the capability had been demonstrated "in the past few days," without identifying the target or providing further details.
* **Gulf oil exports double since early August:** Oil exports from the Persian Gulf and Gulf of Oman [reached](https://substack.com/redirect/bd5e897d-46ec-4c8f-a26d-ee6cd6023655?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) a seven-day average of around 20 million barrels per day, roughly double the early August amount, with Strait of Hormuz transits driving the rebound, according to Kpler data.
* The seven-day average of regional exports climbed from about 10 to 12 million barrels per day in early August to a peak of roughly 22 million in late September. Daily volumes briefly topped 27 million around September 19.
* Trump told reporters on Thursday the U.S. may ask European countries to release diesel reserves as U.S. diesel hit $6.53 per gallon.
* **UK-Iranian national arrested over RAF Fairford incident:** UK counter-terrorism police [arrested](https://substack.com/redirect/e4c895d4-8d58-4816-bec6-393ae9d2dff1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) a 25-year-old British-Iranian dual national in London on suspicion of preparing terrorist acts in connection with Sunday's incident near RAF Fairford, a U.S. Air Force-operated base.
* Five British men arrested near the base remain on police bail after gas, but no explosive devices, was found in vehicles.
* Police said they are investigating "all possible angles," including potential foreign-state involvement. Iran has strongly denied involvement.
* RAF Fairford has recently been used by U.S. bombers after Britain approved its use for strikes on Iran.

# Yemen
* **Saudi-led coalition accuses Ansarallah of attack on power station serving holy city of Medina:** The Saudi-led coalition [accused](https://substack.com/redirect/0b65b34c-2b51-4bec-bb71-69a2aa0247fe?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Yemen's Ansarallah of carrying out a drone attack on the Taiba electricity distribution station in Islam's holy city of Medina, on September 29, saying an investigation and drone debris indicated the group was responsible.
* The attack knocked one transformer out of service but did not disrupt the electricity grid. The coalition previously accused Ansarallah of attempting to target Mecca, another Islamic holy site, allegations the group has denied.
* This comes amid continued fighting in Yemen. Saudi-backed government forces [said](https://substack.com/redirect/e4a430d5-8c66-4a59-9aaf-135ceef7efe0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) they carried out 20 air strikes over three hours targeting Ansarallah reinforcements across several fronts in Taiz, claiming the strikes destroyed military equipment and caused casualties. Government forces also said they downed Ansarallah drones over Aden and hit targets in the Ansarallah-held capital of Sana'a.
* Six people were killed and 35 wounded in overnight clashes between Ansarallah and government forces in residential areas of eastern Taiz, according to The Associated Press.
* **Trump says Saudi Arabia "wouldn't be here" without him as defense chiefs hold call: **Trump said Saudi Arabia "wouldn't be here right now" without him, claiming in a [Time magazine](https://substack.com/redirect/df263d89-3bd7-4f5b-9cdc-92ed1bda7eaf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) interview that both the kingdom and Israel would otherwise have been "wiped off the face of the planet." Trump said his relationship with Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman remained "very good" and emphasized that the U.S. protects Saudi Arabia despite recent reporting that Trump denied MBS's request to enter its war against Ansarallah.
* Saudi Defense Minister Khalid bin Salman held a phone call with U.S. War Secretary Pete Hegseth on Thursday to discuss the U.S.-Saudi defense coordination, according to the Saudi Press Agency. More than 100 U.S. military advisers are [reportedly](https://substack.com/redirect/1eaefb78-18f5-4d3c-8ccf-698cf0c5db88?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in Saudi Arabia providing intelligence, geospatial targeting support and battlefield technology for the kingdom's campaign against Ansarallah in Yemen.

# Palestine
* **Israeli fire wounds three Palestinians in Khan Younis, including child:** Two Palestinians, including an elderly woman, were [wounded](https://substack.com/redirect/22b5542b-083e-4495-afec-9f7419fb1ffb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) by Israeli fire in Khan Younis early Friday, while a child was shot as Israeli forces fired toward tents east of Hamad City, according to WAFA.
* Civil Defense crews also recovered remains of a Palestinian killed in an Israeli drone strike in southern Gaza overnight.
* **Israeli forces and settlers continue to attack olive harvesters across the occupied West Bank:**
* **Nablus:** Three Palestinians were [injured](https://substack.com/redirect/88a3a814-44c8-41cd-9945-3fb16fdd6a56?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) as Israeli settlers, backed by Israeli forces, attacked olive harvesters in Beita, Jamma'in, Urif, Asira al-Qibliya, Beit Furik, and Deir Sharaf on Friday, WAFA reported.
* Israeli forces also fired stun grenades and tear gas at Palestinian farmers and foreign solidarity activists.
* In a separate attack in Beita, settlers opened live fire toward farmers harvesting olives in the Jabal Al-Arma area, with no injuries reported.
* **Salfit:** Israeli forces and settlers [prevented](https://substack.com/redirect/1fa65f87-1e2c-4079-9777-fe14fd5296fa?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) farmers from harvesting olives west of Deir Istiya and forced others off their land in Farkha and Haris. Israeli forces also detained three farmers while they were harvesting olives on their land.
* **Bethlehem:** Israeli settlers [broke](https://substack.com/redirect/031a364f-8058-47af-b369-9acc493d26aa?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) a number of olive trees belonging to a Palestinian resident in the Abu Njeim area, southeast of Bethlehem.
* **Jenin:** Israeli forces [arrested](https://substack.com/redirect/b94ac90a-a725-4ebf-963e-2939f66db698?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) a Palestinian after raiding and searching homes in Zababdeh, south of Jenin, and detained dozens of Palestinian workers in Barta'a, southwest of the city.
* **Ramallah:** Israeli settlers, accompanied by Israeli forces, [attacked](https://substack.com/redirect/2c1ddc07-a347-49a4-851c-c3de6c9e93cf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) homes south of Al-Mughayyir, northeast of Ramallah, and stole a vehicle from the outskirts of the village.
* **Over 2,000 Israeli attacks on Palestinians in West Bank in September:** Israeli forces and settlers carried out over 2,000 attacks against Palestinians and their land and property in the month of September in the occupied West Bank, [according](https://substack.com/redirect/413c7560-f1e8-447d-9ed6-d1d1312caad8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to the Wall and Settlement Resistance Commission.
* 1,404 of the attacks were carried out by Israeli military forces and 647 by Israeli settlers, while Ramallah and Al-Bireh recorded the most attacks.
* Settler attacks killed three Palestinians, bringing the total number of Palestinians killed by settlers in 2026 to 29.
* Attacks also damaged 14,600 trees, including 9,334 olive trees.
* **Gaza families bury 105 Palestinians nearly three years after Israeli massacre:** Hundreds gathered in Gaza City on Thursday for the mass funeral of 105 Palestinians killed on October 25, 2023, when Israeli forces dropped at least 20 bombs on the Al-Taj residential block and surrounding buildings in Yarmouk Square.
* Journalist Mahmoud Haniyeh, whose wife, journalist Doaa Sharaf, and their one-year-old son Obaida were killed in the Israeli attack, held up the child's belongings. "This is his baby bottle. This is his toy. And that is his shroud. I want to ask the world: What threat did this pose to Israel?" Haniyeh asked.
* Some 8,000 victims remain beneath destroyed buildings across Gaza, Civil Defense spokesperson Mahmoud Basal told Drop Site's Mohamed Ahmed. Basal called for the entry of equipment and logistical support needed to recover them. "If things remain as they are, we are talking about many years in which these families will remain beneath the rubble."
* **Watch the dispatch from Mohamed Ahmed[here](https://substack.com/redirect/be8c2bd6-2f52-47cc-a477-90dfe05c35c7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and [here](https://substack.com/redirect/230fe8ce-d949-4976-a77c-d00bd0abc299?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).**
* **Hamas denies Israeli report on rebuilding military capabilities:** Hamas denied an Israeli Channel 12 report claiming the group is accelerating efforts to rebuild its military apparatus, repair tunnels, and continue smuggling operations in Gaza. Spokesperson Hazem Qassem called the report "false" and said it was intended to justify continuing the war and cover up Israeli ceasefire violations.
* Qassem said Hamas remained committed to the ceasefire agreement and urged Trump's "Board of Peace" to adhere to the ceasefire plan and its associated roadmap, warning that providing Israel with "pretexts" would make the Board "a partner in the crimes committed in Gaza."
* **Kushner firm holds $1 billion stake in Israeli company invested in Gaza war suppliers:** Jared Kushner's investment firm is the [largest shareholder](https://substack.com/redirect/665d9b30-fbf6-48fc-9a08-329d6fb614cc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in an Israeli financial company with at least $456 million invested in nine firms supplying Israel's military, CNN reported.
* Kushner's Affinity Partners holds a 7.4% stake in Phoenix Financial--worth over $1 billion. Phoenix's holdings include: $265 million in Elbit Systems, Israel's largest arms maker, $40 million in Reshef Technologies, which makes fuses for shells used in Gaza, and $68 million in Next Vision, which makes cameras for military drones.
* Phoenix also holds stakes in Caterpillar, whose D9 bulldozers are used by the Israeli military to ethnically cleanse communities in Gaza, other parts of occupied Palestine, and Lebanon.
* Kushner sits on the Board of Peace overseeing Gaza and Trump's "peace" plan. The White House called the conflict-of-interest concerns a "tired narrative."

# U.S. News
* **Supreme Court to hear challenge to Trump 's mandatory immigration detention policy:** The Supreme Court [agreed](https://substack.com/redirect/47e2f736-f4b3-4951-9bfa-80744f676270?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Thursday to hear the Trump administration's appeal of a 2nd Circuit ruling against a July 2025 DHS policy subjecting millions of immigrants in deportation proceedings to mandatory detention without bond hearings.
* The case, involving Brazilian national **Ricardo Aparecido Barbosa da Cunha** , who was denied a bond hearing after his September 2025 arrest in Massachusetts, will be argued in the court's new term beginning Monday.
* The policy has sparked more than 73,000 lawsuits--roughly a quarter of all federal civil cases filed this year--and judges have ruled over 4,400 times that detentions under the policy were unlawful, according to analysis from Reuters.
* **South Korea denies finalizing funding for Trump 's Alaska pipeline:** South Korea [pushed back](https://substack.com/redirect/3e7df5c5-8bcf-4f4c-9b8c-9c8da34014e7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on President Trump's Oval Office announcement claiming Seoul had committed $54 billion to a long-stalled LNG pipeline in Alaska, with President **Lee Jae Myung** posting that the project "will proceed to working level under the preconditions that 1) its commercial viability is confirmed and 2) it complies with the legal procedures of the Republic of Korea," and the Korean government issuing a statement saying only that the two countries "have agreed to begin reviewing the project."
* Trump had made the announcement alongside Republican Alaska Sen. **Dan Sullivan** , who is presently seeking reelection in a contested race. Trump claimed that Sullivan was "totally responsible for this pipeline" and explicitly tied the funding push to Sullivan's electoral prospects.
* **Trump administration diverts $52M from Europe, Iraq to Latin America:** The Trump administration [defied](https://substack.com/redirect/6ce24427-d98e-4d23-a027-5d974812c566?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) a hold placed by Sen. **Jeanne Shaheen**(D-N.H.) and Rep. **Gregory Meeks** (D-N.Y.), notifying Congress late Wednesday that it would move forward with diverting $52 million in military assistance originally approved for Slovakia, North Macedonia, Tunisia, and Iraq to Panama, Peru, Ecuador, and Colombia instead.
* In a letter to Secretary of State **Marco Rubio** , Shaheen and Meeks said the move violated statutory requirements, noting that the Slovakia and North Macedonia funds came from a Ukraine supplemental bill specifically intended for countries affected by Russia's invasion.
* The State Department defended the reallocation as consistent with the National Security Strategy's focus on the Western Hemisphere, saying it would "combat narco-terrorism" and help "secure the Panama Canal."
* **Microsoft-linked NJ data center ran unpermitted generators for nearly a year, emitting hundreds of tons of pollution:** DataOne, a New Jersey data center with ties to Microsoft that was recently fined $1 million for running unpermitted generators, [operated](https://substack.com/redirect/602c35d8-b756-4c34-a20d-e49655987b6d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) 62 gas-fired generators for more than 46,000 combined hours starting in July 2025 before state regulators intervened, according to reporting from The Guardian.
* An analysis by Rutgers professor **Xiaomeng Jin** estimated the generators emitted about 140 tons of NOx, a class of dangerous, smog-producing gases, enough to rank DataOne among New Jersey's top five NOx polluters in 2025.
* The company's CEO had told a January town hall the site would be "polluting less than a farm."
* **Trump meme coin firm offers "most exclusive dinner" to top holders, raising fresh ethics concerns**: GetTrumpMemes.com, the firm behind Trump's "$TRUMP" meme coin, [launched](https://substack.com/redirect/1f44176b-a184-4aec-bdea-ec3d1de6e09c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) a new competition Wednesday promising its 185 largest coin holders an invitation to a gala "evening with 3 Legends and President Donald J. Trump," with the top 29 purchasers getting a VIP reception and the top four receiving an 18-karat Trump-branded gold watch.
* Trump has earned $635 million from the meme coin since it was created last year, part of $1.4 billion in disclosed earnings from business ventures in 2025; purchasers of the coin have collectively lost an estimated $4.7 billion, according to the watchdog group Public Citizen.
* **Housing Finance agency guts its own inspector general:** **Bill Pulte** , the director of the Federal Housing Finance Agency, [announced](https://substack.com/redirect/6721591a-1b79-4a15-bcee-7e6edf76212a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) plans to cut staffing at agency's inspector general office by 70-80% in fiscal year 2027, which staff told Congress would force the office to "discontinue essentially all criminal investigations" and effectively "wind down its operations."
* The move follows the November removal of the agency's acting inspector general **Joe Allen** after Democrats had asked him to investigate Pulte's "troubling and unprecedented politicization" of the agency's investigative powers against Trump's perceived political enemies, including Sen. **Adam Schiff** and New York Attorney General **Letitia James**.
* **Treasury releases rules for nation 's first federal school voucher program**: The Treasury Department [released](https://substack.com/redirect/f3c2a674-d6c3-477e-837d-e8a125152735?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) rules Thursday governing the Federal Scholarship Tax Credit, the first federally funded school voucher program, which offers taxpayers up to $1,700 in reimbursement for every dollar donated to "scholarship-granting organizations," which will then pass along the money to families. It is projected to cost $26 billion in lost federal revenue over 10 years.
* States have until January 1 to opt in, with 30 mostly Republican-led states already announcing their intention to join in the program.
* American Federation of Teachers President **Randi Weingarten** urged governors to reject the program, calling it "a poison pill for the 90% of American children who attend public schools."
* **Senators respond to Collins corruption allegations:** A ProPublica investigation published on September 22 found that the Department of Justice's public corruption unit, just before it was gutted by President Donald Trump, was circling Maine Republican Senator **Susan Collins** after her campaign solicited illegal contributions from a Hawaii-based defense contractor.
* The company, Navatek, sent $150,000 to Collins's super PAC through a shell company; $32 million in federal contracts were funneled to the company shortly after.
* Drop Site's Julian Andreone asked senators on Capitol Hill about this reporting. **His interviews are available[here](https://substack.com/redirect/fb46805b-797c-4391-ae4f-a6a6c5179ce9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).**

# Other International News
* **Eritrea severs diplomatic ties with Ethiopia:** Eritrea [announced](https://substack.com/redirect/fb18f54c-9518-47b4-80c8-d7f768c8aff9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Thursday it is breaking diplomatic relations with Ethiopia after Addis Ababa expelled 10 Eritrean diplomats, including the charge d'affaires, declaring them personae non gratae because they had participated in "activities that pose a direct threat to Ethiopia's national security."
* Eritrea's foreign ministry called Ethiopia's accusations "astounding," countering that "it is Ethiopia which has been pursuing an agenda of incessant hostility" and accusing Addis Ababa of waging war to gain Red Sea access and training Eritrean opposition groups.
* Ethiopia separately expelled an Egyptian diplomat; Egypt reciprocated by expelling an Ethiopian embassy official in Cairo. Addis Ababa has accused Eritrea, Sudan, and Egypt of backing the opposition alliance, led by the Tigray People's Liberation Front, now fighting its federal forces.
* **Ethiopian government-allied force claims to have wiped out TPLF forces in Tigray:** A commander in the Tigray Peace Forces, which is allied with Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed's government, [declared](https://substack.com/redirect/2d96556d-cbef-4194-bf58-81cfed13f829?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) late Thursday that TPLF forces had been "wiped out" from the province as government forces closed in on the regional capital, according to Reuters.
* The TPLF acknowledged federal forces had occupied parts of the region but said his forces would "counter-attack in due course."
* **U.S. waives human rights conditions for $320 million in aid to Egypt after the country 's "helpful role" in Iran war:** The State Department [waived](https://substack.com/redirect/10a7f7bb-0ca1-4551-b754-3f65b636e3b6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) human rights certification requirements for $320 million in annual military financing to Egypt, citing Cairo's "helpful role" in the U.S.'s war on Iran, according to a September 21 letter to Congress signed by Secretary of State Marco Rubio and reported on by Reuters. The memo did not elaborate on the details of that "help."
* Egypt is the second largest recipient of U.S. military aid in the world, receiving roughly $1.3 billion annually since the 1980s following its 1979 peace treaty with Israel.
* While small portions of aid to Egypt have been withheld in the past, granting a national security waiver to override human rights concerns is now routine. In September 2024, the Biden administration issued a waiver to grant the full $1.3 billion allocation, citing Egypt's assistance to the U.S. around Israel's war on Gaza.
* **Brazil 's Lula, Bolsonaro skip final debate ahead of Sunday vote; Supreme Court bomb scare proves false alarm:** Brazilian President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva and his rival Flavio Bolsonaro both [skipped](https://substack.com/redirect/3a6d5d0a-ce14-4c7e-b837-3a49995188dd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) a planned TV Globo debate Thursday, the last before Sunday's first-round presidential election, with Lula instead appearing on a popular podcast and Bolsonaro blaming "censorship imposed by the electoral court" after a ruling barred the broadcaster from leaving Lula's seat empty onstage. TV Globo said the cancellation stemmed from "legal uncertainty" created by conflicting rulings from Brazil's electoral and supreme courts.
* Brazilian police also arrested a suspect who tried to jump the Supreme Court's fences and threw a backpack onto a bus stop, believing that he may have been carrying an explosive. The backpack contained only personal belongings, authorities said, and the man remains in custody.
* **Congo displacement camp abandoned after military raid, heightening fears of Ebola outbreak:** Thousands of residents [fled](https://substack.com/redirect/d01b2ce1-2d5c-4513-b870-7da2a5c2d7c1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) DRC's Kigonze camp in the Ituri province, home to about 19,000 displaced people, Congolese and UN officials reported on Thursday, after soldiers searching for weapons entered the site last week and clashes broke out. The camp now lies abandoned, officials said, and a facility where Ebola cases were isolated and treated was burned down.
* Health officials said roughly 1,000 Ebola contacts had been living in the camp, and that roughly a fifth of these have been traced since the exodus began.
* Congo's Ebola outbreak has recorded over 4,000 deaths, according to the latest figures, making up nearly half of the 8,300 confirmed cases, in the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak in history.
* **Ousted Sudanese President Bashir, 82, wanted for genocide, needs treatment abroad** : Omar al-Bashir, who ruled Sudan for three decades before being toppled in 2019, has been [transferred](https://substack.com/redirect/1b965099-17dd-4141-8e26-654a927bee58?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) from military custody in Merowe to a military-run hospital in Khartoum for medical tests, his lawyer Mohamed Alhassan Alameen told Reuters on Thursday, saying that symptoms he has exhibited require diagnosis and treatment outside Sudan. His family echoed the calls for him to be transported out of the country, and noted that they had not yet received permission to do so; it remains unclear what condition he is suffering from.
* Bashir, who was convicted on charges of corruption and illicit financing after his ouster in 2019, is wanted by the International Criminal Court on charges of genocide; in addition to these, he faces several open cases in Sudan.
* **Putin rules out ceasefire on long-range strikes, reiterates nuclear threat over Kaliningrad** : Russian President Vladimir Putin [dismissed](https://substack.com/redirect/5e885191-265d-423b-9b69-5b4168ef5923?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) a ceasefire on long-range strikes with Ukraine at Moscow's Valdai forum Thursday, calling the idea "simply ridiculous" days after Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said Kyiv was ready to halt strikes on Russian refineries if Moscow reciprocated on Ukrainian energy infrastructure.
* Putin repeated his warning that Russia would deploy "all the weapons at our country's disposal" if NATO attempted to cut off the Kaliningrad exclave, following a diplomatic note Moscow sent NATO this week threatening nuclear action in such a scenario and cautioned against "the logic of escalating," in which "increasingly harsh retaliatory measures [lead] to a fatal point of no return."
* NATO has not made overt threats to sever Russian access to Kaliningrad though recent military exercises near the territory and naval patrols in the Baltic Sea have raised concerns in Moscow.
* In Putin's speech, he reiterated his preference for ending the war through talks, and for a "neutral Ukraine." He also suggested that, under a "favorable scenario," Russia might return the assets of Western companies which it seized at the beginning of the war.
* **Greece pushes EU to allow asylum suspensions during migration emergencies** : Greece [urged](https://substack.com/redirect/2579d7b3-d0ab-472f-91d4-a9717ade7bba?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) the European Union to let member states temporarily suspend asylum applications during periods of mass migration. The country's Migration Minister, Thanos Plevris, argued at a meeting of interior ministers in Luxembourg that the bloc's migration pact, in effect since June, has "not gone far enough" and that emergencies warrant "enhanced border surveillance and suspension of asylum."
* Plevris was backed by Dutch Migration Minister Bart van den Brink, who argued that recent surges like the July incident in Spain's Ceuta exclave should be "treated as a border management issue rather than an asylum issue."
* Ministers also approved a new regulation allowing member states to establish migrant "return hubs" outside the EU, with recent reports suggesting that the "Group of Five" nations (Greece, the Netherlands, Germany, Austria and Denmark) were considering Rwanda to host such a site.
* **India 's "cockroach" party renews protests, demands election commissioner's resignation over voter roll dispute:** India's Gen Z-led Cockroach Janata Party, alongside a separate coalition of student and activist groups, is [staging](https://substack.com/redirect/ac04ac4b-68ba-4fa6-b7ff-b2b5ac91f03a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) fresh protests Friday in Mumbai and New Delhi, demanding the resignation of Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar over allegations that his commission manipulated voter rolls to favor Prime Minister Narendra Modi's right-wing Bharatiya Janata Party. The commission and government deny the allegations.
* Pressure intensified after India's Indian Express newspaper reported Kumar's two deputies had formally raised concerns at least 14 times over the past 10 months regarding revisions to voter lists and the commission's digital systems.
* The CJP, led by Abhijeet Dipke, gained prominence earlier this year after forcing the resignation of India's education minister, who was embroiled in a scandal involving leaked exam papers and was blamed for rising unemployment in the country.
* **Hundreds of schools remain closed in France as student protests grow:** Student protests across France over a host of grievances including teacher shortages and dilapidated school buildings, have continued to grow forcing the closure of some 400 schools on Friday.
* Police have cracked down on the protests, arresting nearly 3,000 people, 90% of them minors, [according](https://substack.com/redirect/0c648161-7c70-4178-80cb-cae55db30ce3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to France24.
* Around 170 students and 65 staff members--including 40 school principals--have been injured. Over 100 high schools have suffered severe damage.
* Prime Minister Sebastien Lecornu called a crisis cabinet meeting on Thursday and told ministers to cancel travel plans to deal with the demonstrations.

* **Hungary signals easing opposition to Ukraine 's EU membership:** The Hungarian government said that it [welcomed](https://substack.com/redirect/66fcca33-00cb-48ce-81c1-5df4d107dbd9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) draft Ukrainian legislation Friday that would strengthen Hungarian-language education for Ukraine's roughly 100,000 ethnic Hungarians, as part of talks to lift its objections to possible Ukrainian integration into the European Union.
* Hungarian Prime Minister Peter Magyar has adopted a less confrontational approach toward Kyiv than predecessor Viktor Orban, but still conditions support for Ukraine's EU accession on stronger minority protections.
