Nabeela Syed made history as the youngest member elected to the Illinois legislature, and is a current member of the Illinois State House with the drive to continue her work in the State Senate. In the State House, she has passed legislation to cap prescription drug prices, expand breast cancer screening, increase voter accessibility for young people, and secured paid leave for organ donors. Fun fact, Nabeela was the first state legislative candidate I ever campaigned for! I was in college at the time, and years later when we started Leaders We Deserve, Nabeela was one of the inspirations for the organization. The seat is currently held by Republican Darby Hills and Nabeela needs support to flip this seat. She’s already proven her commitment to fighting and advocating for her community, and is ready to continue being a hardworking and authentic voice in the State Senate. Trevor Jung currently serves as the City of Racine’s Director of Transit and Mobility, and he’s ready to continue delivering for Wisconsin in the State Senate. He’ll fight to lower costs while raising incomes, provide protections from data center costs, support Veteran programs, and hold Big Tech and Social Media companies accountable. This seat is currently held by a Republican, and Jim Croft is running to keep it red. So Trevor needs your support to flip this seat and continue making families, neighbors, and communities the priority. This race is especially important to breaking the Republican majority in the State Senate to ensure Wisconsin isn’t the next stop on the GOP’s gerrymandering campaign. Flipping these red seats blue is absolutely critical to building state legislative power across Missouri, Wisconsin, Iowa, and Illinois. But these are the kind of bold progressive candidates right-wing billionaires and the corporate machine will come after, Peter. That’s why I’m asking for your support today — we need grassroots supporters like you showing up to have these leaders’ backs. Thank you, David Hogg

|
---

| | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/140524474/650763870/-977686964?refcode=MW_ATA_EM_PT_Healthcare_261002_T1_1&ms=MW_ATA_EM_PT_Healthcare_261002_T1_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwY2JmMDA5OC05NWJlLWYxMTEtYTZhOS0wMDBkM2E1NmQyZjciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=eciQMhDUT5xmWg4IPbeXbZPTvlbRKiG0tRKHykHkJeo=) Derek, I think it has become obvious:

We need to take steps towards universal health care coverage in this country NOW.

[_**If you agree, sign on to my petition to join me in this fight.**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/140524475/650763871/1127548933?refcode=MW_ATA_EM_PT_Healthcare_261002_T1_1&ms=MW_ATA_EM_PT_Healthcare_261002_T1_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwY2JmMDA5OC05NWJlLWYxMTEtYTZhOS0wMDBkM2E1NmQyZjciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=eciQMhDUT5xmWg4IPbeXbZPTvlbRKiG0tRKHykHkJeo=&emci=52d635a9-84be-f111-a6a9-000d3a56d2f7&emdi=0cbf0098-95be-f111-a6a9-000d3a56d2f7&ceid=4568237) **[SIGN ON](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/140524476/650763872/1127548933?refcode=MW_ATA_EM_PT_Healthcare_261002_T1_1&ms=MW_ATA_EM_PT_Healthcare_261002_T1_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwY2JmMDA5OC05NWJlLWYxMTEtYTZhOS0wMDBkM2E1NmQyZjciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=eciQMhDUT5xmWg4IPbeXbZPTvlbRKiG0tRKHykHkJeo=&emci=52d635a9-84be-f111-a6a9-000d3a56d2f7&emdi=0cbf0098-95be-f111-a6a9-000d3a56d2f7&ceid=4568237)** You couldn’t create a more opaque health care system than the one in the U.S – _no one pays more for less than we do._

And when we’re facing an urgent affordability crisis, it’s unconscionable to me that my Republican colleagues voted last year to strip health care from millions of Americans. Conveniently, most of those cuts don’t take effect until after this year’s election.

**But we have to go further than patching the broken system.**

In order to have a sustainable system, we have to have universal health care, so that we don’t focus only on who has coverage, but put our focus on bringing costs down for everyone.

**Recently, I introduced a plan to move our country towards a system of universal health care coverage:**
* **Undo the harmful health care provisions in the Big Ugly bill** and make permanent the enhanced ACA tax credits that Republicans let expire.

* ****Implement a low-cost public health insurance option**** and improve Medicaid and Medicare coverage.

* ******Stand up to the middlemen profiting off this broken system****** by ensuring health insurance companies and pharmacy benefit managers do not put profit over patients and by extending Medicare-negotiated drug prices and out-of-pocket limits for prescription drugs.

* ********Increase transparency across the system******** by requiring health insurance plans provide detailed information about benefits and out-of-pocket costs, and to make certain cost and ownership information public.

********It all comes down to this: We need to move past the partisan fights over who gets covered and make sure every American can access a basic standard of care.********

It’s not only the right thing to do – it’s also the only way to start lowering costs for everyone.

********That’s why I’m running for reelection, and why I need my team of grassroots supporters to join me in this fight.**

[_**If you support my plan to lower costs and move our country towards universal health care coverage, add your name to my petition.**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/140524477/650763873/1127548933?refcode=MW_ATA_EM_PT_Healthcare_261002_T1_1&ms=MW_ATA_EM_PT_Healthcare_261002_T1_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwY2JmMDA5OC05NWJlLWYxMTEtYTZhOS0wMDBkM2E1NmQyZjciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=eciQMhDUT5xmWg4IPbeXbZPTvlbRKiG0tRKHykHkJeo=&emci=52d635a9-84be-f111-a6a9-000d3a56d2f7&emdi=0cbf0098-95be-f111-a6a9-000d3a56d2f7&ceid=4568237)****** Thank you,

Mark Warner **Before you go:**

We are officially in the final, all-out sprint towards Election Day – and we can’t afford to take our foot off the gas.

Victory in November requires sustained engagement from grassroots supporters like you. Right now, this campaign is recruiting volunteers, getting our ads up on the airwaves, and scaling our Get Out the Vote operation.

name: Mike Carey
subject: My story is not so different from yours.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Carey for Congress
body:
I grew up in inner city Cincinnati, raised by a single mother. At 10, we moved to a farm in Sabina. Here's what I took from both of those places. |
---
Peter,

I grew up in inner city Cincinnati, raised by a single mother.

We didn't have a lot. But she made sure I understood something early: nobody was coming to hand me anything. Whatever I was going to build, I was going to have to build it myself. She said it more than once. She meant it every time.

When I was ten years old, our family grew and we moved to Sabina, Ohio. Population: a few thousand. A farm town in Clinton County where people got up before the sun and worked until the job was done. That move changed the way I saw the world.

| [**THIS IS WHERE IT ALL STARTED >>**
](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=642a9fa866444ce1986d16cb82316fdd&_e=s7-3ioFyo5BX09g9M5hVsY_wftA-EIJ287ykzahf73yf5Hz-H5TpW3kAXTvk7ar4u0o6xOpPmdO1O8UAShhKxnqczInIJ0zBCooFdO4aB5n6HfeqdSPGPcL_iQzEQjUGsC0fPtxXlUwTdmgKA1jBXw8AOS8JCwI9EH6NwhBHR4-B5OvTwwzVp93b5LZtifnR-PEio1wOMgoCYvpLD8r9Mm6kWzc3G9VJLn9c93bVAlHVF1ugKXL7zVUxsVXj0S5g7opK26TFRqnCQwKVs69tqIgbYj2raV0uVnqYvbKyoq50gSHzn4_iLU2jZfbDw3-giRhWXOIpl9k5APJ4XkLiW-IoAeahk3o-qd-FASn-LEhYTnmW_LY6Ukq8ObgmwFNHynvL8bt8YQm50duwaMIwyIYJtHuV3v5kGzg5_3vR8icJnYkgZYUuMwJwxNdWUFCGXUmVVKCczqKKx7owIFwbbF4a563za5DFLCsa36DrYTd04FV3Su4CgNT-eDmoT9PVqZiPMfphFtzI9k1x2L4GCg87VHIuxJWKpk2T3DVmsOrq1eM6o8xHjwIjAYedljLHopYyVDnHtTI1tiBhrln9yEJkefVPouQ725uBUv3Ljc2xfgjvcJklnay9Esx4BunlG6lXi9X6tda80YGavTV_niuoS2q0hexPYujossWlItf00urcWog9Qiz_6DBMEywyTNTvRMCEc9X2Ez-WvzxeMQ%3D%3D)
---

On that farm, I started my own hay-baling business as a kid. Nobody told me to. It was just how things worked out there, you saw a need, you filled it, and you got paid for the work. Simple as that. I carried that lesson into everything that came after.

After high school, I followed a family tradition of service. I earned an ROTC scholarship, attended the Marion Military Institute, and served as an officer in the Army National Guard. The military taught me things you cannot learn in a classroom. Accountability. Discipline. The understanding that the person next to you is counting on you to do your job, and that there is no such thing as a bad day at someone else's expense.

I went on to Ohio State for my degree, and then spent more than twenty years as an energy executive fighting for Ohio coal miners and American energy independence. I watched men who had given their whole lives to this industry get squeezed out by regulations written in offices a thousand miles away by people who had never met them. I fought for their pensions. I fought against the failed energy policies that drove up prices and made American workers pay the bill for Washington's bad decisions.

That fight is what eventually brought me to Congress.

| | Welcome back to Fact Friday. Recently, I asked El Paso middle schoolers a question for my Hispanic Heritage Month Essay Contest: **"What does Hispanic Culture mean to you, and how has living in El Paso influenced that perspective?"** I received some incredible submissions, and soon we'll celebrate the young people who shared their stories with us. Their essays got me thinking about my own answer — but first, a little history. Hispanic Heritage Month is celebrated each year from September 15 through October 15 to recognize the histories, cultures, and contributions of Hispanic Americans. It began in 1968 as Hispanic Heritage Week before Congress expanded the observance to a full month in 1988. And there's a reason it starts in mid-September: September 15 marks the anniversary of independence for Costa Rica, El Salvador, Guatemala, Honduras, and Nicaragua, followed by Mexico on September 16 and Chile on September 18. **For me, Hispanic Heritage Month is about celebrating where we come from, honoring the people and traditions that shaped us, and making sure those stories are carried forward.** I'm a third-generation El Pasoan, born and raised in this beautiful border community. Growing up here shaped how I see the world and taught me to take pride in being a fronteriza — a daughter of the border, shaped by the cultures and communities on both sides of it. El Paso is a place where cultures, languages, families, and traditions come together across generations and across the border. That is part of what makes our community so special, and why I'm so proud to call it home. Hispanic Heritage Month gives us an opportunity to celebrate that history, but our heritage isn't something we recognize for just one month. It lives in the stories we tell, the traditions we pass down, the food we share, the languages we speak, and the communities we build together. And just as importantly, it lives in the next generation. This essay contest allows young El Pasoans to tell their own stories and reflect on what our culture and community mean to them. Their voices are part of El Paso's story, too. **So this Hispanic Heritage Month, I hope you'll take a moment to think about your own answer: What does Hispanic culture mean to you?** Hit reply and tell me. clean_body: A celebration of where we come from, and the stories we carry forward. | | | | Welcome back to Fact Friday. Recently, I asked El Paso middle schoolers a question for my Hispanic Heritage Month Essay Contest: "What does Hispanic Culture mean to you, and how has living in El Paso influenced that perspective?" I received some incredible submissions, and soon we'll celebrate the young people who shared their stories with us. Their essays got me thinking about my own answer — but first, a little history. Hispanic Heritage Month is celebrated each year from September 15 through October 15 to recognize the histories, cultures, and contributions of Hispanic Americans. It began in 1968 as Hispanic Heritage Week before Congress expanded the observance to a full month in 1988. And there's a reason it starts in mid-September: September 15 marks the anniversary of independence for Costa Rica, El Salvador, Guatemala, Honduras, and Nicaragua, followed by Mexico on September 16 and Chile on September 18. For me, Hispanic Heritage Month is about celebrating where we come from, honoring the people and traditions that shaped us, and making sure those stories are carried forward. I'm a third-generation El Pasoan, born and raised in this beautiful border community. Growing up here shaped how I see the world and taught me to take pride in being a fronteriza — a daughter of the border, shaped by the cultures and communities on both sides of it. El Paso is a place where cultures, languages, families, and traditions come together across generations and across the border. That is part of what makes our community so special, and why I'm so proud to call it home. Hispanic Heritage Month gives us an opportunity to celebrate that history, but our heritage isn't something we recognize for just one month. It lives in the stories we tell, the traditions we pass down, the food we share, the languages we speak, and the communities we build together. And just as importantly, it lives in the next generation. This essay contest allows young El Pasoans to tell their own stories and reflect on what our culture and community mean to them. Their voices are part of El Paso's story, too. So this Hispanic Heritage Month, I hope you'll take a moment to think about your own answer: What does Hispanic culture mean to you? Hit reply and tell me. I'd love to hear your story. ## They're Losing Their Grip!
This quote is from a time before primaries, but the attitude of the major parties hasn't changed. They want to control which candidates are on the general election ballot (leaving the rest of us to choose among their limited set of preordained choices). Now the majority of Americans don't support either major party, and their registration numbers – pictured – are only getting worse, so they're starting to realize things need to change. [](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=4XT5t7ZPUAMhlrpk_QBMIj3IoC_P2qwp_ZErQmwfNZD_7VN9bhJnQo7d4VCSx-Qop4Cz5Tf9gtDT6UaB2V3-AKPtYch8pLZWtf--c-XKLMGHNl8uGd5YxwgrBrEC9RsyZQ7PK8Y7rER4UU7mxbHReg&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2026_october_newsletter&n=2) This week, the PA State House passed [**HB280**](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=V7SejdAfq_S5peXuNGcE_VGnmYIJVo6a_Z7isKPClcrT0aSAU8_1lFjIxiZoSKa0kKXcFy_OScXj6UaGCl9dwyZ4uDEKssvjvtJrEDjkrAuQRUdrh0Yub00rc0YZoXq9U6kUPC5qnCWSA_sonXXVH95JIoSfk-DsVyIpU9kirs4&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2026_october_newsletter&n=3) which would allow independent voters to participate in primaries. The bill was co-sponsored by **Forward Republican[Valerie Gaydos](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=h0RfpQFo3I_cV_stI8Bw4hJhb3ySooMYPSVVRu7ubAI&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2026_october_newsletter&n=4)**. We appreciate her standing up to others in her party on such an important issue. This is exactly what being a "Forward Republican" or "Forward Democrat" is all about—making the system work better for everyone, not just your own party. Pennsylvania is one of only 7 states that still have closed primaries. Opening those primaries would be a first step towards loosening the grip of the duopoly here. We will be watching this legislation closely to see whether it clears the remaining hurdles to become a law. ([Contact your representative](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=2Ycjns7oB5o-0odxkGw2JSr2iIcKFyRcbCGqfd4fNPIzvIXNW5BK1vle7DTtjbw4&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2026_october_newsletter&n=5) if you want that to happen.) Thanks to the work by our partner organizations, [Ballot PA](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=z3vUwOHe94eTXtJdmRpuDLxElaobMEJ2m3UlL6wuEzQ&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2026_october_newsletter&n=6) and [Independent Pennsylvanians](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=Aj0izWy80JeEne78TTwrPFpPDO9hOwBQKKcBHxkOhQs&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2026_october_newsletter&n=7) (plus [Open Primaries](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=YTIBxqx8zpmyL-AnxGUXEqGrSd0V6K2LzxEvPriUGKI&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2026_october_newsletter&n=8) nationally who recognized the sponsors of this bill as "Champions of Independent Voters"). By taking this first step, Pennsylvanians may start thinking of just how far we can go with reform. End gerrymandering? Implement ranked-choice voting? It's all possible if we work together to move _Forward_. **Read more below:** Spotlight PA- [Bill to let unaffiliated voters participate in PA primaries passes state house](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=fig9NNEEGgWJgnm_2EYYuIahwhfVuTu4RJGueCPNqy1M3QtiYREJ46D2mhM3ClJX1E-j_M8G7fg_tRQ8e2eilNAFDFrpeKl44M1bpxTdAlIH8Axo74Od6YK_CJbISwnh&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2026_october_newsletter&n=9) Altoona Mirror- [Bill to Open PA Primaries passes State House](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=fig9NNEEGgWJgnm_2EYYuIahwhfVuTu4RJGueCPNqy1M3QtiYREJ46D2mhM3ClJX1E-j_M8G7fg_tRQ8e2eilNAFDFrpeKl44M1bpxTdAlIH8Axo74Od6YK_CJbISwnh&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2026_october_newsletter&n=10) Unite America- [PA House Advances Open Primary Bill](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=fig9NNEEGgWJgnm_2EYYuIahwhfVuTu4RJGueCPNqy1M3QtiYREJ46D2mhM3ClJX1E-j_M8G7fg_tRQ8e2eilNAFDFrpeKl44M1bpxTdAlIH8Axo74Od6YK_CJbISwnh&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2026_october_newsletter&n=11)

clean_body: The grip is slipping | | | They're Losing Their Grip! This quote is from a time before primaries, but the attitude of the major parties hasn't changed. They want to control which candidates are on the general election ballot (leaving the rest of us to choose among their limited set of preordained choices). Now the majority of Americans don't support either major party, and their registration numbers – pictured – are only getting worse, so they're starting to realize things need to change. This week, the PA State House passed which would allow independent voters to participate in primaries. The bill was co-sponsored by Forward Republican. We appreciate her standing up to others in her party on such an important issue. This is exactly what being a "Forward Republican" or "Forward Democrat" is all about—making the system work better for everyone, not just your own party. Pennsylvania is one of only 7 states that still have closed primaries. Opening those primaries would be a first step towards loosening the grip of the duopoly here. subject: Scott Wiener | Letter from the Campaign Manager: Scott Keeps San Franciscans Safe
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Scott WIENER FOR CONGRESS
body:
| |
Peter,

Happy Fall! We are less than 5 weeks out from Election Day, and ballots are dropping this weekend. Last week alone, team Wiener knocked 25,000 doors, while Scott connected with the community at house parties and spoke with neighbors at block parties and farmers’ markets across town.

32 days — let’s keep pushing!

San Francisco is a world-class city, and our best days are yet to come. But current conditions on our streets have, at times, left people feeling unsafe and rightfully wanting better for our city. Scott has helped lead the way, pushing for new approaches that are both compassionate and effective.

Scott was an early champion of conservatorship reform, led the legislative fight to close the “locked-door loophole,” and worked with street vendors and community organizations to change state law and give SFPD a greater role in tackling the sale of stolen goods on our streets.

Scott’s opponent has spent her career calling to _**defund and dismantle**_ the police, and fighting against Mayor Lurie’s efforts to crack down on open-air drug markets.

Public safety is about helping those in need and holding people accountable when they inflict harm. We must do both. **Scott has.**

**In Congress, Scott will work to:**
* Ensure cities and counties have access to federal funds to assist with fully staffed police departments AND increased crisis and mental healthcare to compassionately support those in need.
* Crack down on the fentanyl supply chain by targeting the cartels and Chinese chemical manufacturers flooding our communities with poison, and holding accountable the drug traffickers profiting from mass death.
* Expand federal resources for fentanyl treatment, including naloxone access and overdose prevention programs, so people struggling with addiction get help before it’s too late.
* Strengthen federal prosecution and coordination to dismantle human trafficking networks and ensure survivors have access to the housing, healthcare, and legal support they need to rebuild their lives.

Scott is the only candidate in this race who has fought and will continue to protect the public and keep San Franciscans safe in every neighborhood.

— Josh

Last week alone, team Wiener knocked 25,000 doors, while Scott connected with the community at house parties and spoke with neighbors at block parties and farmers’ markets across town. 32 days — let’s keep pushing! San Francisco is a world-class city, and our best days are yet to come. But current conditions on our streets have, at times, left people feeling unsafe and rightfully wanting better for our city. Scott has helped lead the way, pushing for new approaches that are both compassionate and effective. Scott was an early champion of conservatorship reform, led the legislative fight to close the “locked-door loophole,” and worked with street vendors and community organizations to change state law and give SFPD a greater role in tackling the sale of stolen goods on our streets. Scott’s opponent has spent her career calling to defund and dismantle the police, and fighting against Mayor Lurie’s efforts to crack down on open-air drug markets. Public safety is about helping those in need and holding people accountable when they inflict harm. We must do both. Scott has. In Congress, Scott will work to: Ensure cities and counties have access to federal funds to assist with fully staffed police departments AND increased crisis and mental healthcare to compassionately support those in need. Crack down on the fentanyl supply chain by targeting the cartels and Chinese chemical manufacturers flooding our communities with poison, and holding accountable the drug traffickers profiting from mass death. Expand federal resources for fentanyl treatment, including naloxone access and overdose prevention programs, so people struggling with addiction get help before it’s too late. Strengthen federal prosecution and coordination to dismantle human trafficking networks and ensure survivors have access to the housing, healthcare, and legal support they need to rebuild their lives. subject: Vote Forward has new letter-writing campaigns where you can get involved right now.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Swing Left, [swingleft
body:
Right now, hundreds of thousands of voters are waiting to be reached across impactful campaigns.
#
Hi there,
At Swing Left, we’re always looking for innovative, evidence-based ways to reach more voters and win key races. That’s why we’re excited to share what our friends at Vote Forward are doing with a new and innovative series of letter-writing campaigns!
**Vote Forward is testing strategic approaches to rebuild trust in government and boost civic participation with personal, handwritten letters ahead of Election Day.**
Right now, hundreds of thousands of voters still need to be reached across these high-impact campaigns, and the Swing Left community's support could make a real difference.
Here are two of the campaigns Vote Forward is running that still need help:
* [**Ground Truth Civic Action Follow-Up Letters**](https://act.swingleft.org/go/2428?utm_source=em20261002-2999&t=1&akid=2999%2E1562180%2EbT7Los): A single conversation at the door isn’t always enough to move a voter by Election Day. In this campaign, volunteers for Ground Truth, a voter contact program run by Swing Left, have deep conversations with voters and dictate notes summarizing those conversations. Vote Forward volunteers use those notes to write tailored follow-up letters. If you’ve already volunteered or canvassed with Ground Truth, joining this program is an incredibly powerful way to continue that conversation and help move a voter from conversation to ballot.

* [**Persuasion Letters in Competitive U.S. House Districts**](https://act.swingleft.org/go/2428?utm_source=em20261002-2999&t=2&akid=2999%2E1562180%2EbT7Los): This campaign is designed to measure impact on vote choice in addition to voter turnout. These letters feature facts about the Democratic candidates on issues where voters trust Democrats most. By pairing candidate facts with your own personal story about why issues like healthcare, Social Security, or the cost of living matter in your life, your letter creates a credible connection that generic advertising can’t replicate.

[**If you’re ready to jump in and start adopting voters in one of these campaigns, click here to get started now!** ](https://act.swingleft.org/go/2428?utm_source=em20261002-2999&t=3&akid=2999%2E1562180%2EbT7Los)
**[Take Action Now](https://act.swingleft.org/go/2428?utm_source=em20261002-2999&t=4&akid=2999%2E1562180%2EbT7Los)**
Every letter you send helps the team at Vote Forward test and learn more about what works to help shape the future of voter contact. And with hundreds of thousands of voters still waiting to be adopted, your voice can make all the difference.
Thank you, as always, for everything that you do.
— The Swing Left Team

**Since 2017, Swing Left has channeled the energy of grassroots volunteers and donors to elect Democrats, up and down the ballot, focusing on the most competitive races that can swing the national balance of power.** Right now, Swing Left is investing in grassroots organizing in key swing districts and initiatives across the country to flip the House and win the Senate and critical states in 2026. [**If you’d like to help support our work, you can make a donation using this link.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_sl_footer?refcode=em20261002-2&t=5&refcode2=2999_1562180_bT7Los&akid=2999%2E1562180%2EbT7Los)

Peter, MAGA Mike Minogue just announced he’s planning to spend up to $2 billion of his own money to try to buy this governor’s seat.
**[That’s why I set an Emergency Fund goal of $200,000 by tonight. Will you split a donation right now between my campaign and Wes Moore's so that we have the resources we need to compete with that kind of spending?](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20261002-2.weip-6&refcode=em-20261002-2&t=1&akid=2038%2E1086043%2Elgz4L7)**

body:
For 45 days, a 12-year-old girl lived through a nightmare no child should ever experience.

For 45 days, she was alone and abandoned.

| | | | | [ ](https://email.editor.goppresidential.com/c/eJyU0EFuszAQBeDTmB3IHpwJLLz4pSj_Km12XVoGT8AS2MgeUuX2FVV7gG5nnp4-vY-bvbmwhDi9uZXMlLbN5mIHKmmlFKl499JoQQLWStYSrBs5PMlqV3mjHWpErMiocy_7szqBrGZDOAySUBKoHpEQAB4Sh05De-rdoKpgjkIlJYCUJ9U1Hrq2V74bXTcqPYDQknzglJtDlKkET5GDW5oxrdViZuatiPafgKuAq0_RMTU800w5UXmkPO-ri4FfTcrTkXCvWmNd5pTZbvWWNtFeM417ziFOor1w3kkA7rxaHkV7-f9-v9e_yJ_HmCJTZNFeaHVhUVU2fvsMyxIKnoWW03H9BvLfhnwa-AoAAP__uAF-EA)
---
Friend,
_**For 45 days, a 12-year-old girl lived through a nightmare no child should ever experience.** _ She had been trafficked, drugged, abused, and held against her will in a homeless encampment in California. **For 45 days, it seemed as if everyone had forsaken her.** **For 45 days, she suffered a living hell.** **For 45 days, she endured untold horrors.** [ _**Then came Day 46. That was the day our team at Heroes for Humanity went in and brought her out.** _ ](https://email.editor.goppresidential.com/c/eJyU0EFuszAQBeDTmB3IHpwJLLz4pSj_Km12XVoGT8AS2MgeUuX2FVV7gG5nnp4-vY-bvbmwhDi9uZXMlLbN5mIHKmmlFKl499JoQQLWStYSrBs5PMlqV3mjHWpErMiocy_7szqBrGZDOAySUBKoHpEQAB4Sh05De-rdoKpgjkIlJYCUJ9U1Hrq2V74bXTcqPYDQknzglJtDlKkET5GDW5oxrdViZuatiPafgKuAq0_RMTU800w5UXmkPO-ri4FfTcrTkXCvWmNd5pTZbvWWNtFeM417ziFOor1w3kkA7rxaHkV7-f9-v9e_yJ_HmCJTZNFeaHVhUVU2fvsMyxIKnoWW03H9BvLfhnwa-AoAAP__uAF-EA)
My name is Dennis Price, and I want to tell you why I'm sharing her story with you today. I believe God puts people in our path for a reason. Sometimes He calls us to pray. Sometimes He calls us to give. And sometimes He puts someone in front of us who desperately needs help, and then the Lord asks, “Who will go?” I have spent more than 19 years across various special operations units and private military contracting, and now I serve as a humanitarian and evangelist. I've seen suffering most people thankfully never will. I started Heroes for Humanity during the collapse in Afghanistan, watching Americans and vetted Afghan allies get hunted while the systems built to get them out failed completely. A small team and I helped rescue dozens of them. **That crucible proved how powerful it can be when good people refuse to look the other way.** We’ve carried that mission to all corners of the world, including responding to devastating earthquakes in Venezuela and Colombia this summer and the deadly Texas Hill Country floods last year. Our team is made up of veteran special operators, first responders, medical professionals, and everyday heroes who are willing to go into the places others can’t – or won’t – to rescue people in desperate need. [ _**For that little girl, it meant getting her out of an unimaginable situation and bringing her home.** _ ](https://email.editor.goppresidential.com/c/eJyU0EFuszAQBeDTmB3IHpwJLLz4pSj_Km12XVoGT8AS2MgeUuX2FVV7gG5nnp4-vY-bvbmwhDi9uZXMlLbN5mIHKmmlFKl499JoQQLWStYSrBs5PMlqV3mjHWpErMiocy_7szqBrGZDOAySUBKoHpEQAB4Sh05De-rdoKpgjkIlJYCUJ9U1Hrq2V74bXTcqPYDQknzglJtDlKkET5GDW5oxrdViZuatiPafgKuAq0_RMTU800w5UXmkPO-ri4FfTcrTkXCvWmNd5pTZbvWWNtFeM417ziFOor1w3kkA7rxaHkV7-f9-v9e_yJ_HmCJTZNFeaHVhUVU2fvsMyxIKnoWW03H9BvLfhnwa-AoAAP__uAF-EA) In other cases, it could mean delivering lifesaving aid after a natural disaster, pulling families from a warzone, or simply being there on the worst day of someone’s life and reminding them that they have not been forgotten. But we can't wait until the next desperate call comes to get ready. Our operators have to be trained. Our equipment has to be ready. Vehicles need fuel. Medical supplies need to be stocked. Because when someone is waiting for their “Day 46,” every minute matters. **So, I’m asking you to do something today.** [ _**Will you make a gift of $10, $25, $50, or whatever you can afford to Heroes for Humanity?** _ ](https://email.editor.goppresidential.com/c/eJyU0EFuszAQBeDTmB3IHpwJLLz4pSj_Km12XVoGT8AS2MgeUuX2FVV7gG5nnp4-vY-bvbmwhDi9uZXMlLbN5mIHKmmlFKl499JoQQLWStYSrBs5PMlqV3mjHWpErMiocy_7szqBrGZDOAySUBKoHpEQAB4Sh05De-rdoKpgjkIlJYCUJ9U1Hrq2V74bXTcqPYDQknzglJtDlKkET5GDW5oxrdViZuatiPafgKuAq0_RMTU800w5UXmkPO-ri4FfTcrTkXCvWmNd5pTZbvWWNtFeM417ziFOor1w3kkA7rxaHkV7-f9-v9e_yJ_HmCJTZNFeaHVhUVU2fvsMyxIKnoWW03H9BvLfhnwa-AoAAP__uAF-EA) You may never be the person who physically walks into danger to bring someone home, but you can empower someone else to be that person. Your gift can be the hand that reaches across the world to comfort someone in need. [ _**And maybe, just maybe, God put this message in front of you today for a reason.** _ ](https://email.editor.goppresidential.com/c/eJyU0EFuszAQBeDTmB3IHpwJLLz4pSj_Km12XVoGT8AS2MgeUuX2FVV7gG5nnp4-vY-bvbmwhDi9uZXMlLbN5mIHKmmlFKl499JoQQLWStYSrBs5PMlqV3mjHWpErMiocy_7szqBrGZDOAySUBKoHpEQAB4Sh05De-rdoKpgjkIlJYCUJ9U1Hrq2V74bXTcqPYDQknzglJtDlKkET5GDW5oxrdViZuatiPafgKuAq0_RMTU800w5UXmkPO-ri4FfTcrTkXCvWmNd5pTZbvWWNtFeM417ziFOor1w3kkA7rxaHkV7-f9-v9e_yJ_HmCJTZNFeaHVhUVU2fvsMyxIKnoWW03H9BvLfhnwa-AoAAP__uAF-EA)

Today is October 1, the federal fiscal new year -- the date the budget process treats as sacred and Congress treats as negotiable. It's a good day to step back from the annual fight over funding bills and look at the whole machine.
The raw numbers, for fiscal 2025: the federal government spent $7.0 trillion -- nearly 25 percent of the entire economy, about $20,500 for every person in America. It collected $5.2 trillion. The gap -- roughly $1.8 trillion -- is borrowed. That's the budget in one paragraph. Here's what's inside it.
**The 60% that votes for itself**
Roughly 60 percent of federal spending is mandatory -- programs written into permanent law that run on autopilot unless Congress affirmatively changes them. Nobody votes on this money each year. If the law says a person meeting certain criteria gets a certain benefit, the check goes out...

The same man who spent years handing out BILLIONS of your tax dollars to data centers is now saying we need to protect Texans from them. = This isn’t a change of heart. He just knows he got caught. Dan pushed through billions in tax incentives for data center companies — the same companies now straining our power grid, draining our water supply, and driving up your bills. He blocked serious property tax relief for families while making sure corporations got their breaks. Now, weeks before Election Day, he suddenly wants to be the man who protects you from the very problem he built. = Unlike Dan, I've been on the front-lines fighting to prioritize drinking water for Texas families over data center infrastructure. ## 11-Year-Old Makes Chess History
Bodhana Sivanandan learned to play chess during the COVID-19 pandemic when she was 5 years old. Six years later, the London schoolgirl has become the youngest woman grandmaster in chess history, securing the final qualifying performance she needed while [playing in England's top position](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0L1uwyAUxfGnwRsWXPORDAxdvKVrR-vaXGwqDBEmjvL2VStV6t4XODq__8dtumFMMa_vuJMLa5haKFOm55GoNarTqzzySkdbK2a_49GohlhpKxMIMFwKLmDCpcWTJt15F4iAho6ctFdxtaCl7Tbn1TxrWIz2Idh5IIlaWQVXQ_piFZguuu85KQSAAKlNLywIr8J8gcVYJT1TgnxspfafJea2UUivclLtl7J3yW2t3Q82vDEYGYxto3uNufUxMxgDYXtUYjBKyV-ElZfk-Vz8hhn5EU_MmD1m_mvlz7Jj5n_IDMZBaAPCMBi76vz9GVOKh7FMiXXHmH5-tP8XPB18BQAA__9Cy4e2) at the 46th Chess Olympiad in Samarkand, Uzbekistan. Bodhana broke the record at age 11; the previous record was 12**.** She played all 11 rounds at the Olympiad and scored eight points. Earlier this year, she defeated grandmaster Marc'Andria Maurizzi, becoming the [youngest girl known to defeat a player rated above 2,600](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGO4yAQQL_G7mwNEwNxQXGNu1x7JSIwGE7YRDCbKH-_yv7C9k_vSe_fzd5cLvnc_7qDTNyj5VjtSa9eiJmafdevc6fOe3NnOFxnajE3StUioJoETIDWec5PsnIMJhIhXUYyQq-wapRCj8lQWL1EveL1LpW-oPJBegc-rkI6v-gxm49OACACCqlm0AhhifcreqUXEYYFKGSubf5f88mJYnnXJ7XZ12MsJjE_-nD5M-A24NYftXGf3y7V-gEG3Fzj7Av1ATchplrCtOdWpjv5elCffKLeJ4ECFrXCdU58lLGZ8HjlUnJXelhgP1wuPz3-_amnwe8AAAD__7qvfsM). The records have been piling up. Bodhana is already Britain's youngest women's chess champion and the youngest person to represent England internationally in any sport. In August 2025, she became the youngest female player to [defeat a grandmaster](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0MGuEyEUxvGnYXY0cEqhs2AxMU7U3qtuTKObCYXDDMpAA9hJ396MiYn7uz7Jyf_7XV-nVxNiSPNns6L2s5-az1PCrUZsDcv0zL_TjLXNxSS3mtqw-FBwyRMwkJQzymAytoUHTqfOaY8IeOxQc9WzXsGJq27RHCwyOEvOkIuj4Aa5OB-t7G0vnTO2C3p_xxkDYMBP8sAUMCf87QxWKsEdEQxdaLkcfuaQ2oI-PvMDy8HmtYt6ae1eyXEgMBIYt207_Aolq_1KYNz3EBhbweRCmgmMnNMnmkJzdPRWQgt1oXbBWqldzHoPOdEb2rxipf8EqMfVRKT_SRAYP3778vJBXgZ1GsSP8fr1_WW4fLq-e_m-p3RFu_sWYgxVKiLYvJoQ_xa3t1s_NPwJAAD__zAPlbM), beating 60-year-old Pete Wells at 10 years, 5 months, and 3 days old. "_I'm happy to do it, but I want to keep going and keep making history as well_ ," Bodhana told the International Chess Federation, "_instead of just stopping here_."
## A Little Girl and Her Firehouse Family
Lila Pagan is 6 years old, full of energy, and has a crew of Seminole County, Florida firefighters wrapped around her finger. [They call her "baby girl,"](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LFyhCAYBOCn0Q4HflC8giKN3aVN6aD8IBmEG-A0vn3GvEL6nZ399us5P7UPPrpPvaOyzs7VpjniWQLWinm-0js6LNVlHc2uS8VsfcYtzUBhIIwSCrNeqz9w7lujLCIgb1Ex-aAPCT2T7aZGuXDDUTPJFmH1uPS9AUH5KCU3UojWq7uOUQpAgfVDRyVQI-wywjpIwUwjKBpfU-6-k491QxuudGDu1rS3QW21vkrDPxqYGpjO8-xs-uF9ykFHk-5QA9PNamAquPuYApI1vWO9yO2x3m0VcyFbiimjIUUfPjrCyYU6kxQMcT6HNivzOn0IvgyyEdTt2oe_CfX_5x0KfgMAAP__US2H2Q) show up for her birthdays and Christmases, and have watched her grow from a critically injured toddler into a kid who loves running around. Three years ago, the Station 22 crew responded to a harrowing call: Lila, then 3, had been accidentally run over by a truck. She was intubated and placed in a coma. Before the ambulance left, Lt. Marcus Gombs [stopped to pray with her terrified mother](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkDGO2zAQRU8jdWOQI0s0CxZBAGWL3TSLYEuBaw6lSWjSIMcWnNMHzhW2__h47328LW-eE-f1p7-Qi2tcJJYl094SiVBdHuWWV2qyVp_DxTehGrnSVhZUOIFWoHDxZ-E7LWMfXCRCGnpy2lhlDY7a9JuzkcxJk7JBjScbR23tFOk8URjspzahZ_e800ohKtTjdFAGVTjGzxOeJ3PUoTsqCiylHn4XzrJRTI9yp3o4l0uf3CZybd3wrcO5w3nf90O75fxofx5_n4sO57WUAE-xDudp0KcO55krRV43odrgYyvwQulKAd79ncDDK4skgh9cE6jBQoNXjgTfSxbONwIp8L6VHX5dIZYKL1T76sJ155S4TaY7qvXiOf0nlK-3vTv8FwAA__9trZDP), Pamela. But Lila pulled through, and the firefighters kept showing up. The bond goes both ways. When firefighter Cross Ferrentino passed his paramedic test, Pamela was one of the first to congratulate him. "_That impacted me_ ," [he said](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGO4yAURb8Gd1jwjI1TUGzjLttuaRF42OxgiODFVv5-lPmFqa90j875d1_vNqaYt7_2QBO2sFIoa8arJSTCur7LK2_YaKs2-8M2whpixb2sIGDiUnABq3UUT1zHzpuACDh0aKS-iZuGUepuN370YZq0esxKDmoc3KjQOT2DFtprMXfRfO6kEAAC5Dj1QoPwKjxmcJNW0jMl0Ecqtf9fYqYdQ3qXE2vvytElsxM9Gxv-MFgYLNd19Re2_TMyWGyl6BIyWBoeMZeE3JVXpjf_qPBHyZ5vsSbe7ImeU325L-6qbTuDRQ83qaZBddX45xVTim3STIntsDH90On33U4D3wEAAP__vdSD_w). He's already made one promise for the future: "_I will be there at the wedding when she gets married in about 30 years, and I got to make sure I approve of the guy too_."
## Baltimore's Book Trolley Brings Reading to Kids
It started on a stoop. Ms. Maze, a Baltimore librarian, was reading to her nieces on her front steps when neighborhood kids gathered around and didn't want story time to end. That moment led her to continue reading to neighborhood kids, eventually become a librarian, and later take to the streets as a [self-described "radical street librarian,"](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0L1uhDAQBOCngQ5kLz-GwkUaukubEhm8hk2MfbL3DvH2EXmF1DMafZqvx_ww5Clsn-ZA7TY3s4tzwDN7ZMY0X_EVNsy8JRPsYTJjcpRwjzMI6CspKgGzWZneOHel1Q4RsClRSzWKUUEnVbnrZlxU1_S42AXaZlyaoZVGDgpBumZAWZK-56QQAAJk19dCgbCtWwZYe9VKW7QCLXFM9XekwDs6f8U3pnqNR-n1zvzMRfNRwFTAdJ5nfZk9xjstYPLkMPPlsYDJJKbVY75r8TChWhKFjcJWuYRYLTH-5Gp_BZvQ5urmdDDKrt758GXS9nmS95R7VbRiOwz5PwH__7u3ht8AAAD__wp5hcw) handing out free books from her trunk in one of the city's worst book deserts. Now she has a trolley. The green and gold vehicle rolls through Baltimore's neighborhoods like an ice cream truck for readers, ringing a bell as it travels the streets and making stops at parks, football practices, and back-to-school events. Anywhere from 50 to 130 readers can board in a single day to pick out books. The experience is designed to feel magical because Ms. Maze says communities can sometimes associate books with [being boring or educational](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLFurDAQRb8GOtAwBgyFi9fQ7WtTWgaPwYmxV2YCIl8f7f5C2nulc6Tz8dAP44OP63-zk3Kr0-ySjnQdgZgp6zt9x5UOXrOJdjcHU3Y-05Y0AvZVAxWgNgv7k3RXWuWIkERJqpEjjBK7RpabIuzF0A69FSgIRNfgAg5bM8-jFIOdS69euAYAEbDp-hokgm3dPODSy7axRQtkPadcfyYfeSMX7nRSrpe0l0FtzM-jEP8KnAqcruuqOVlzv94Cp-AdFTi5TFTNKX1VnFMIdFcHp3y_l938UOUjUz49XVVeounGEUYos7LPy4fgj14WLay78eFt5b_3OhX-BgAA__8XCYJA). "_I wanted every child to feel the joy of reading and the thrill of discovering how_ [_books help you explore new worlds_](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkD0OnDAQRk8DnZE9_HgpXKSh27QpkcFjcNZgNJ5AuH3EXiH906fvvV_v8W1DDPvy025o_OJH9mnc8coRmZHGO_3ZF8y8kN3dZjMj-UC4phEkdEJJIWG0M4cTx7Z0xiMC1iUapXvZa2iVLlejXtaquWk7mOapb6Waa409NM30cljrrgzmmVNSAkhQbVdJDdI1fnrB3OlGuaKR6AInqn6nsPOKPt7pRKrmtJXRrMxHLuofBQwFDNd1VddmCR6RhyhgOFOYMRcwTDZy2BKhiGEiS8Hu4oN4ZMErisyJ7imlj8C_B2HOglJ8AgnrGenLrCkGZ-9cknHHFWIMudNFI5fNhvg9xP-f8jTwLwAA__-NVY4f) _,_ " she said.

name: Rashida Tlaib
subject: UPDATE: The most votes in the Senate to hold the Israeli government accountable
body:
Together, we’re working to end the violence and end U.S. complicity. | | |
---
Friend, Every day, our movement demanding peace and human rights is growing — inside and outside of the halls of Congress. This week in the U.S. Senate, Senators came close to passing S.Res.852, a resolution seeking accountability for Israel’s rampant human rights abuses, including the murder of Palestinians in the West Bank. The resolution failed 47-51, with all but one Democrat voting in favor, and one Republican crossing the aisle to vote with Democrats. The week prior, in a vote of 49-50, the Senate narrowly failed to pass a resolution to end Donald Trump’s illegal war with Iran with four Republicans joining Democrats, but Democratic Sen. John Fetterman siding with Republicans. **Together, we’ve successfully pushed many current members of Congress to speak out against the war and take action for Palestinians’ lives and rights — even members of Congress who’ve been long-time supporters of Israel’s military.** For example, the top Democrat on the House Foreign Affairs Committee temporarily blocked Trump’s $2.8 billion weapons transfer to the Israeli military, naming concerns about violating U.S. and international law. But in order for Congress to address the urgent needs of our communities, including investments in healthcare, housing, nutrition, and education — not more weapons, war, and genocide — we need to elect a more progressive U.S. Senate and House of Representatives. **With just over four weeks until Election Day, my Rooted in Community Leadership PAC is working to send more allies to Congress to fight by my side while also building the bench of leaders on the state and local level.** **[Donate today to elect a Congress that will block weapons transfers to the Israeli military and end Trump’s clean_body: Together, we’re working to end the violence and end U.S. complicity. | | | Friend, Every day, our movement demanding peace and human rights is growing — inside and outside of the halls of Congress. This week in the U.S. Senate, Senators came close to passing S.Res.852, a resolution seeking accountability for Israel’s rampant human rights abuses, including the murder of Palestinians in the West Bank. The resolution failed 47-51, with all but one Democrat voting in favor, and one Republican crossing the aisle to vote with Democrats. The week prior, in a vote of 49-50, the Senate narrowly failed to pass a resolution to end Donald Trump’s illegal war with Iran with four Republicans joining Democrats, but Democratic Sen. John Fetterman siding with Republicans. Together, we’ve successfully pushed many current members of Congress to speak out against the war and take action for Palestinians’ lives and rights — even members of Congress who’ve been long-time supporters of Israel’s military. # **[Lilly's amylin combo prints 23.3% and Novo is still catching the next wave](https://substack.com/redirect/fa0ccd6c-6294-4af6-8af1-ceeb85c82534?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
Eli Lilly just showed the post-GLP-1 lever. Eloralintide plus tirzepatide, in obese patients with Type 2 diabetes, cut 23.3% of body weight at 48 weeks on the highest dose, versus 14.8% on high-dose tirzepatide alone. That is about 54 pounds against 34. About a quarter of the top-dose lost 30% or more. Novo's CagriSema, cagrilintide plus semaglutide, is aimed at an early-next-year launch, with standalone cagrilintide and a higher dose in 2028. Amycretin targets both pathways in one molecule.
* **Winners?** Lilly, if Phase 3 holds, and the patients who plateaued on a GLP-1. Leerink has the eloralintide franchise at $23.2 billion in sales by 2035.
* **Losers?** Novo if CagriSema launches into a Lilly combo that already beat tirzepatide in the harder diabetic population. Compounders get squeezed again.
* **Next?** Lilly starts Phase 3 before year-end. Standalone eloralintide is a 2029 story, the combo a 2030 story. Novo has to ship CagriSema clean.

This is the second product cycle, not a victory lap. GLP-1s built the market. Amylin is the upsell. Lilly is stacking a pancreas hormone on Zepbound and printing a number that used to be surgery. Novo is not dead. It is late. The money is in who owns the combo slot when the first wave of patients stops losing weight.

# **[Forty billion dollars of mineral promises still have to become metal](https://substack.com/redirect/fa0ccd6c-6294-4af6-8af1-ceeb85c82534?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
Bloomberg Intelligence asked the only question that matters. More than $40 billion in announced support will not break China's chokehold on precious metals unless execution shows up before the rearmament cycle needs the metal. Policy has moved past grants into equity, price floors, loans, offtake, and stockpiles. MP Materials and ATALCO are the near-term magnet and gallium names. IperionX is titanium. Perpetua is antimony. An F-35 needs more than 900 pounds of rare earth. Defense-grade output, customer qualification, and contracted volume still have to follow the press releases.
* **Winners?** MP, ATALCO, IperionX, and Perpetua if offtake and qualification land. Equity and a price floor beat another grant cycle.
* **Losers?** Missile and drone lines that need the metal before 2030, and any miner still selling a slide as capacity.
* **Next?** Watch contracted volume, not headlines. Mining and refining persist through 2030. Breaking the quasi-monopoly is not a this-decade story.

I already flagged this race on September 21, **[when CRML ripped 37.5% to $9.22 on the Greenland security pact](https://substack.com/redirect/91aee2fd-37d3-47de-a046-4847eee1d80c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** and Tanbreez first ore sat in late 2028. Same movie. Announced capital is not a magnet. The West is rearming on a Chinese clock. Execution is the trade. Everything else is a press conference.

clean_body: We’ll be talking about Prop 40, extreme wealth, and investing in California’s future.| | | | Peter, I’m taking the stage with Bernie on October 3rd and 5th to talk about one of the biggest economic questions facing California: how should we tax extreme wealth? This November, Californians will vote on Proposition 40, which would create a one-time tax of up to 5% on the state’s billionaires and raise as much as $100 billion. Most of that revenue would go toward health care, with additional funding for food assistance and education. An economy should work for working people. California has extraordinary wealth, but too many families struggle to afford health care, raise their children, and get ahead. Investing in people is not separate from building a strong economy. It’s how we strengthen it. That’s the conversation I’ll be having with Bernie Sanders, California Insurance Commissioner candidate Jane Kim, and the SEIU-United Healthcare Workers West this week. = = = = Thanks for your support, your activism, and all you do. In our second debate, I asked our state one question.

| | Friend,
On Monday night I stood across from Gov. Rhoden on the debate stage in Sioux Falls and asked South Dakotans one question:
Are things getting better?
Governor Rhoden spent an hour telling you how much has been done. But here is what I hear when I sit down in your communities.
Teachers aren't just leaving for better pay across the border. They're leaving the profession entirely.
Eighteen nursing homes have closed in the last ten years, and only about half of our communities have reasonable access to a birthing center.
And the property tax plan the governor is so proud of leans on a new county sales tax. That isn't relief for everyone. It's a tax shift, and renters and working families are the ones left behind.
The governor told voters, "You're not guessing what I will do." He's right. We know exactly what more of the same looks like. I offered something different on that stage:
* Fund K-12 the way state law calls for, so your property taxes come down.
* Pay for school lunches, which would save families about $800 a year.
* A child care tax rebate, because if we want people working, they need a safe place for their kids.
* Real property tax reform, not just a band-aid on a bullet hole.
* A real seat at the table for all nine tribes.

As I said Monday night, after 50 years of one-party rule, it's time for more than a change of personalities. It's time for a change of priorities.
I won't pretend this is easy. South Dakota hasn't elected a Democratic governor since 1974, and Republicans outnumber us on the voter rolls by more than two to one. We are not going to outspend the other side. We are going to out-work them, and that only happens with people like you behind us.
The election is November 3. If you liked what you heard Monday, will you chip in $25 today so we can put that message in front of every voter who didn't see the debate?
Thank you for standing with me,Dan Ahlers _Your Candidate for Governor_

TODAY'S TOP STORIES

PROPOSITION 134 AND 135 FACT CHECK: WHAT THE MEASURES SAY AND WHAT
OPPONENTS CLAIM
[https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.

BY SHAINA COLE, ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE
[https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.

[https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.

A Facebook post from the Douglas County Democrats warns that under
Proposition 134, any student accused of being transgender could face
an invasive gender check, with no appeal.

The measure itself contains no such thing. There is no examination in
the final text. No mechanism for one student to accuse another. No
appeal provision in either direction, because there is no finding to
appeal from.

The measure uses the word “complaint” once, and it runs the other
way. It bars a government entity, licensing organization or athletic
association from entertaining a complaint or opening an investigation
against a school for keeping a separate team for female students.

[https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.

COLORADO RANKS 36TH ON THE HERITAGE ELECTION INTEGRITY SCORECARD
[https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.

BY SHAINA COLE, ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE
[https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.

_Colorado scored just 45 of 100 points on Heritage Foundation's 2026
election integrity scorecard, landing 36th out of 51, with voter ID,
mail ballots and citizenship verification dragging the score down._

*
THREE CATEGORIES ACCOUNT FOR MOST LOST POINTS: Colorado scored 6 of 20
on voter ID, 7 of 17 on mail ballot management, and just 2 of 13 on
citizenship verification, together accounting for 35 of the state's 55
missing points, while scoring well on voter roll accuracy (18 of 21).

*
MAIL VOTING AND BALLOT COLLECTION DRAW THE BIGGEST DEDUCTIONS: The
state automatically mails ballots to all active registered voters,
which cost it 4 points, requires no photo ID or unique identifier for
absentee voting (0 of 6), and scored 0 of 4 for allowing a voter to
designate any person to deliver their ballot.

*
A BALLOT MEASURE COULD MOVE THE NEEDLE: Amendment 84, on the Nov. 3
ballot, would require voters to include the last four digits of a
government ID number with mail ballots, directly addressing the
absentee-ID question where Colorado currently scores zero; it needs
55% to pass as a constitutional amendment.

[https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.
BY MARK SALLEY | COMMENTARY | OCTOBER 2

_Imagine you are an investor in a business...maybe a restaurant. For
the last six years you have been pouring more and more of your
hard-earned money into the business to keep it afloat. And despite
your increasing investment, you lost more and more of your
customers...for each of the past six years. On top of that, most
customers failed to give the restaurant a passing grade._

CD-3 STATE BOARD OF EDUCATION: SHERRI WRIGHT, BARB CLEMENTI AND WHAT
GOES UNSAID
[https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.
BY CHRISTY ANDERSON | COMMENTARY | OCTOBER 1

_We have two educators running for the Colorado State Board of
Education CD-3 seat in November. It may please you or surprise you to
know that both have actually been in a classroom. Sherri Wright,
running as the incumbent, was a teacher for 20 years in Colorado and
Texas._

_In Thornton, the water and sewer charges alone on a new
2,000-square-foot house come to $57,203. Add the rest of the taxes and
fees, and the total reaches $79,503, according to a new report from
the Common Sense Institute (CSI). Somebody pays it._

Hi team,
**" I'm not surprised."**
That's what a lot of my old classmates said at our class reunion last weekend when we talked about my campaign for Congress.
They remember me as someone who wrote for the school paper and said what I thought, whether it was popular or not. Who stood up for what I believe in, and didn't back down. And who was -- and still is -- proud as hell to be where we're from.
On the trail, people tell me, "You'll get to Washington and forget about us." And I understand why. Dan Meuser has sold us out time and time again.
But I'm the same person I was in high school. Determined, hardworking, and ready to work with anyone to get results for our communities here at home.
**Here 's my promise:** If you send me to Washington, I won't forget where I came from.
But I can only get there with your support.
**[With just 32 days to go, will you chip in to help me fight for our part of PA, my home, in Congress?](https://substack.com/redirect/69ced019-86fd-4fd6-9d0b-e53bf2498a18?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

From here, for here. Always.
- Rachel Wallace

Hey Peter,
---
The Democratic Congressional Campaign Committee (DCCC) announced today that this race in NC-13 is on their radar and is very much in play. We've known this all along, but now they’re seeing it too. Here’s what they said in a press release this morning: “Today, the DCCC is expanding House Democrats’ Districts in Play for the 2026 election cycle to include North Carolina’s Thirteenth Congressional District, signaling Democrats’ readiness to reclaim the House majority by widening the battlefield and working to defeat Brad Knott.” Being added as a “District in Play” shows that support for our campaign continues to grow. This also reinforces what we already knew: **_this race is winnable. _** DCCC Chair Susan DelBene said, “Knott's disastrous record, highlighted by his votes to kick thousands of North Carolinians off their health insurance, give tax breaks to billionaires, and support Trump's cost-hiking agenda, has made life unaffordable for working families.” I agree. We must do better for our community. I’m running for US House to put the people of the district first. To uphold the Constitution. To represent North Carolina values. And to bring a little common sense to Congress. I want to help fix what’s broken in Washington – and I hope I can count on your support to do so. As more folks start to tune in, I need your help to show up stronger than ever and keep showing how hard we are working to flip this district together.

name: Roy Cooper
subject: Election night in 2016
body:
A number that still keeps me up at night
| [](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1567&source=&t=1&akid=4149%2E124072%2EizHPtm) | | | |
---
Peter,
At the end of this message, I’m going to ask you to chip in $5 to my Senate campaign here in North Carolina. If you’re ready to give now, you can use this link to donate: [**_https:/ /secure.actblue.com/donate/cooper-email_**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1567&amount=5&t=8&akid=4149%2E124072%2EizHPtm)
**Otherwise, I want to share a number with you that still keeps me up at night.**
In 2016, I ran for Governor for the first time.
I was fighting to unseat Republican Governor Pat McCrory. Nobody had defeated an incumbent Governor in North Carolina for more than 150 years, but I knew that we had the team behind us to win and make history.
Poll after poll showed me with a slight – or sometimes even large – lead. The momentum was on our side.
However, on election night, the race was too close to call.
I ended that night with a less than 5,000-vote lead – which might sound like a lot but is a razor-thin margin in North Carolina, especially given the 4.6 million ballots cast. It was less than half of 1%.
Governor McCrory didn’t concede. He claimed that there had been voter fraud in our state with no evidence to back it up.
He called for a recount, and over the next month, he and his team continued spreading baseless conspiracy theories and undermining faith in the democratic process.
**Yet on Dec. 5, 2016, democracy won. The recount was wrapped up, all the provisional votes were counted and the final results were in: We had won the race by 10,277 votes.**
Peter, this current Senate race is starting to remind me a lot of my 2016 race.
Just like in 2016, the momentum today appears to be on our side.
The polls have shown me with a slight advantage, and even though President Trump carried North Carolina each of the three times he ran, experts are saying this is the best chance for Democrats to flip a Republican-held Senate seat in the country.
Here’s what worries me ...
**We could have just as easily lost that race in 2016. Despite all of the winds blowing in our favor, we still only won by 10,277 votes – just 0.22%.**
This summer, GOP spending in our race reached more than $100 million. Super PACs and dark-money groups relentlessly attacked me with baseless ads and misinformation.
That’s why we simply cannot take our foot off the gas. We cannot look at the polls and the predictions and think for a second that we have this in the bag. With a month left until Election Day, the GOP’s spending will keep chipping away at our momentum unless we have the resources to fight back.

# [](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/go/1269?t=1&akid=3936%2E21716%2E6I1B3u)
Hi,
I hope you’re well! I know how committed you are to helping Democrats take back the House Majority. Right now, candidates across the country are working hard to connect with voters, win this November, and deliver real results for the American people.
**DCCC Red Alert Round #2**
**Frontline Members:**
Gabe Vasquez (NM-02)
Tom Suozzi (NY-03)
Marcy Kaptur (OH-09)
Henry Cuellar (TX-28)
Vicente Gonzalez (TX-34)
**Red to Blue Candidates:
** Bill Hill (AK-AL)
Manny Rutinel (CO-08)
Will Lawrence (MI-07)
Shannon Taylor (VA-01)
Mitch Berman (WI-01)
**Gabe Vasquez (NM-02)** is laser focused on lowering costs, securing better paying jobs and making Southern New Mexico communities safer in this district Trump won in 2024.
Donald Trump’s Super PAC is spending millions against **Tom Suozzi (NY-03)** , a bipartisan leader, because they know he won’t be easy to beat.
**Marcy Kaptur (OH-09)** is the longest serving woman in Congress and a fighter for Northeast Ohio. Republicans couldn’t beat her in 2024, so they re-drew the congressional map in a desperate attempt to try and flip this seat.
**Henry Cuellar (TX-28) and Vicente Gonzalez (TX-34)** have a proven record of delivering for South Texas. Across Texas and the country, a wave of Latino voters are ready to reject Republicans at the ballot box.
**Bill Hill (AK-AL)** is a commercial fisherman, union construction worker and educator of nearly 25 years. Bill understands the economic pressures Alaskans are facing right now. He is running to make government work for hardworking families, because he is one.
As a teen, **Manny Rutinel (CO-08)** worked at McDonalds, tutored kids and even sold plasma to help pay the bills after the bank foreclosed on his family home. Manny is running for Congress to fight for working families, create good paying jobs and fix our broken healthcare system.
**Will Lawrence (MI-07)** is ready to serve Mid-Michiganders. He has a proven track record of protecting manufacturing jobs and leading the fight for affordable housing. He was one of the top vote getters in the primary, and has shown his campaign has the momentum, enthusiasm and organization to win this critical seat in November.
**Shannon Taylor (VA-01)** is a career prosecutor with a 90% homicide conviction rate. In 2011, Shannon became the first Democrat in nearly 40 years and first woman ever to win the office of Henrico Commonwealth’s Attorney. She’s ready to flip Virginia’s First Congressional District blue.
Wisconsinites know what hard work is, and **Mitch Berman (WI-03)** is a registered nurse and father who has dedicated his career to fighting for his community. Raised in a one-stoplight town, Mitch was brought up on the rural values that corrupt career politicians like his opponent Rep. Bryan Steil have long forgotten.
[**Could you donate now to support these 10 candidates and help take back the House?**](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/go/1566?c0=2026_redalert_2.ETPLqV&t=2&akid=3936%2E21716%2E6I1B3u)

Thanks for your support. With your help, Democrats will take back the House in 2026.
All my best,
Sarah McBride

These laws are called shield laws. They protect healthcare workers who provide abortion care, in person or by telemedicine, from punishment by states that ban abortion.
[These three states are trying to skip the normal court process and go straight to the Supreme Court.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/140531359/650786184/1168025325?sourceid=1151655&utm_campaign=27emage-1004aax-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=shieldlaws&amtOpts=&recurringAmtOpts=&am=&recurringAm=&is_optimized_ask=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0MGUxMzFhNS1hYmJlLWYxMTEtYTZhOS0wMDBkM2E1NmQyZjciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=jTfT6ws9bFZpOm7-7oT8G3PgjmgfmQLOsDVLntiajlU=&emci=df29b6a7-a9be-f111-a6a9-000d3a56d2f7&emdi=40e131a5-abbe-f111-a6a9-000d3a56d2f7&ceid=954237) If five justices agree to take up the case, the three states can officially file their lawsuit.

They accuse these providers of mailing abortion pills into states that ban abortion. Several other lawsuits like this are underway.
[These cases are part of a coordinated national effort to attack abortion pills, even though more than 7.5 million people in the U.S. have used them safely.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/140531362/650786187/1168025325?sourceid=1151655&utm_campaign=27emage-1004aax-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=shieldlaws&amtOpts=&recurringAmtOpts=&am=&recurringAm=&is_optimized_ask=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0MGUxMzFhNS1hYmJlLWYxMTEtYTZhOS0wMDBkM2E1NmQyZjciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=jTfT6ws9bFZpOm7-7oT8G3PgjmgfmQLOsDVLntiajlU=&emci=df29b6a7-a9be-f111-a6a9-000d3a56d2f7&emdi=40e131a5-abbe-f111-a6a9-000d3a56d2f7&ceid=954237)
This is a fearmongering campaign. These states are using the Supreme Court as a megaphone to spread fear and misinformation, because they want to make it impossible for people to get abortion care.
The Center for Reproductive Rights is fighting in court to defend abortion pills and abortion providers, and you make that work possible. name: Gina Hinojosa
subject: Abbott won’t debate me
body:
Abbott’s scared. That’s why he refuses to debate me.
# [](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)[](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)
Peter,
Earlier this year, I called on Abbott to debate me.
Greg Abbott, however, ignored FOUR debate invitations, and he’s not making any attempts to debate me either.
We know why he won’t get on the debate stage: he’s failed Texans and doesn’t want me to call him out on it. But I’m ready, and have been ready, to get onto a debate stage and discuss my vision for a better Texas.
Property taxes have gone up 85%, public schools have shut down, and he’s allowed data centers and Flock cameras to flood the state. He’s been answering to his billionaire corporate donors, not hardworking Texans — and he can’t defend that on a debate stage.
**Texans deserve better. And I know we can win in November, but I can’t do it without you.**
In order to reach voters in every corner of the state, we need to continue to ramp up our ad spending and on-the-ground mobilization efforts. And we need the resources to do so.

Friends, Election Day is **32 days away** , and we just closed our final fundraising quarter before November — raising over $5 million, our strongest quarter yet. That is an extraordinary achievement, and it is a testament to the belief so many people have put into this fight. An Emerson College poll also came out this week showing us 2 points ahead of Mike Lawler!! It shows that ALL of the incredible work we are doing is paying off but it’s still close and we cannot afford to stop fighting like hell to get this done. In a race this close, money only gets us so far. What gets us across the finish line this November is folks knocking doors, making calls, and talking directly to voters across every corner of this district. That’s how we win. These next 32 days, we need to leave everything on the field — because our district and our country deserve better. THANK YOU for being part of this fight and for giving this all you’ve got! We are so proud to be in the arena with you. Now let’s go win! Team Cait

# **BREAKING: DNC Sues Trump Administration for Attempting to Disenfranchise American Citizens Abroad **
---
| | | _Trump’s DOD quietly removed process for American citizens born and remaining abroad to register to vote and request mail ballots_
Today, the DNC [sued](https://us.list-manage.com/zfV2jVfQXk3?e=d6c5c7d7ec&c2id=d01ae369e8fbc8d507a43d27c2d1769e) the Trump administration over the Department of Defense (DOD)’s attempt to disenfranchise eligible American citizens who were born and remain abroad by proclaiming a false “emergency” to justify changes to voter registration materials. The DNC’s complaint denounces the Trump administration for following the lead of the Republican National Committee in attempting to disenfranchise Americans abroad because they overwhelmingly favor Democratic candidates.

For decades, American citizens born and remaining abroad, including the children of veterans, have registered to vote and requested mail ballots using the Federal Post Card Application (FPCA). In late August, DOD proclaimed a false “emergency” to change the FPCA without notice and comment — eliminating the way thousands of American citizens born and remaining abroad register to vote and request ballots each year.

In August of a critical midterm election year, Trump’s DOD simply eliminated a box on the Federal Post Card Application that describes U.S. citizens born and remaining abroad — who are eligible to vote under the laws of 38 states and the District of Columbia — which could make it impossible for them to register to vote and request mail ballots.

_In response to this brazen attack on Americans’ right to vote,**DNC Chair Ken Martin released the following statement:**_
> “Trump and Republicans are so desperate to hang on to power that they are trying to eliminate the way some American citizens abroad register to vote and request mail ballots. They know that Americans, both at home and abroad, are going to reject their destructive agenda, and they are scrambling to disenfranchise as much of the electorate as possible by any means necessary. The DNC will continue to use every legal tool at our disposal to defend every American’s First Amendment right to participate in our democracy — no matter who they are or where they live.”
>
>
> ###

September was our busiest and best month yet.

**[Help us keep Charlie’s mission alive and turn September’s momentum into November’s victory.](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.com/click/e16885575/VaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYW5lZG90LmNvbS90cHBhYy90cHBhY19kb25fc2Jfc2ZfbXQtb3RvY2hfYnJfMjAyNjEwMDIv/SZW1haWxfYW1lcmljYU9ORXN0d2Fycm9vbV9jb20yNjEwMDI/LbmNsTEVZSWFSTQ/qP3V0bV9tZWRpdW09YnImdXRtX3Rlcm09MjM2ODhfd3IxJmFtb3VudD0xMDA/gasAuxA/sdufe5df754)**

Peter,

Democrats know they cannot win on the issues. So they are lying about me.

A liberal DC Super PAC just **poured millions** into Montana to defeat me. They are flooding the airwaves across the state with lies about me. This is dark money from DC insiders who are trying to take this Senate seat out of Republican hands.

I need your help to fight back right now to get the truth out to every voter in this final stretch of the campaign. **[Are you with me?](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=cf8fad823aa04fc789302dcd1f67ce89&_e=syQ38QgIsc2PNulg3VA1jSgS3Ngc8KEtzxG-p60zEN3tL9vbtws62RW-ip_CKjsZzDr_GTEj2aLJ2qjwVPG7inZHzPL6VJgytkN7A7Tl2Cv7q-NQdktJP8NfWkrqHmH77MAysSv97ml_TgNtRZbARVcM2aXwUvTYCD5xoZeqVxMNZ1iOlSh0-BtUTyBdxuCcz_N5M2Rd7y4Thxr3XA3BA3ljEK-GWzajq_BLFu8UyHKKmYiWpxfhSkfu8eQujgUa3AOEbOE5_NRyodpxKENAZg5upFpDjQu2XHZUX7jgK7iI9RpEHpSNyLWkJDkNB3AU6fQxisjY3CsZbsQOLDtQ2lgRW7Bw00sW4EachIjW8lSFw9q0_6awVMqUJMOxfIGO064L7KxWhZqiYB7_a8nhm-C6ru1piPDktyJR7HaqwTnqpIfdjE9QzUwIbGz5qe76MQKauZ-u-tx9Op3f0S18ZrJoRkndYR69isql-MeiBodyKAOVAdJxy956-zA6JzDKFkSNvVUmk0kB2wFEAp1Spjnrfm5q0PJxqYUKvEshoBC3kAiqy1IQW3DtWBNK5yHg0TMgyLZN04UhGYO7S-gWw9ErYt5gZrpK03hUagDXOCZSEUcvon6iZ6HQBiJ5Ws1Fi90ok0VVK-PbFkR2NfqF6hEhuiilp_s_WMjPNo3WnoLn8LqPlWSfnVclNNZ9kymPunzHORjj3A6BhiZUXEAbMQ%3D%3D)**

Let me be clear about what is happening. My opponents' campaigns are built on deception and dark money. They are pretending to be something they’re not while getting bankrolled by the same liberal DC machine that has been trying to flip red states for years. This is the same playbook they are running in Iowa - targeting competitive states where flipping just one seat puts Democrats in control.

**They are not spending millions in Montana because they care about this state. They are spending it because they want control. And we need the resources to fight back.**

Here is the truth they do not want you to know. I am a Trump-nominated federal prosecutor who spent my career taking on cartels, drug traffickers, and violent criminals threatening Montana families, women, and children. I cut taxes. I balanced budgets. name: Francesca Governali, LCV
subject: LAST CHANCE: STOP Trump’s Repeal of the Roadless Rule!
body:
Add your name before October 6!

If you are unable to see the message below, [click here to view](https://links.messages.lcv.org/servlet/MailView?ms=MTM5OTk3NzIS1&r=NjA3MDU0MTAzNTc3S0&j=MjU2MDAxOTcxMQS2&mt=1&rt=0).
| | | |
---
| | | |
## _**LAST CHANCE:**_
**STOP Trump’s Repeal of the Roadless Rule!**
The Trump administration has officially proposed repealing protections for more than **44 MILLION ACRES of our national forests**. If this succeeds, it would mean more logging, more roads through undeveloped wilderness, and the destruction of remote, ecologically intact forests that are essential to the health and safety of people, wildlife, and our climate. **_Comments are open until October 6._** The administration needs to hear us loud and clear: Hands Off Our National Forests!
[**_Add your name to defend our forests >>_**](https://links.messages.lcv.)
---
| | | [ADD YOUR NAME](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/w_)
---
| | The Trump administration has officially proposed repealing the Roadless Rule, which protects more than **44 MILLION acres of land from logging and road construction, including old-growth forests** like the Tongass National Forest in Alaska.
---
| | The Roadless Rule is one of the most important safeguards we have to protect our forests from corporate development. For the last 25 years, the Roadless Rule has protected America’s most ecologically intact forests and wild places. Now, in a clear giveaway to billionaire industry executives — and against the wishes of the millions of people who have voiced their support for these protections over the last three decades — Trump and his allies want to gut these protections.
---
| | This rollback would jeopardize our nation’s most treasured old-growth forests and threaten the health and safety of communities across the country — all for corporate polluter profits.
---
| | [**_We can’t let corporate polluters tear down our irreplaceable old-growth forests, Peter. Add your name to keep our forests protected >>_**](https://links.messages.lcv.)
---
| | | [TAKE ACTION NOW](https://links.messages.lcv.)
---
| | This rollback is a blatant, reckless giveaway to Big Polluters — with devastating costs for our communities and our planet:
* **Wildlife habitat will be shattered** , pushing vulnerable species to the brink.
* **Drinking water will be polluted for millions of Americans** , due to increased runoff and contamination from deforestation.
* **Old-growth forests will be destroyed** , releasing more carbon and worsening the climate crisis.
* **Wildfires will be made more destructive** , fueled by new roads and reckless development.
* **Our last wild places will be lost** , sacrificed for corporate profits.

---
| | Public comments are open now — and the administration needs to hear from all of us. Add your voice today to defend our forests, our climate, and our communities. [**Submit your comment today to defend our old-growth forests and the Roadless Rule.**](https://links.messages.lcv.)
---
| | Francesca Governali
Senior Government Affairs Advocate, Conservation
League of Conservation Voters
---
| | |

Hoosier Farmers are Facing Higher Costs Due to Republican Control Indiana farmers are being squeezed by high costs and unstable trade policies caused by the Trump administration. Farmers are facing rising fuel and fertilizer prices leading to financial turmoil and uncertainity. Hoosier farmers are the backbone of our economy, and they deserve stable markets and fair prices. It's time they have a government that has their back. Each week, the State Party will highlight key policy or programs from Democrats at the Statehouse or across the state. Democrats deliver a better future for Hoosier families, and we urge you to share this information with your networks. Hoosier Democrats are Fighting for Workers, Not Big Businesses More than 800 Hoosier workers at British Petroleum’s Whiting Refinery have been locked out of their jobs since March with little explanation and no paycheck. The lockout began after contract talks stalled, with the union stating that BP wants to cut more than 100 jobs and reduce pay. These workers did nothing wrong except stand up for their jobs and fair, livable wages. Indiana Democrats are fighting to get them the unemployment benefits they deserve. name: Pramila Jayapal
subject: I refuse to accept this system
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Pramila for Congress
body:
Big Pharma and the insurance lobby spend millions every year to buy politicians, protect their profits, and keep this system exactly as it is.
# [](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/892?refcode=em20261002-6793-footer&t=1&akid=6793%2E420207%2E5lt4wN)
Peter,
In our current healthcare system, for-profit insurance companies make more money when they deny your claim, delay your care, or price you out of coverage entirely.
_I refuse to accept this system._
**Americans pay more than any country in the world for health care so private insurance companies can rake in tens of billions of dollars in profit.**
We spend nearly 18% of our GDP on health care (that’s over $5 trillion a year!), all while getting worse results. Compared to other wealthy nations we spend almost double per person. And yet we have the highest maternal mortality rate, the worst performance on access and coverage, and the highest rate of deaths from avoidable and treatable causes.
That’s why I’ve introduced the Medicare For All Act in session after session, and I’m going to keep it up until we guarantee healthcare for every American from birth until death.
**Just look at what the status quo has given us:**
* 41% of Americans carry medical debt

* 1 in 3 Americans skip needed care due to healthcare costs

* 1 in 4 families struggle to pay medical bills

* 82% of Americans are forced to pay out of pocket

**Medicare For All would change all of that.** You would have the freedom to choose your own doctor. The freedom to control your own health. The freedom from profit-seeking insurance companies running our broken system.
Every person in this country would be covered from birth to death. No premiums, no deductibles, no copays. Dental, vision, mental health, prescription drugs, and long-term care would all be covered. Your coverage would stay with you if you change jobs, start a business, or retire.
**Because Medicare For All is freedom for all.**
But Big Pharma and the insurance lobby spend millions every year to buy politicians, protect their profits, and keep this system exactly as it is so they can continue to line their own pockets. This kind of change is only going to happen when millions of people across the country stand up and demand it.
**[So Peter, if you’re with me, will you add your name right now and help build the grassroots pressure we need to make Medicare For All a reality?](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/signup/pj-em-20261002-medicare-for-all-petition/?source=em20261002-6793&t=2&akid=6793%2E420207%2E5lt4wN)**
**[Add Your Name](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/signup/pj-em-20261002-medicare-for-all-petition/?source=em20261002-6793&t=3&akid=6793%2E420207%2E5lt4wN)**
In solidarity,
Pramila Jayapal
**[Contribute](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pj-email-footer?refcode=em20261002-6793-footer&t=4&refcode2=6793_420207_5lt4wN&akid=6793%2E420207%2E5lt4wN)**
