# [](https://act.fordfornevada.com/go/12?t=1&akid=1007%2E127862%2E-hLh0K)
If your inbox looks anything like mine, it’s probably full of messages like this. Campaigns across the country are asking for your help. I get it.
So all I’ll say is this: **let me make my case to you.**
I've made plenty of cases as Attorney General. But this one's personal — it's about why our campaign needs you now more than ever. Here goes nothing:
* **First, this race is a total Toss-Up.** The Cook Political Report says it, and so does Sabato’s Crystal Ball. Nate Silver rated Nevada as the single most competitive governor’s race in the country. These forecasters agree that we’re one of the closest races on the ballot this November.

* **Second, we just picked up a small lead.** The latest Emerson poll has us up by two points. That comes after months of polls showing MAGA Gov. Joe Lombardo ahead. I don't want us to lose that momentum.

* **Third, time is running out fast.** We only have a few weeks left to campaign. In that same poll, more than 1 in 10 voters were still undecided. We're running out of time to reach them.

Put it all together, and a dollar in a race this close goes further than a dollar almost anywhere else.
**[So I'll rest my case with one question: can you chip in $5 today to help us win this thing?](https://act.fordfornevada.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_af_20261002_2_ak.A24u7Y&amount=5&refcode=em20261002-990&t=3&akid=1007%2E127862%2E-hLh0K)**

Aaron

| | This week marked one year since the Trump administration tried to invade Portland with armed thugs. Throughout the spring, summer, and early fall of 2025, the administration put a _lot_ of PR effort into portraying our city as full of violent insurrectionists who pose a clear and present danger to the republic. Peter, want to hear some bad news for Elon Musk? (We thought so.) So far this cycle, he’s poured millions of dollars into the Ohio governor’s race — but his Republican candidate, his DOGE co-founder Vivek Ramaswamy, is still locked in a TOSS-UP with Dr. Amy Acton, the Democracy Defender we endorsed. Dr. Acton has even taken a narrow LEAD in some recent polls. Billionaires like Elon Musk have saturated the airwaves with ads attacking Dr. Acton, but just like we saw when Elon tried to buy a Wisconsin Supreme Court election last year, voters aren’t buying it. Our democracy is not for sale. (Sorry not sorry, Elon.) But this race is way too close for comfort, and the spending disparity is only widening. This election is critical for the fair maps movement: the Ohio governor sits on the state’s redistricting commission and signs or vetoes maps passed by the legislature. [This is one of over 300 races we’re targeting across the country as vital to future fights over redistricting and voting rights. | Folks, there is no more “preparing” for election season. It’s already here. In a matter of weeks, Pennsylvanians will begin to fill out their mail-in ballots. If that doesn’t sound like a lot of time to reach millions of voters — it’s not. We’ve got another issue too: Our fundraising has slowed down at the worst possible time, and we need at least 94 more individual donations to get back on track. [Will you step up and become one of those 94 supporters we need before midnight?](https://zzejj9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001cz4ALSwNc80dC-GoX3yFtRvVv6TmjffvDB69oGewXwNyYF2aEPmwCuPBaZR4cZIdHWDtm8Jd50o_M6nnvoy1zFQLoQapEv-6atvocydlKXjbPXYX9sDwwhP8YuGqStEvzh4ok5AngMFIBGadMYkLf6rzkSA7R6GzQoBVyehy30_52uoIu09C2s2XETc-XQsACzjQyWzUSvlxaZWQ_PvH9c5ORxjCy0f5XIem_eG4blMcAiRkTrdtcjH856CbLf1ZuzQ7jkz1L12Ni1C2v2PFfA==&c=oHREJDmd4ybV_PE5VaNk2fTn-05BE9qWHwMiYR3i5R7C4gWaAzsy5g==&ch=vJZo-HBR5ZDmY_EuYYi10EwBWkl_bu5omLJ1mkf3OB2nwGLYaRKXRw==) Listen, I’m not saying this to scare anybody. I’m saying it because each and every supporter deserves to know the full, unvarnished truth about the stakes of this election. If my opponent wins, Donald Trump’s far-right movement will not only control every state-level office in Pennsylvania... They’ll now have an election denier in the Governor’s Office in the swingiest of swing states in the country. This one, singular election on November 3rd won’t only change Pennsylvania's future. It could change our entire country’s future — and that’s exactly why I’m asking for your support. This race will be won by reaching voters where they are... and telling them exactly what is at stake.
Central New York families are paying more for groceries, utilities, housing, healthcare, and childcare. Farmers and small businesses are buried in red tape. Too many young people believe they have to leave home to find opportunity.

| Friend, it’s Adam Schiff.

We recently learned that the U.S. Postal Service is secretly following Trump’s plan to block millions of mail-in ballots this fall — in defiance of several court orders telling them to stop.

I want to be direct with you about what this really is. It’s not a bureaucratic mess. It’s not a technical glitch.

**This is a poison Donald Trump has been feeding the American people for years: make voters doubt whether their vote will even count.**

He and his allies have worked long and hard to cast doubt on our elections — because a public that distrusts its own elections is easier to control than one that shows up and makes their voices heard at the ballot box.

I've spent my career standing up to people who tried to bury the truth for political gain, and I can tell you: the greatest threat to this democracy right now isn't coming from outside our borders.

_It's coming from a president who grows more powerful when we stop believing our votes matter._

**There is only one antidote strong enough to counter that threat: turnout so large and so overwhelming that no purged list or rigged voting system can suppress it.**

That is the movement we’re building. Seat by seat, state by state. And there is no question that it requires each and every one of us to step up.

| | Folks, on a long deployment, a sailor's wish list gets very short. Mail from loved ones, a home-cooked meal, a hot shower. That's about it. Nobody at sea is asking for luxuries. They're asking for the basics to work. I've been knocking doors across Hampton Roads for months, and the list I hear from folks on their front porches isn't much longer:
1. **Affordable health coverage that doesn’t leave them high and dry.**
2. **A grocery bill that doesn't make them wince.**
3. **Leaders who keep their promises.**

_That's not a lot to ask._ Right now, Jen Kiggans is failing on all three counts. _She has voted with Trump 100% of the time this Congress._
1. She supported the tariffs that have raised prices on nearly everything families here buy. (The Joint Economic Committee puts the average extra cost of everyday goods for Virginia families at $3,800. I ran a small business here before I ran for Congress, and I know exactly what a cost increase like that does to a family budget or a payroll.)
2. She promised to protect access to health care, then voted for the largest Medicaid cuts in history.
3. She said she'd extend the ACA tax credits, then voted to let premiums skyrocket.

**Here's what I'll fight for in Congress:**
* Lower costs. Ending the tariff chaos that's squeezing families at the checkout line and the gas pump.
* Lower drug prices. I voted to let Medicare negotiate drug prices and to cap insulin at $35 a month for seniors. Now we need to go further.
* A ban on members of Congress trading stocks. If you write the rules, you shouldn't get to profit from them.

But I can’t wave a magic wand and make all of this a reality. First, I need a House majority that works for the American people, not the most corrupt president in history. To that end, Democrats need to flip three seats. **VA-02 has to be one of them.** We have 32 days left to flip this seat. [**Just $10 will help me turn out the voters who will decide this race, take back the House, and put the basics back within reach. Can I count on you to back me up today?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/140536213/650800027/1362775340?refcode=EM_BS_LUR_261002_FR_NotAlot_A0_na_U1_X1_M3&amount=10&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDA3OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyNWJhNjM0YS1iY2JlLWYxMTEtYTZhOS0wMDBkM2E1NmQyZjciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=bk1cfkbMaSHX-98fS6Ynltc51vIEYfPN142Sup1cRKM=) | | | [Donate Now!](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/140536214/650800028/1362775340?refcode=EM_BS_LUR_261002_FR_NotAlot_A0_na_U1_X1_M3&amount=10&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDA3OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyNWJhNjM0YS1iY2JlLWYxMTEtYTZhOS0wMDBkM2E1NmQyZjciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=bk1cfkbMaSHX-98fS6Ynltc51vIEYfPN142Sup1cRKM=)

She promised to protect access to health care, then voted for the largest Medicaid cuts in history. 3. She said she'd extend the ACA tax credits, then voted to let premiums skyrocket. Here's what I'll fight for in Congress: Lower costs. Ending the tariff chaos that's squeezing families at the checkout line and the gas pump. Lower drug prices. I voted to let Medicare negotiate drug prices and to cap insulin at $35 a month for seniors. Now we need to go further. A ban on members of Congress trading stocks. If you write the rules, you shouldn't get to profit from them. But I can’t wave a magic wand and make all of this a reality. First, I need a House majority that works for the American people, not the most corrupt president in history. To that end, Democrats need to flip three seats. VA-02 has to be one of them.** We have 32 days left to flip this seat. = | | | = Gratefully, Elaine Luria | | We believe that emails are the best way for our campaign to stay in touch with supporters like you. name: OnePA Team
subject: Stop making working families cover for billionaires
body:
Tell your state legislators to introduce and pass a tax on billionaires’ income from wealth. | |
---
Peter, **We pay taxes out of the wages we work for. Billionaires can watch their investments grow by millions, borrow against those fortunes, and spend the money while the gains remain untaxed.** Our families keep contributing with every paycheck. The super wealthiest have access to an entirely different tax system that lets enormous amounts of their income escape taxation. That arrangement reaches into our neighborhoods. We feel it when our children’s schools have too few teachers, when getting healthcare means traveling farther, and when housing costs swallow most of a paycheck. Our communities need public investment, and billionaires have more than enough wealth to contribute. **Much of their income comes from owning stocks, real estate, and other investments. When those assets rise in value, the gains generally go untaxed until they sell.** Even then, those gains are taxed at rates far below what working people pay on our wages. And still, before they sell, billionaires can use their investments as collateral for favorable loans, giving them money to live on without selling and triggering a tax bill at all. Their fortunes can keep growing while those gains go untaxed for decades. **We can organize to change those rules. In Pennsylvania, OnePA is part of the**** _Tax Billionaires, Fund PA_****coalition demanding more revenue from billionaires’ unearned income.** That fight offers a demand communities across the country can bring to their own state legislatures. We can put that demand directly in lawmakers’ offices and build pressure for them to introduce legislation and move it toward a vote. **MAGA’s federal cuts are putting huge pressure on the services our families depend on. Thousands have already been thrown off Medicaid and SNAP in Pennsylvania, with more to come. State lawmakers must use their power to raise revenue from the wealthiest and protect the people they represent.** Our communities cannot keep being cut out while billionaires accumulate fortunes that escape taxation.
For working-class and Black communities, those budget decisions shape our daily lives. They determine whether our children get the education they deserve, whether our neighbors can access care, and whether families can remain in the communities they helped build. We have every reason to demand a greater say in where public dollars come from and where they go.
**OnePA members build that power through organizing. We bring neighbors together around shared needs, develop community leaders, and hold elected officials accountable.** Every person who takes action strengthens the demand for a tax system that makes billionaires contribute to the services all of us depend on.
